etymology_story.zh: 该词来自古希腊语 philéllēn（喜爱希腊人或希腊文化的），由表示喜爱的成分和 Hellēn（希腊人）组成。它在十九世纪早期英语中与支持希腊独立的运动密切相关，也用于表达对希腊文化的喜爱。[词源参考](https://www.etymonline.com/word/philhellene)
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Ancient Greek philéllēn, meaning Greek-loving, combining an element expressing affection with Hellēn, a Greek. In early nineteenth-century English it was closely associated with support for Greek independence, while also developing cultural applications. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/philhellene)

morphology_enriched.zh: 可识别的构词成分：phil-（喜爱；philo- 的变体）+ Hellene（希腊人）→ philhellene。主要词族：philhellenes（复数）、philhellenist（亲希腊者）、philhellenists（复数）、philhellenic（亲希腊的）、philhellenism（亲希腊思想或运动）；名词与形容词 philhellene 的重音相同，形容词也常用 philhellenic。[词类参考](https://www.vocabulary.com/dictionary/philhellene)
morphology_enriched.en: Recognizable components: phil-, the Greek-derived loving element related to philo-, + Hellene, a Greek, → philhellene. The principal family comprises philhellenes, philhellenist, philhellenists, philhellenic, and philhellenism. The noun and adjective philhellene have the same stress; philhellenic is also used as the adjective. [Part-of-speech reference](https://www.vocabulary.com/dictionary/philhellene)

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: philhellenist（亲希腊者）与名词 philhellene 基本同义；Graecophile（希腊文化爱好者）通常突出文化兴趣；Hellenist（希腊语言文化研究者）突出学术专长，不必然表示政治支持。形容词近义词 philhellenic 表示亲希腊的。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Philhellenist is essentially synonymous with the noun philhellene. Graecophile usually foregrounds cultural enthusiasm. Hellenist emphasizes expertise in Greek language or culture and does not necessarily imply political support. The adjective philhellenic means sympathetic to Greece or the Greeks.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: phil- 表示喜爱，Hellene 指希腊人：把喜爱投向希腊，就是亲希腊者。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Phil- supplies affection and Hellene supplies Greece: affection directed toward Greece makes a philhellene.

etymology.text: 借自盎格鲁法语 puisné，本指较晚出生、较年幼，后来用于表示地位较低。可用“后出生、排行在后”帮助记住职级含义。

usage_note: 主要见于英式法律称谓 puisne judge，指首席法官之外的法官，说明职级，不说明实际年龄；发音近似 puny。

senses.meaning_zh: 职位较低的；尤指首席法官以外的普通法官的
senses.meaning_en: Junior in judicial rank, especially holding a judgeship other than that of chief justice.
senses.english_definition: A puisne judge is a judge who does not hold the position of chief justice in the court concerned.

senses.meaning_zh: 职位较低者；尤指首席法官以外的普通法官
senses.meaning_en: A person of junior rank, especially a judge other than a chief justice.
senses.english_definition: In legal usage, a puisne is a judge who holds a position below that of the chief justice.

etymology_story.zh: puisne 经法律语言传入英语，源自古法语 puisné，字面义为后来出生的，由 puis（后来）和 né（出生的）组成。它从出生顺序靠后发展为职级较低，现代主要保留在司法用语中。[词源及词义参考](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=puisne)
etymology_story.en: Puisne entered English through legal usage from Old French puisné, literally born later, combining puis, afterward, and né, born. Its meaning shifted from later birth to junior rank and now survives chiefly in judicial terminology. [Etymology and meaning reference](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=puisne)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将 puisne 作为整体借词处理，不把 puis-、-ne 当作能产英语词缀；puis + né 是历史来源分析。名词复数为 puisnes；形容词通常无比较级变化。puny（弱小的）与其同源，但不是由现代英语 puisne 加词缀派生的词。[同源关系参考](https://www.etymonline.com/word/puisne)
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, puisne is an unanalyzed borrowing; puis- and -ne are not productive English affixes. Puis + né explains its historical construction. The noun plural is puisnes, and the adjective normally has no comparative forms. Puny shares its historical source but is not a modern English affixal derivative of puisne. [Relationship reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/puisne)

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: junior（级别或资历较低的）适用范围最广；associate judge（普通或陪席法官）在某些司法制度中与 puisne judge 对应，但具体职称依制度而异；subordinate（下属的）更强调上下级关系，不能在所有法院名称中直接替换 puisne。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Junior broadly describes lower rank or seniority. Associate judge corresponds to puisne judge in some judicial systems, but official titles vary. Subordinate emphasizes a hierarchical relationship and is not a universally interchangeable judicial title.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 历史逻辑是后来出生 → 排在后面 → 职级较低；记住它读作 /ˈpjuːni/，不是按字母逐段拼读。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Follow the historical chain: born later → placed after another → junior in rank. Pair that chain with the pronunciation /ˈpjuːni/.

senses.meaning_zh: 四叶饰；四瓣形图案或孔洞，尤用于建筑装饰和纹章
senses.meaning_en: A decorative shape or opening with four rounded, leaflike lobes.
senses.english_definition: A quatrefoil is a decorative shape with four rounded parts arranged like the leaves of a four-leaf clover.
senses.collocation_zh: 四叶形窗饰；四叶形窗
senses.sentence_en: A stone quatrefoil decorates the space above the doorway.
senses.sentence_zh: 门洞上方的墙面饰有一个石制四叶饰。

etymology_story.zh: 该词经中古英语传入，来自法语中表示四和叶的成分，早期指四叶或四小叶的形态。它后来用于指模仿这种形态的建筑孔洞与装饰图案。[词源参考](https://www.etymonline.com/word/quatrefoil)
etymology_story.en: The word reached English through Middle English from French elements meaning four and leaf, initially referring to a four-leaved or four-leafleted form. It later named architectural openings and decorative patterns resembling that form. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/quatrefoil)

morphology_enriched.zh: 可识别的历史构词：quatre（法语：四）+ foil（叶；见于传统构词中的借入成分）→ quatrefoil。主要形式为 quatrefoils（复数）、quatrefoiled（具有四叶饰的）；quatrefoil window 中 quatrefoil 是名词作定语，不必另立常用形容词词类。相关构词包括 trefoil（三叶饰）和 cinquefoil（五叶饰），它们不是由 quatrefoil 派生的。[词形参考](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/quatrefoil)
morphology_enriched.en: Recognizable historical construction: quatre, French for four, + foil, a borrowed leaf element preserved in traditional formations, → quatrefoil. Principal forms are quatrefoils and quatrefoiled. In quatrefoil window, quatrefoil functions as a noun modifier rather than requiring a separate common adjective entry. Parallel formations include trefoil and cinquefoil; neither derives from quatrefoil. [Word-form reference](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/quatrefoil)

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: four-lobed motif（四瓣图案）是强调轮廓的宽泛释义；four-leaf-clover motif（四叶草图案）突出与植物叶形的相似性；rosette（玫瑰花饰）指花朵状装饰，瓣数不固定，不能与 quatrefoil 完全等同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Four-lobed motif is a broad descriptive equivalent emphasizing the outline. Four-leaf-clover motif emphasizes resemblance to the plant. Rosette denotes a flowerlike ornament with no fixed number of lobes and is therefore only a related term.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: quatre 是四，foil 是叶：把四片圆叶围成一个装饰轮廓。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Quatre gives four and foil gives leaf: picture four rounded leaves forming one decorative outline.

morphology.text: rattle（咣当作响）+ trap（旧式轻便马车）→ rattletrap（破旧、响个不停的车辆或机器）。

senses.meaning_en: Rickety, mechanically unreliable, or in noisy disrepair.

etymology_story.zh: rattletrap 是由 rattle 和 trap 构成的英语复合词，十八世纪的早期用法带有对不值钱或运转不良之物的贬义，后来集中用于破旧作响的车辆和机器。trap 在这个复合词中的确切历史义项并不明确，不宜断定它最初就是指轻便马车。[词源参考](https://www.etymonline.com/word/rattletrap)
etymology_story.en: Rattletrap is an English compound of rattle and trap, used in the eighteenth century disparagingly for objects of little value or poor operation and later especially for shabby, rattling vehicles and machinery. The precise historical sense of trap in the compound is uncertain, so an original meaning of light carriage should not be asserted. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/rattletrap)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代形式分析：rattle（咣当作响）+ trap → rattletrap，属于意义已词汇化的复合词。名词复数为 rattletraps；同形形容词通常用于名词前，不常用比较级。首成分 rattle 的相关词包括 rattled、rattling、rattly、rattler，但这些不是由 rattletrap 派生的词。[形容词用法参考](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/rattletrap)
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formal analysis: rattle + trap → rattletrap, a compound with a lexicalized meaning. The noun plural is rattletraps. The identical adjective is normally used before a noun and is not commonly graded. Forms related to the first component include rattled, rattling, rattly, and rattler; these are not derivatives of rattletrap itself. [Adjectival-use reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/rattletrap)

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: jalopy（老爷破车）主要指破旧汽车；clunker（破车、破机器）突出老旧和运转不佳；rickety（摇摇欲坠的）是形容词，强调结构松散不牢，而 rattletrap 还常使人联想到咣当声。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Jalopy chiefly denotes an old, dilapidated car. Clunker emphasizes an old, poorly functioning vehicle or machine. Rickety is an adjective stressing structural shakiness, while rattletrap additionally evokes rattling noise.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住 rattle 的咣当声：车身一边晃、一边响，就是 rattletrap。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Let rattle provide the sound: a vehicle that shakes and clatters along is a rattletrap.

etymology.text: 中古英语 terredo 经拉丁语 teredo 借自希腊语 terēdōn，原指蛀木虫。它钻入木材的习性，比细长外形更能帮你记住名字。

senses.meaning_zh: 船蛆；蛀蚀水下木材的蠕虫状海生双壳贝类
senses.meaning_en: A wormlike marine bivalve that bores into submerged wood.
senses.english_definition: A teredo is a sea animal with a long, soft body and a small shell that it uses to bore into wood under water.
senses.collocation_zh: 船蛆侵害；船蛆造成的损坏
senses.sentence_en: The submerged wooden piles showed extensive teredo damage.
senses.sentence_zh: 浸在水中的木桩遭到了船蛆的严重蛀蚀。

etymology_story.zh: 英语 teredo 来自拉丁语 teredo，后者源于希腊语 terēdōn，意为蛀木虫，与表示磨损、钻孔的动词有关。这个名称突出其钻蛀木材的习性；船蛆实际上是双壳贝类。
etymology_story.en: English teredo comes from Latin teredo, ultimately from Greek terēdōn, meaning a wood-boring worm and related to a verb meaning to wear away or bore. The name reflects its wood-boring behavior, although the animal is actually a bivalve mollusc.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作不可进一步拆分的借入词处理，不宜把历史希腊语成分当作英语词缀。复数为 teredos 或 teredoes；Teredo 也是相关动物的属名。teredine（船蛆类的）和 teredinid（船蛆科动物；船蛆科的）是相关的专业词，普通英语中没有常用的动词或副词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, treat teredo as an unanalyzed loanword rather than a combination of productive English affixes. Its plurals are teredos and teredoes; Teredo is also a zoological genus name. Related specialist forms include teredine, meaning relating to shipworms, and teredinid, meaning a member of or relating to the shipworm family; there are no common derived verbs or adverbs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: shipworm（船蛆）是更常见的通称；wood-boring bivalve（蛀木双壳贝类）是解释性表达；wood borer（蛀木动物）范围更广，也可包括昆虫等其他动物。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Shipworm is the more familiar common name; wood-boring bivalve is a descriptive equivalent; wood borer is broader and can also refer to insects and other animals that tunnel into wood.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“钻木”这个动作：长得像虫，实际是用小贝壳钻木的贝类。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor it to boring through timber: a wormlike animal that drills with a tiny shell.

usage_note: 病毒学用语，指完整的病毒颗粒，含遗传物质和蛋白质衣壳，有些还有包膜；不是受感染的宿主细胞。

senses.meaning_zh: 病毒体；完整的病毒颗粒
senses.meaning_en: A complete virus particle containing genetic material within a protein coat, sometimes with an outer envelope.
senses.english_definition: A virion is a complete individual virus particle, consisting of genetic material inside a protective protein coat and, in some viruses, an outer envelope.
senses.collocation_zh: 病毒体组装；成熟病毒体
senses.sentence_en: Each virion contains a viral genome enclosed in a protein coat.
senses.sentence_zh: 每个病毒体都含有包裹在蛋白质外壳中的病毒基因组。

etymology_story.zh: 英语 virion 借自法语科学术语 virion，是与 virus（病毒）相关的现代造词。它把病毒作为生物学实体的概念具体化，专指一个完整的病毒颗粒。
etymology_story.en: English virion was borrowed from the French scientific term virion, a modern formation related to virus. It gives a specific name to the complete particle, distinguishing that physical unit from the broader concept of a virus.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代学习可把 virion 作为完整术语记忆，并联想 vir-（与 virus 有关）和科学颗粒名称中的 -on；这是一种记忆性分析。复数为 virions；相关词有 virus（病毒）、viral（病毒的）、virology（病毒学）、virologist（病毒学家）和 virological（病毒学的），它们属于相关词族，并非都由 virion 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Learn virion as a complete technical term, with a useful mnemonic association between vir- and virus and between -on and scientific particle names. The plural is virions. Related vocabulary includes virus, viral, virology, virologist, and virological; these belong to the related word family rather than all being direct derivatives of virion.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: virus particle（病毒颗粒）和 viral particle（病毒颗粒）是常见近义表达，但在具体研究中可能也包含不完整颗粒；virus（病毒）范围更广，可指病毒种类或整个感染性生物学实体。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Virus particle and viral particle are common near-equivalents, although particular studies may use them to include incomplete particles. Virus is broader and can refer to a type of virus or to the biological entity throughout its infection cycle.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: virus 是“病毒”，virion 是把它落实为“一颗完整颗粒”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think of a virion as one complete physical particle of a virus.

senses.meaning_zh: 供食用的银白色小鱼或幼鱼，通常整条烹食
senses.meaning_en: Small silvery fish, often juvenile fish, cooked and eaten whole.
senses.english_definition: Whitebait are very small fish that people usually cook and eat whole.
senses.collocation_zh: 炸小银鱼；小鱼煎饼
senses.sentence_en: We shared a plate of fried whitebait with lemon.

etymology_story.zh: whitebait 由英语 white（白色的）和 bait（鱼饵）复合而成，名称使人联想到银白色的小鱼。它后来成为食用小鱼的名称，在不同地区所指的鱼种并不相同。
etymology_story.en: Whitebait is an English compound of white and bait, evoking small, silvery fish. It became a name for small fish eaten as food, with the species covered by the term varying between regions.

morphology_enriched.zh: white（白色的）+ bait（鱼饵）→ whitebait，属于复合名词。它通常作集合名词使用，复数形式也常为 whitebait；没有常用的派生动词、形容词或副词。whitebait fishing（捕捞食用小鱼）等是短语组合，不是词缀派生。
morphology_enriched.en: White + bait forms the compound noun whitebait. It is normally used collectively, and its plural is commonly unchanged. There are no common derived verbs, adjectives, or adverbs; expressions such as whitebait fishing are phrase combinations rather than affixal derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: fry（鱼苗）强调鱼的幼小发育阶段，不一定供食用；juvenile fish（幼鱼）是更明确的生物学描述；small fish（小鱼）仅表示体型小。whitebait 特别强调作为食材的小鱼集合，具体鱼种因地区而异。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Fry emphasizes an early developmental stage and does not necessarily imply food; juvenile fish is a more explicit biological description; small fish refers simply to size. Whitebait specifically names a culinary grouping whose species vary by region.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: white + bait：一把银白小鱼，常常整条下锅。
mnemonic_anchor.en: White + bait: picture a handful of silvery little fish cooked whole.

senses.meaning_zh: 用于冥想或宗教仪式的象征性几何图式
senses.meaning_en: A symbolic geometric diagram used in meditation or religious ritual.
senses.english_definition: A yantra is a geometric design used in some Indian religious traditions to help people meditate or perform rituals.
senses.collocation_zh: 吉祥轮图；以几何圣图为辅助的冥想
senses.sentence_en: She focused on the central point of the yantra during meditation.
senses.sentence_zh: 冥想时，她将注意力集中在几何圣图的中心点上。

etymology_story.zh: yantra 借自梵语 yantra，原有器具、装置等含义，在历史构词上与表示控制、约束的词根 yam 及工具性后缀 -tra 有关。在宗教语境中，它发展出辅助冥想和仪式的象征性图式这一含义。
etymology_story.en: Yantra comes from Sanskrit yantra, meaning an instrument or device, historically associated with the root yam, meaning to restrain or control, and the instrumental suffix -tra. In religious use, it came to denote a symbolic diagram serving as an aid to meditation and ritual.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 yantra 是整体借入的名词，梵语词根和后缀不属于可自由使用的英语构词成分。复数为 yantras；专业形容词 yantric（与几何圣图有关的）可分析为 yantr- + -ic。没有常用的派生动词或副词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, yantra is a borrowed noun whose Sanskrit components are not productive English building blocks. Its plural is yantras. The specialist adjective yantric, meaning relating to a yantra, can be analyzed as yantr- + -ic; there are no common derived verbs or adverbs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sacred diagram（神圣图式）是宽泛的解释性近义表达；mandala（曼荼罗）也是宗教象征图式，但其结构、传统和用途与 yantra 不完全相同；talisman（护符）强调护佑作用，只在部分用途上重合。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sacred diagram is a broad descriptive equivalent. Mandala also names a religious symbolic design, but its structure, traditions, and uses do not exactly match those of a yantra. Talisman emphasizes protective power and overlaps only with some uses.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“工具”记到“心的工具”：用几何图形集中注意力。
mnemonic_anchor.en: From instrument to instrument of attention: a geometric design that helps focus the mind.

usage_note: 医学术语，描述血液和组织碱性异常增加的状态；与酸中毒 acidosis 方向相反，本词不是普通饮食中“碱性”的泛称。

senses.meaning_zh: 碱中毒；促使体液尤其是血液碱性升高的酸碱失衡过程
senses.meaning_en: An acid–base disturbance that tends to increase blood pH.
senses.english_definition: Alkalosis is a process in the body that tends to make the blood too alkaline, for example through a loss of acid or an increase in bicarbonate.
senses.collocation_zh: 代谢性碱中毒；呼吸性碱中毒
senses.sentence_en: Prolonged vomiting can cause metabolic alkalosis through the loss of stomach acid.
senses.sentence_zh: 持续呕吐可因胃酸流失而引起代谢性碱中毒。

etymology_story.zh: alkalosis 是以 alkali（碱）和源自希腊语的 -osis（状态，医学中常指异常状态）构成的现代医学词。alkali 经欧洲语言追溯至阿拉伯语中与盐生植物灰有关的名称，这种灰曾用于制取碱。
etymology_story.en: Alkalosis is a modern medical formation based on alkali and the Greek-derived suffix -osis, denoting a condition and often an abnormal one in medicine. Alkali ultimately comes through European languages from an Arabic term associated with the ashes of salt-tolerant plants, historically used to obtain alkali.

morphology_enriched.zh: alkal-（碱）+ -osis（异常状态）→ alkalosis。复数为 alkaloses；直接相关形容词为 alkalotic（碱中毒的）。相关词族包括 alkali（碱）、alkaline（碱性的）、alkalinity（碱度）、alkalize／alkalinize（使碱化）、alkalization／alkalinization（碱化）和 alkalemia（碱血症）。
morphology_enriched.en: Alkal- meaning alkali + -osis meaning an abnormal condition forms alkalosis. Its plural is alkaloses, and its directly related adjective is alkalotic. The wider related family includes alkali, alkaline, alkalinity, alkalize or alkalinize, alkalization or alkalinization, and alkalemia.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: alkalotic state（碱中毒状态）是解释性近义表达；alkalemia（碱血症）专指血液 pH 高于正常范围，并不与 alkalosis 完全等同；alkalinity（碱性、碱度）是一般性质或测量概念，本身不表示疾病。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Alkalotic state is a descriptive near-equivalent. Alkalemia specifically means an abnormally high blood pH and is not identical to alkalosis, which names a process that raises pH. Alkalinity is a general property or measurement and does not itself denote a medical disorder.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: alkal- 指“碱”，-osis 指“异常状态”：身体的酸碱平衡被推向碱性。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Alkal- signals alkali and -osis signals a condition: the body's balance is being pushed toward alkalinity.

morphology.text: 按历史形式理解：al（all，强调）+ tho（though）→ altho；较常见拼写 although 也保留这两个成分。

etymology.text: 对应中古英语 although，由 al“全、完全”与 though 组成。早期强调成分后来与“尽管”连在一起，形成表示让步的连词。

usage_note: 是 although 的较少见简化拼写；普通正式写作优先用 although。引导让步，不表示原因；虽处于句首也不能因此改写拼写。

senses.meaning_zh: 虽然；尽管（although 的非正式简化拼写）
senses.meaning_en: although; despite the fact that, in an informal simplified spelling
senses.english_definition: You use altho, an informal spelling of although, to introduce a fact that contrasts with what you say in the main clause.
senses.collocation_zh: 虽然……仍然……；尽管……可能……
senses.sentence_en: Altho it was raining, we still went for a walk.
senses.sentence_zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是出去散步了。

etymology_story.zh: Altho 是 although 的简化拼写，省去了 though 中不发音的 gh。Although 源于中古英语 al“完全、确实”和 though“虽然”的组合，其中 al 原本起强调作用。
etymology_story.en: Altho is a simplified spelling of although that omits the silent gh in though. Although developed from Middle English al, meaning 'entirely' or 'indeed,' plus though, with al originally adding emphasis.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词关系：although → altho，属于拼写简化，并非新增词缀构词；历史上可分析为 al（强调成分）+ though。相关形式有 although、though 和非正式拼写 tho，均不因人称或时态变化。CEFR-B1 参照标准词 although 作编辑估级，并非 altho 的独立官方评级。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: although → altho through spelling simplification, rather than affixation; historically, al is an intensifier added to though. Related forms are although, though, and informal tho; these conjunctions do not inflect. CEFR-B1 is an editorial estimate based on standard although, not a separate official rating for altho.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Although 是适合正式和一般书面语的标准拼写；though 意义接近，但也可作副词放在句末表示“不过”；even though 更强调事实与预期之间的反差。Altho 不宜替代正式写作中的 although。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Although is the standard spelling for both formal and ordinary writing; though has a similar meaning but can also function as a sentence-final adverb meaning 'however'; even though emphasizes a stronger contrast with expectations. Altho is generally unsuitable as a replacement for although in formal writing.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Although 去掉不发音的 gh，意思仍是“虽然”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remove the silent gh from although: the spelling changes, but the contrast remains.

morphology.text: an-（无）+ -ergy（反应、活动的构词成分）→ anergy（免疫无反应状态）。

etymology.text: 是由希腊语构词成分组成的国际科学用语：否定成分表示“无”，活动、作用的相关成分表示“反应”。英语最早见于1890年。可用“没有出现应有的免疫反应”记忆。

usage_note: 本课取免疫学义：机体或免疫细胞对抗原不能产生预期反应；不能按日常 energy 的样子理解成普通疲劳。

senses.meaning_zh: 免疫无反应状态，尤指免疫细胞对抗原刺激不产生正常反应
senses.meaning_en: a state of immune unresponsiveness, especially to antigen stimulation
senses.english_definition: Anergy is a state in which immune cells or the immune system fail to respond normally to an antigen.
senses.collocation_zh: T细胞无反应状态；诱导免疫无反应状态
senses.sentence_en: Recognition of an antigen without an appropriate second signal can induce T-cell anergy.
senses.sentence_zh: 识别抗原时，如果缺少适当的第二信号，就可能诱导T细胞进入无反应状态。

senses.meaning_zh: 精力缺乏；活动能力减退（较少见的医学用法）
senses.meaning_en: a lack of energy or reduced capacity for activity, in less common medical usage
senses.english_definition: Anergy can also mean a marked lack of energy or ability to be active.
senses.collocation_en: general anergy; a state of anergy
senses.collocation_zh: 全身乏力；精力缺乏的状态
senses.sentence_en: The older clinical account described the patient's profound lack of energy as anergy.
senses.sentence_zh: 这份较早的临床记录用 anergy 描述患者严重缺乏精力的状态。

etymology_story.zh: Anergy 的词源基础是希腊语 anergia“无活动、无工作”，由表示否定的 an- 和 ergon“工作、活动”组成。它早期表示活动或精力的缺乏，后来在免疫学中专指不能产生应有免疫反应的状态。
etymology_story.en: Anergy ultimately rests on Greek anergia, meaning 'inactivity,' formed from negative an- and ergon, 'work' or 'activity.' Its earlier sense of deficient activity or energy developed a specialized application to immune unresponsiveness.

morphology_enriched.zh: 科学构词可分析为 an-（无）+ -ergy（活动、作用），其中 -ergy 不专指“免疫反应”。词族包括 anergic（无反应的；乏力的）、anergize／anergise（使进入免疫无反应状态）、anergized、anergizing 和 anergization（无反应状态的诱导）；后几项主要用于专业文献。Energy、energetic 与其共享远源词根，但不是 anergy 的派生词。CEFR-C2 为专业词汇的编辑估级，并非官方单词评级。
morphology_enriched.en: The scientific formation can be analyzed as an- 'without' + -ergy 'activity or action'; -ergy does not specifically mean an immune response. The family includes anergic, anergize/anergise, anergized, anergizing, and anergization, with the latter forms mainly occurring in specialist writing. Energy and energetic share a distant root but are not derivatives of anergy. CEFR-C2 is an editorial estimate for this specialist vocabulary, not an official word-level rating.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Immune unresponsiveness 是较宽泛的“免疫无反应”；immune tolerance 指对特定抗原的免疫耐受，anergy 是形成耐受的一种机制；immunodeficiency 指免疫防御存在缺陷，并不等同于特定细胞或抗原层面的无反应。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Immune unresponsiveness is a broader descriptive term; immune tolerance is nonresponsiveness to a particular antigen, with anergy being one mechanism that can produce it; immunodeficiency concerns defective immune defenses and is not equivalent to cellular or antigen-specific anergy.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: an-＝无，erg＝工作：免疫细胞遇到刺激，却没有启动应有的“工作”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: An- means 'without' and erg means 'work': the immune cell receives a stimulus but does not start its expected work.

senses.meaning_zh: 附属于土地或建筑物的；随地产享有或转移的（法律用语）
senses.meaning_en: legally attached to land or a building as an associated right or accessory
senses.english_definition: A right or feature that is appurtenant to a property belongs with that property as a legal accessory.
senses.collocation_zh: 附属权利；附属于受益土地的地役权
senses.sentence_en: The deed includes the land and all rights appurtenant to it.
senses.sentence_zh: 该契据涵盖这块土地及其全部附属权利。

senses.meaning_zh: 附属的；附带的；从属于某主体的（正式用语）
senses.meaning_en: belonging to or accompanying something as a subordinate or associated part
senses.english_definition: Something appurtenant to another thing belongs with it as an accompanying or subordinate part.
senses.collocation_zh: 附属设施；附属设备
senses.sentence_en: The inspection covered the main building and its appurtenant facilities.
senses.sentence_zh: 此次检查涵盖主楼及其附属设施。

senses.meaning_zh: 附属物；附属权利（少见，主要用于法律或正式语境）
senses.meaning_en: an accessory or right belonging to something else, in uncommon legal or formal usage
senses.english_definition: An appurtenant is something that belongs to another thing as an accessory or associated right.
senses.collocation_zh: 该地产及其附属物或附属权利
senses.sentence_en: The agreement refers to the property and its appurtenants.
senses.sentence_zh: 该协议提及这处地产及其附属物和附属权利。

etymology_story.zh: Appurtenant 经盎格鲁法语进入中古英语，源自表示“属于”的动词的现在分词，其更早词源是拉丁语晚期的 appertinere“属于、涉及”。“属于某主体”的基本概念在财产法中发展为土地、建筑物及其附属权利之间的关系。
etymology_story.en: Appurtenant entered Middle English through Anglo-French as the present participle of a verb meaning 'to belong,' ultimately from Late Latin appertinere, 'to belong or pertain to.' The basic idea of belonging became especially associated with property and its attached rights or accessories.

morphology_enriched.zh: 英语中宜将 appurtenant 视为整体借入词；历史上可分为 appurten-（属于）+ -ant（法语分词词尾），不宜按现代英语的 productive 词缀任意拆分。相关词族包括 appurtenance（附属物、附属权利）、appurtenances（复数，常用）和 appurtenantly（附属地，罕见）；appertain、appertains、appertained、appertaining 是相关动词形式。名词复数为 appurtenants。CEFR-C2 为编辑估级，并非官方单词评级。
morphology_enriched.en: In English, appurtenant is best treated as an established borrowing; historically it contains appurten- 'belong' and the French participial ending -ant, rather than a freely productive modern English formation. Its family includes appurtenance, the frequent plural appurtenances, and rare appurtenantly; related verb forms are appertain, appertains, appertained, and appertaining. The noun plural is appurtenants. CEFR-C2 is an editorial estimate, not an official word-level rating.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 附属义中，accessory 强调补充或辅助作用；ancillary 强调为主要活动提供支持；appurtenant 更强调归属于某主体，法律语境中尤其指附属于地产。名词通常使用 appurtenance，比 appurtenant 更常见。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Accessory emphasizes a supplementary or auxiliary role; ancillary emphasizes support for a principal activity; appurtenant emphasizes belonging to a principal thing, especially property in legal contexts. As a noun, appurtenance is more usual than appurtenant.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“属于”：主体是地产，跟着地产一起享有的权利就是 appurtenant rights。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor it to 'belonging': rights that belong with a property are appurtenant rights.

morphology.text: aqua（水）+ plane（滑行）→ aquaplane（在水面上滑行）；用于车辆时指轮胎隔着水层失去抓地力。

etymology.text: 英语把拉丁语的 aqua“水”与 plane 组合成词，先用于水上滑行运动，后来在英式英语中也用于车辆在积水上的滑行。

senses.meaning_zh: （车辆）因轮胎浮在水层上而打滑、失去抓地力（主要用于英式英语）

senses.meaning_zh: 滑水板，尤指由机动船拖曳、供人站立滑行的宽板

senses.english_definition: An aquaplane is a board that you stand on while a motorboat pulls you across the surface of the water.
senses.collocation_en: ride an aquaplane; tow an aquaplane
senses.collocation_zh: 站在滑水板上滑行；拖曳滑水板
senses.sentence_en: She stood on the aquaplane while the motorboat pulled her across the lake.
senses.sentence_zh: 她站在滑水板上，由机动船拖着滑过湖面。

senses.meaning_zh: 站在由船拖曳的滑水板上滑水

etymology_story.zh: Aquaplane 由 aqua-（源自拉丁语 aqua“水”）和 plane（在水面上滑行）组合而成，早期指由船拖曳的滑水板及相关运动。后来，车辆轮胎在水层上滑行的相似现象也被称为 aquaplaning。
etymology_story.en: Aquaplane combines aqua-, from Latin aqua 'water,' with plane in the sense of skimming over a water surface, and originally referred to a towed board and the activity of riding it. The term was later extended to the similar motion of vehicle tires riding over a layer of water.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：aqua-（水）+ plane（水面滑行）；名词和动词形式相同。词形包括 aquaplanes（名词复数或动词第三人称单数）、aquaplaned、aquaplaning；aquaplaner 可指进行拖板滑水的人，但较少见。Aquaplaning 还常作名词，表示车辆滑水现象或拖板滑水运动。CEFR-C1 为编辑估级，并非官方单词评级。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: aqua- 'water' + plane 'skim over water'; the noun and verb have the same form. Inflections are aquaplanes, aquaplaned, and aquaplaning; the less common aquaplaner denotes someone who rides an aquaplane. Aquaplaning also functions as a noun for the vehicle phenomenon or the water sport. CEFR-C1 is an editorial estimate, not an official word-level rating.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 车辆义中，hydroplane 是常见的美式对应词；skid 泛指轮胎失去抓地力而打滑，不限于积水；水上运动中的 water-ski 指踩着滑水橇滑行，器材通常不同于 aquaplane 所指的宽板。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For vehicles, hydroplane is the usual American equivalent; skid covers loss of tire grip more broadly and does not require water. In water sports, water-ski means riding on water skis, which normally differ from the broad board called an aquaplane.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: aqua＝水，plane＝贴着表面滑行：人可以在水上滑，车轮也可能被水托起而滑。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Aqua means water and plane suggests skimming: a rider skims over water, and a tire can do the same.

senses.meaning_zh: 无规立构的；聚合物重复单元的立体构型无规则排列的
senses.meaning_en: having no regular stereochemical arrangement along a polymer chain
senses.english_definition: An atactic polymer has repeating units whose stereochemical configurations do not follow a regular pattern along the chain.
senses.collocation_zh: 无规立构聚丙烯；无规立构聚苯乙烯
senses.sentence_en: Atactic polypropylene lacks the regular stereochemical arrangement found in isotactic polypropylene.
senses.sentence_zh: 无规立构聚丙烯不具备等规立构聚丙烯所具有的规则立体构型排列。

senses.meaning_zh: 共济失调的；运动协调障碍的（较少见，通常用 ataxic）

senses.sentence_zh: 报告描述了一种共济失调步态，其步伐不规则且协调性差。

etymology_story.zh: Atactic 的历史词源与希腊语 ataktos“无秩序的”有关，由否定成分 a- 和表示“排列、安排”的词根组成。表示缺乏秩序或协调的概念后来用于医学，并在聚合物化学中专指立体构型缺乏规则排列。
etymology_story.en: Atactic is historically connected with Greek ataktos, 'disorderly,' combining negative a- with a root referring to arrangement. The idea of deficient order or coordination acquired medical uses and, in polymer chemistry, a specialized meaning involving irregular stereochemical configurations.

morphology_enriched.zh: 科学构词可分析为 a-（无）+ tactic（与排列有关），此处的 tactic 不是日常名词“策略”。相关形式包括 atacticity（无规立构性）及专业用法 atactically（以无规立构方式）；同一术语体系还有 tacticity（立构规整性）、isotactic（等规立构的）和 syndiotactic（间规立构的）。医学上的 ataxia、ataxic 是相关词，不是由 atactic 直接派生。CEFR-C2 为专业词汇的编辑估级，并非官方单词评级。
morphology_enriched.en: The scientific formation can be analyzed as a- 'without' + tactic 'relating to arrangement'; tactic here is not the everyday noun meaning a strategy. Related forms include atacticity and specialist atactically; the same terminology includes tacticity, isotactic, and syndiotactic. Medical ataxia and ataxic are related words rather than direct derivatives of atactic. CEFR-C2 is an editorial estimate for this specialist vocabulary, not an official word-level rating.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 聚合物语境中，stereoirregular 强调立体构型排列不规则，与 atactic 接近；random 只是一般的“随机”，也可能指共聚单体序列，不能直接替换；医学语境中的 ataxic 更常用于表示共济失调。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: In polymer contexts, stereoirregular is close to atactic because it concerns irregular stereochemical arrangement; random is broader and may instead describe a copolymer's monomer sequence, so it is not automatically interchangeable. In medical contexts, ataxic is the more usual term for impaired coordination.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: a-＝无，tact＝排列：侧基的空间方向没有规则“队形”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A- means 'without' and tact suggests arrangement: the side groups have no regular stereochemical formation.

etymology.text: 中古英语 attaynten 来自盎格鲁法语 ateint，是 ateindre 的过去分词。这个“受到指控、被判定”的词逐渐形成历史法律中的剥夺公权义。

senses.meaning_zh: 【历史法律】因叛国罪或重罪被定罪而剥夺某人的公民权及财产权
senses.meaning_en: Historically, to deprive someone convicted of treason or felony of civil and property rights.
senses.english_definition: If someone was attainted, a conviction or legislative act deprived them of civil rights and normally caused their property to be forfeited.
senses.collocation_en: be attainted of treason; attainted by Parliament
senses.collocation_zh: 因叛国罪被剥夺公民权及财产权；被议会宣布剥夺公民权及财产权
senses.sentence_en: He was attainted of treason, and his estates were forfeited to the Crown.
senses.sentence_zh: 他因叛国罪被剥夺公民权及财产权，其地产被王室没收。

etymology_story.zh: 源自中古英语，借自盎格鲁法语 ateint，即 ateindre“达到；指控；定罪”的过去分词，最终可追溯至拉丁语 attingere“触及”。词义由指控、定罪发展为历史法律中定罪后剥夺权利及没收财产的含义。
etymology_story.en: The word entered Middle English from Anglo-French ateint, the past participle of ateindre, meaning to reach, accuse, or convict, ultimately from Latin attingere, meaning to touch. Its legal meaning developed from conviction to the loss of rights and forfeiture associated with that conviction.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可再作有效拆分的借入词：attaint；不能按 at + taint 推导法律义。屈折形式为 attaints、attainted、attainting；相关历史法律名词有 attainder“剥夺公民权及财产权”，另有罕用的 attaintment“剥夺权利；污损”。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, attaint is an unanalyzed borrowed base; its legal meaning cannot be derived from at + taint. Inflected forms are attaints, attainted, and attainting; related nouns include the historical legal term attainder and the rare attaintment, meaning attainder or dishonour.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: convict“判定有罪”侧重有罪裁决；disenfranchise“剥夺选举权或其他公民权”侧重权利丧失；outlaw“宣布为不受法律保护者”侧重法律保护的丧失。attaint 特指历史上与叛国罪或重罪定罪相连的权利剥夺及财产没收，三者都不是完全对应词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Convict emphasizes a finding of guilt; disenfranchise emphasizes the removal of voting or other civic rights; outlaw emphasizes exclusion from legal protection. Attaint specifically denotes the historical loss of rights and forfeiture associated with conviction for treason or felony, so none is an exact equivalent.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 历史词源“触及”→法律裁决落到某人身上→权利与财产被剥夺；这是记忆链，不是现代构词拆分。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Historical 'touching' → the judgment reaches a person → rights and property are lost; this is a memory chain, not a modern morphological breakdown.

senses.meaning_en: Relating to the ocean zone typically about 200–2,000 metres deep, along the continental slope.
senses.english_definition: Bathyal environments and organisms occur in the deep ocean zone along the continental slope, typically between about 200 and 2,000 metres below the surface.

etymology_story.zh: 以希腊语 bathys“深的”为基础，加形容词后缀 -al 构成科学术语。它由一般的“深”专门化为海洋学中大陆坡半深海环境的名称，其具体深度界限因分类体系而异。
etymology_story.en: The term was formed from Greek bathys, meaning deep, with the adjectival suffix -al. The general idea of depth became a technical designation for continental-slope environments, whose precise depth limits vary between classification systems.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：bathy-／bath-（深）+ -al（……的）→ bathyal。相关科学构词词族包括 bathymetry“水深测量”、bathymetric“水深测量的”、bathyscaphe“深海潜水器”和 bathypelagic“深海中层的”；这些是共享词根的词，并非都由 bathyal 派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: bathy-/bath- (deep) + -al (relating to) → bathyal. The wider scientific root family includes bathymetry, bathymetric, bathyscaphe, and bathypelagic; these share a root rather than all being derivatives of bathyal.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: deep-sea“深海的”范围较宽；abyssal“深海底带的”通常指比半深海带更深的区域；bathypelagic“深海中层的”描述水体中的深度带。bathyal 常用于大陆坡及其海底环境，不能与这些近义或相关术语任意互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Deep-sea is a broad description; abyssal usually denotes a deeper ocean region; bathypelagic describes a depth zone within the water column. Bathyal commonly concerns the continental slope and its seabed environments, so these related terms are not freely interchangeable.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: bathy-＝深：沿大陆架边缘向下走，进入大陆坡的半深海带。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Bathy- means deep: follow the seabed down beyond the continental shelf into the bathyal slope zone.

senses.meaning_zh: 【英国饮食】轻腌轻熏、通常未经剖腹去内脏的整条鲱鱼
senses.meaning_en: A lightly salted and smoked whole herring, traditionally left ungutted.
senses.english_definition: A bloater is a whole herring that has been lightly salted and smoked, traditionally without having its insides removed.
senses.collocation_zh: 雅茅斯熏鲱鱼；熏鲱鱼酱
senses.sentence_en: The shop sold bloaters alongside kippers and smoked haddock.

etymology_story.zh: 来自旧动词 bloat“轻腌或熏制鱼”，加上名词后缀 -er。这个鱼类加工用动词的更早来源并不确定，因此不能仅凭现代 bloat“胀大”的意思推断这种食品的名称。
etymology_story.en: Bloater comes from an older verb bloat, meaning to salt or smoke fish lightly, with the noun-forming suffix -er. The earlier origin of that curing verb is uncertain, so the food name should not be explained solely through the modern meaning of becoming swollen.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：bloat（旧义：轻腌、熏制鱼）+ -er（表示加工所得之物）→ bloater；复数为 bloaters。相关复合表达包括 bloater paste“熏鲱鱼酱”；现代常见的 bloated“肿胀的；臃肿的”和 bloating“腹胀”属于 bloat 的肿胀义用法，不宜与食品义混同。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: bloat (older fish-curing sense) + -er (a resulting product) → bloater; the plural is bloaters. A related compound is bloater paste; modern bloated and bloating belong to the swelling sense of bloat and should be distinguished from the food term.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: smoked herring“熏鲱鱼”是上位称呼；kipper“剖开熏鲱鱼”通常已剖开并去内脏；red herring“重腌重熏鲱鱼”通常腌熏程度更重。bloater 特指通常保持整条、未经去内脏而轻腌轻熏的鲱鱼。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Smoked herring is the broader category; a kipper is normally split and gutted before smoking; a red herring is more heavily salted and smoked. A bloater is distinguished by its light cure and its traditionally whole, ungutted preparation.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把旧义 bloat 锚定为“熏鱼”：bloater＝整条轻熏鲱鱼。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor the older bloat to fish curing: a bloater is a whole, lightly smoked herring.

etymology_story.zh: 借自意大利语 cantabile“可歌唱的；适宜歌唱的”，可追溯至晚期拉丁语 cantabilis，源于拉丁语 cantare“唱歌”。它作为演奏术语进入英语后，表示使器乐旋律呈现人声歌唱般的流畅和表现力，也可指具有这种风格的乐段。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Italian cantabile, meaning singable or suitable for singing, ultimately from Late Latin cantabilis and Latin cantare, meaning to sing. As a performance term, it came to describe instrumental music shaped like expressive singing and, as a noun, a passage in that style.

morphology_enriched.zh: 在现代英语中通常作为完整的意大利语借词使用；在源语言中可分析为 cant-（唱）+ -abile（可……的）。名词复数可用 cantabiles，亦见意大利语形式 cantabili；同源词包括 cantata“康塔塔”和 canto“长诗的一篇”，它们并非由英语 cantabile 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English generally treats cantabile as a complete Italian borrowing; in its source language it can be analyzed as cant- (sing) + -abile (capable of being). Noun plurals include cantabiles and Italian cantabili; cognates include cantata and canto, neither of which is a direct English derivative of cantabile.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: songlike“如歌的”最直接描述歌唱般的性质；lyrical“抒情的”强调情感表达；legato“连贯的；连贯地”强调音与音之间衔接平滑。cantabile 要求整体旋律像人声歌唱，通常涉及连贯处理，但不等同于单纯的 legato。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Songlike directly describes resemblance to singing; lyrical emphasizes expressive feeling; legato specifies smooth connections between notes. Cantabile asks for an overall vocal quality, which often involves legato but also requires expressive phrasing.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: cant-＝唱：让乐器“唱出来”，就是 cantabile。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Cant- means sing: make the instrument sing, and you have cantabile.

senses.meaning_zh: 【音乐】恰空舞曲；通常在反复的和声进行或低音基础上展开变奏的三拍子乐曲
senses.meaning_en: A usually triple-metre composition featuring variations over a recurring harmonic pattern or bass.
senses.english_definition: A chaconne is a piece of music, usually in triple metre, in which a recurring sequence of harmonies or bass notes supports a series of variations.
senses.collocation_en: Bach's Chaconne; a chaconne for solo violin
senses.collocation_zh: 巴赫的《恰空》；为小提琴独奏而作的恰空舞曲

senses.meaning_zh: 【舞蹈史】恰空舞；一种与早期恰空音乐相伴的舞蹈
senses.meaning_en: A historical dance associated with early chaconne music.
senses.english_definition: A chaconne is also a historical dance performed to the kind of music from which the later instrumental form developed.
senses.collocation_en: dance a chaconne; a court chaconne

etymology_story.zh: 英语经法语 chaconne 借自西班牙语 chacona，其更早词源并不确定。它最初指舞蹈及其伴奏音乐，后来在巴洛克音乐中发展为以反复和声或低音为基础的器乐变奏形式。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed French chaconne from Spanish chacona, whose earlier origin is uncertain. Originally a name for a dance and its accompanying music, it later developed into a Baroque instrumental variation form built on recurring harmonies or a recurring bass.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可有效拆分的借入词：chaconne；复数为 chaconnes。没有常用的直接派生词；chaconne-like“类似恰空舞曲的”是可临时构成的描述形式，chacona 则是西班牙语来源形式。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, chaconne is an unanalyzed borrowing; its plural is chaconnes. It has no common direct derivatives; chaconne-like is a possible descriptive formation, while chacona is its Spanish source form.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: passacaglia“帕萨卡利亚舞曲”是最接近的相关形式，两者在历史用法中经常重叠；ground-bass variations“固定低音变奏曲”明确强调低音反复；variation set“变奏曲集”范围更宽，不必具有恰空常见的拍子或反复模式。它们都不能在所有语境下直接替换 chaconne。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Passacaglia is the closest related form, and historical usage often overlaps with chaconne; ground-bass variations specifically emphasize a repeated bass; a variation set is broader and need not have a chaconne's typical metre or recurring pattern. None is interchangeable with chaconne in every context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 同一和声骨架反复，表层旋律不断变化：抓住“反复基础上的变奏”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: The harmonic framework returns while the musical surface changes: remember variations over a recurring foundation.

forms: demits；demitted；demitting，后两项双写 t。
family: demission 辞职；resign 辞职

morphology.text: 从拉丁语词根理解：de-（向下、离开）+ mittere（送、放）→ demittere（放下），经法语和中古英语演变为 demit。

etymology.text: 中古英语 dimitten 从盎格鲁法语 demettre 借入，远源是拉丁语 demittere“放下、放开”。把职位放下，便容易记住正式的辞职义。

usage_note: 正式且较少见，可说 demit office；也可不及物地表示退出职务或团体。日常谈辞职更常用 resign。
sentence: He decided to demit office at the end of the year.
translation: 他决定在年底辞去职务。

teaching.contrast: 正式且较少见，可说 demit office；也可不及物地表示退出职务或团体。日常谈辞职更常用 resign。

senses.meaning_zh: 辞去职务；退出组织（正式用语，部分地区常用）
senses.meaning_en: To resign from an office or withdraw from membership, in formal or regional usage.
senses.english_definition: If someone demits office or demits from an organization, they formally give up their position or membership.
senses.collocation_en: demit office; demit from a lodge
senses.collocation_zh: 离任；退出共济会分会
senses.sentence_en: She will demit office when her successor takes over.
senses.sentence_zh: 她将在继任者接任时离任。

senses.meaning_zh: 正式退会证明，尤指共济会的退会证明（专门用语）
senses.meaning_en: A certificate confirming honorable withdrawal from an organization, especially a Masonic lodge.
senses.english_definition: A demit is a document confirming that someone has formally left an organization while remaining in good standing.
senses.collocation_en: request a demit; grant a demit
senses.collocation_zh: 申请退会证明；批准并签发退会证明
senses.sentence_en: The lodge granted him a demit before he moved abroad.
senses.sentence_zh: 他移居国外前，分会批准了他的退会申请并签发了证明。

etymology_story.zh: 经中古英语和盎格鲁法语 demettre 等形式传入，远源涉及拉丁语 demittere“放下、送下”，部分意义也受到 dimittere“遣走、解除”的影响，后来用于辞职和退出组织。名词义指正式退会的证明文件。[词源及义项来源：Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/demit)
etymology_story.en: The word entered through Middle English and Anglo-French forms such as demettre, ultimately involving Latin demittere, meaning to send down, with some senses influenced by dimittere, meaning to send away or discharge. It developed resignation and withdrawal meanings, including a noun for the accompanying certificate. [Source: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/demit)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语通常把 demit 作为整体动词处理；历史上可联系 de-（向下）与拉丁语 mittere（送），但不能把它分析为现代英语 de- + 独立词 mit。屈折形式：demits、demitted、demitting；相关名词 demission（辞职，罕见）；名词 demit 的复数为 demits，退会证明义也拼作 dimit。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English generally treats demit as a whole borrowed verb; historically it connects de- with Latin mittere, meaning to send, rather than containing an independent English word mit. Inflections: demits, demitted, demitting; related noun: demission, a rare term for resignation; the certificate noun has plural demits and the alternative spelling dimit.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: resign（辞职）是最通用的对应词；relinquish（放弃、交出）强调主动放手，宾语范围更广；withdraw（退出）强调离开组织或活动。demit 更正式且具有地域或组织用语色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Resign is the usual general equivalent; relinquish emphasizes giving something up and takes a wider range of objects; withdraw emphasizes leaving a group or activity. Demit is more formal and is associated with particular regions or organizations.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把职位“放下”，就是正式离任；退会时拿到的证明，也叫 demit。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture putting an office down: you leave the position, and a withdrawal certificate can also be a demit.

forms: dewaxes；dewaxed；dewaxing。
family: dewaxing 脱蜡；dewaxable 可脱蜡的

morphology.text: de-（去除）+ wax（蜡）→ dewax（脱蜡）；dewax + -able → dewaxable（可脱蜡的）。

etymology.text: 是英语中的前缀造词：表示去除的 de- 加 wax；wax 是来自古英语 weax 的本土词。先想到把蜡去掉，再理解工业中的“脱蜡”。

usage_note: 及物动词，后接需要去蜡的物品；工业中常指从油品中除去石蜡，实验室也可指去除样本上的蜡。
sentence: The refinery uses a cooling process to dewax the oil.
translation: 炼油厂用冷却工艺给油品脱蜡。

teaching.contrast: 及物动词，后接需要去蜡的物品；工业中常指从油品中除去石蜡，实验室也可指去除样本上的蜡。

senses.meaning_zh: 除蜡；去除表面或材料中的蜡
senses.meaning_en: To remove wax from a surface or material.
senses.english_definition: If you dewax something, you remove the wax covering it or contained in it.
senses.collocation_en: dewax tissue sections; dewax a surface
senses.collocation_zh: 给组织切片脱蜡；去除表面的蜡
senses.sentence_en: The technician dewaxed the tissue sections before staining them.
senses.sentence_zh: 技术员先给组织切片脱蜡，再进行染色。

senses.meaning_zh: 给油品脱蜡；从油中去除石蜡（工业用语）
senses.meaning_en: To remove paraffin wax from oil during processing.
senses.english_definition: When a refinery dewaxes oil, it removes wax that could make the oil flow poorly at low temperatures.
senses.collocation_en: dewax lubricating oil; dewax base oil
senses.collocation_zh: 给润滑油脱蜡；给基础油脱蜡
senses.sentence_en: The refinery dewaxes the oil to improve its flow at low temperatures.
senses.sentence_zh: 炼油厂给油品脱蜡，以改善其低温流动性。

etymology_story.zh: 这是英语内部形成的动词，由表示“去除”的 de- 加名词 wax“蜡”构成；wax 本身可追溯到古英语 weax。其字面意义是“去掉蜡”，在炼油中专指从油品中去除石蜡。[构词及工业义来源：Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/dewax)
etymology_story.en: This verb was formed within English by adding the removal prefix de- to the noun wax, which goes back to Old English weax. Its literal meaning is removing wax, with a specialized refining use for removing paraffin wax from oil. [Formation and refining sense: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/dewax)

morphology_enriched.zh: de-（去除）+ wax（蜡）→ dewax。屈折形式：dewaxes、dewaxed、dewaxing；直接衍生词：dewaxing（脱蜡过程）、dewaxer（脱蜡设备或制剂）、dewaxable（可脱蜡的）。基础词 wax 的主要相关词有 waxy（蜡状的）、waxiness（蜡质特性）、waxed（上蜡的）、waxing（上蜡）、waxless（无蜡的）和 rewax（重新上蜡）。
morphology_enriched.en: de- meaning removal + wax → dewax. Inflections: dewaxes, dewaxed, dewaxing; direct derivatives: dewaxing, the removal process; dewaxer, a removal device or preparation; dewaxable, capable of being dewaxed. The base wax also has waxy, waxiness, waxed, waxing, waxless, and rewax.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: remove wax（去除蜡）是通俗释义；deparaffinize（脱石蜡）专指去除石蜡，常见于组织学；strip（剥除）可指去除蜡层或其他涂层，范围更广。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Remove wax is the plain-language equivalent; deparaffinize specifically concerns paraffin removal and is common in histology; strip can mean removing wax or other coatings and is therefore broader.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: de- 表示“去掉”：wax 是蜡，dewax 就是去蜡。
mnemonic_anchor.en: de- takes something away: wax goes on, and dewax takes it off.

forms: 可数名词，复数 donnybrooks；也见 Donnybrook。
family: donnybrook-like 像群殴般混乱的（-like 类比派生）

morphology.text: 整词作为独立词素记忆。donnybrook + -like（像……的）→ donnybrook-like（像混战般的）；不要把地名误拆成普通词根。

senses.meaning_zh: 群殴；多人参与的混战（非正式用语）
senses.meaning_en: A noisy, disorderly fight involving several people.
senses.english_definition: A donnybrook is a confused and noisy fight in which several people take part.
senses.collocation_en: a full-scale donnybrook; a donnybrook breaks out
senses.collocation_zh: 一场大规模混战；爆发群殴
senses.sentence_en: A donnybrook broke out among the spectators after the match.
senses.sentence_zh: 比赛结束后，观众中爆发了一场群殴。

senses.meaning_zh: 激烈的公开争吵；混乱的争论（非正式用语）
senses.meaning_en: A heated, disorderly argument or public dispute.
senses.english_definition: If a disagreement becomes a donnybrook, it turns into a noisy and angry argument, often in public.
senses.collocation_en: a political donnybrook; a donnybrook over something
senses.collocation_zh: 一场政治争吵；围绕某事的激烈争论
senses.sentence_en: The budget proposal sparked a donnybrook at the council meeting.
senses.sentence_zh: 这项预算提案在议会会议上引发了激烈争吵。

etymology_story.zh: 来自爱尔兰都柏林附近 Donnybrook 的年度集市名称，该集市因喧闹和斗殴而闻名。19世纪中叶，地名转为普通名词，先指多人混战，也用于激烈的公开争论。[来源：Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/donnybrook)
etymology_story.en: The word comes from the annual fair at Donnybrook near Dublin, Ireland, which became notorious for noisy disorder and fighting. In the mid-nineteenth century, the place name became a common noun for a brawl and also came to describe a heated public dispute. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/donnybrook)

morphology_enriched.zh: Donnybrook（地名）→ donnybrook（普通名词），属于专名普通名词化；现代英语中作为整体词基处理，不宜按普通英语词根拆解。复数为 donnybrooks；没有常用的固定派生词族，donnybrook-like 只能算临时组成的“像混战般的”。
morphology_enriched.en: Donnybrook, a place name, became donnybrook, a common noun, through conversion of a proper name. Modern English treats it as a whole base rather than a transparent combination of ordinary roots. The plural is donnybrooks; there is no established common derivative family, although donnybrook-like can be coined when needed.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: brawl（斗殴）强调喧闹的肢体冲突；free-for-all（乱斗、混战）强调众人无序参与，也可用于争论；fracas（喧闹冲突）强调突发的吵闹场面。donnybrook 可兼指群殴和激烈争吵。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Brawl emphasizes noisy physical fighting; free-for-all emphasizes uncontrolled participation by many people and can also describe an argument; fracas emphasizes a sudden noisy disturbance. Donnybrook can refer to either a group fight or an angry dispute.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 记住“以打架出名的集市”：集市乱成一团，便是 donnybrook。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember the fair famous for fighting: its name became the word for the resulting chaos.

forms: 可数名词，复数 dosserets。
family: dosser 法语来源相关的背靠、支承构件名

morphology.text: 沿法语来源理解：dosser-（背靠、支撑的词干）+ -et（小型词尾）→ dosseret（小支承构件）；英语整词作为建筑名词记忆。

etymology_story.zh: 19世纪借自法语 dosseret，是 dossier 的指小形式，与 dos“背部”所属词族有关。英语将它用作建筑术语，指柱头上承托拱的附加垫块或加厚顶板。[来源：Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/dosseret)
etymology_story.en: English borrowed dosseret from French in the nineteenth century as a diminutive of dossier, belonging to the family of dos, meaning back. In English it became an architectural term for an additional block or thickened abacus above a column capital. [Source: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/dosseret)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语把 dosseret 作为不可自由拆分的借词词基；历史上的法语构词关系为 dossier + 指小后缀 -et，并发生词干调整。英语复数为 dosserets；没有常用的英语派生词族，不能把法语构词成分当作现代英语中的独立词根和后缀。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats dosseret as an unanalyzed borrowed base. Historically, the French formation involves dossier plus the diminutive suffix -et, with stem adjustment. Its English plural is dosserets; it has no established common English derivative family, and its French components are not productive English building blocks.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: impost block（承拱垫块）是最接近的对应术语；abacus（柱头顶板）通常是柱头顶部的板状构件；capital（柱头）指柱顶的整个构件。dosseret 特指柱头上方的附加承拱块或加厚顶板。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Impost block is the closest equivalent; abacus usually denotes the slab at the top of a capital; capital denotes the whole head of a column. Dosseret specifically identifies an additional supporting block or thickened abacus above the capital.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 联想“给拱托背的小垫块”：位置在柱头与拱之间。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a small backing support for an arch, sitting between the capital and the arch.

senses.meaning_zh: 测功机，尤指发动机或车辆测功机（行业口语）
senses.meaning_en: A dynamometer, especially one used to measure engine or vehicle power.

senses.meaning_zh: 用测功机测试发动机或车辆（行业口语）
senses.meaning_en: To test an engine or vehicle using a dynamometer.
senses.english_definition: If you dyno a vehicle, you use a dynamometer to measure its power output.
senses.collocation_en: dyno a car; dyno an engine
senses.collocation_zh: 给汽车做测功测试；给发动机做测功测试

senses.meaning_zh: 动态跳跃抓点；飞跃抓点动作（攀岩术语）
senses.meaning_en: An explosive climbing move in which a climber jumps to reach a hold.
senses.english_definition: A dyno is a climbing move in which you jump away from your existing footholds to catch another hold.
senses.collocation_en: a double dyno; stick a dyno
senses.collocation_zh: 双手同时跃抓的动态动作；成功完成并稳住一次动态跳跃抓点

senses.english_definition: If you dyno to a hold, you use an explosive jump to reach and catch it.
senses.collocation_en: dyno to a hold; dyno for the next hold
senses.collocation_zh: 动态跳跃抓住一个攀岩点；跃向下一个攀岩点

etymology_story.zh: 测功机义是 dynamometer 的口语缩略形式，而攀岩义通常解释为 dynamic 或 dynamic move 的缩略表达；两条路径都与表示“力量”的希腊语 dynamis 有关。两种名词又分别发展出“做测功测试”和“跳跃抓点”的动词用法。[测功机词源：Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/dyno)；[名词及攀岩动词：WordWeb](https://www.wordwebonline.com/en/DYNO)；[汽车动词用例：TrackDyno](https://trackdynoapp.com/)
etymology_story.en: The machine sense is an informal shortening of dynamometer, while the climbing sense is generally explained as a shortening of dynamic or dynamic move; both ultimately connect with Greek dynamis, meaning power. The nouns also developed corresponding verb uses for power testing and jumping to a hold. [Machine origin: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/dyno); [noun and climbing verb uses: WordWeb](https://www.wordwebonline.com/en/DYNO); [automotive verb example: TrackDyno](https://trackdynoapp.com/)

morphology_enriched.zh: 属于缩略构词：dynamometer → dyno（测功机），dynamic／dynamic move → dyno（攀岩动作）；-o 是缩略形式的结尾，不表示“测量”。名词转为动词后仍写作 dyno；复数及第三人称单数为 dynos，过去式和过去分词常写 dynoed 或 dyno'd，现在分词为 dynoing。相关完整词有 dynamometer（测功机）、dynamometry（测力或测功）、dynamic（动态的）、dynamically（动态地）和 dynamics（动力学；动态关系），这些不是由 dyno 直接派生的。
morphology_enriched.en: The formation is shortening: dynamometer → dyno for the machine, and dynamic or dynamic move → dyno for the climbing action; final -o does not mean measurement. Conversion produces the corresponding verbs. The plural and third-person singular are dynos; past forms commonly appear as dynoed or dyno'd, and the present participle is dynoing. Related full forms include dynamometer, dynamometry, dynamic, dynamically, and dynamics; these are not direct derivatives of dyno.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: dynamometer（测功机、测力计）是设备义的正式名称，适用范围更广；dynamic move（动态动作）是攀岩中的上位表达，并非每个动态动作都是 dyno；leap（跳跃）只说明腾跃动作，不专指抓住攀岩点。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Dynamometer is the formal equipment term and has broader measurement applications; dynamic move is a broader climbing expression, since not every dynamic move is a dyno; leap describes the jump itself without specifically implying that a climbing hold is caught.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“力量”这条线：机器测动力，攀岩用爆发力；名词也能转为相应动作。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Follow the idea of power: a machine measures it, a climber uses it explosively, and each noun can become a verb.

senses.meaning_zh: 擦剂；涂擦于皮肤以缓解肌肉或关节疼痛的药液
senses.meaning_en: A medicinal liquid rubbed onto the skin to relieve muscular or joint pain.
senses.english_definition: An embrocation is a liquid medicine that you rub onto your skin to relieve pain in your muscles or joints.
senses.collocation_en: apply an embrocation; a warming embrocation
senses.collocation_zh: 涂擦药液；温热型擦剂
senses.sentence_en: He rubbed an embrocation into his aching shoulder.
senses.sentence_zh: 他把擦剂涂在酸痛的肩膀上并加以揉擦。

etymology_story.zh: 该词经中古拉丁语 embrocation- 进入英语，最终源于与“润湿、敷洗”有关的希腊语词，和 brekhein“弄湿”同源。其含义由施用药液的行为发展为所使用的外用药液。
etymology_story.en: The word entered English through medieval Latin embrocation-, ultimately from Greek words associated with moistening or applying a lotion, related to brekhein, meaning “to wet.” Its meaning extended from applying medicinal liquid to the liquid itself.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词关系为 embrocate（涂擦药液，去末尾 e）+ -ion（行为或产物名词后缀）→ embrocation。相关形式有 embrocate、embrocates、embrocated、embrocating，以及名词复数 embrocations；动词 embrocate 在现代英语中较少见。
morphology_enriched.en: The formation is embrocate, with final e removed, + -ion, forming a noun for an action or its product. Related forms are embrocate, embrocates, embrocated, embrocating, and the plural embrocations; the verb embrocate is uncommon in modern English.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: liniment（擦剂）最接近，通常也通过揉擦施用；rub（外用涂擦药）更口语化，可指液体或膏状制剂；lotion（洗剂、乳液）范围更广，不一定用于止痛。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Liniment is the closest equivalent and is also usually applied by rubbing; rub is more informal and can describe a liquid or cream; lotion is broader and need not be intended for pain relief.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 词源核心是“润湿”：用药液润湿并揉擦疼痛处 → 擦剂。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with the historical idea of wetting: wet and rub a sore area with medicine → embrocation.

senses.meaning_zh: 萤石；主要成分为氟化钙的矿物
senses.meaning_en: The mineral calcium fluoride, especially when considered as an industrial raw material.
senses.english_definition: Fluorspar is a mineral consisting of calcium fluoride that is used in industry, especially to make chemicals and help materials melt during metal production.
senses.collocation_zh: 萤石矿床；萤石生产
senses.sentence_en: The mine supplies fluorspar to chemical manufacturers.
senses.sentence_zh: 这座矿山向化学品制造商供应萤石。

etymology_story.zh: 该词由 fluor 与 spar 组成：fluor 是萤石的旧称，源自拉丁语 fluor“流动”，与萤石在冶炼中充当助熔剂的用途有关；spar 是日耳曼语来源的晶质矿物名称成分。因此，其命名逻辑是“帮助熔料流动的晶石”。
etymology_story.en: The word combines fluor, an older name for the mineral derived from Latin fluor, meaning “flow,” with spar, a mineral term of Germanic origin. The reference to flow reflects its use as a flux in metalworking.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词可分析为 fluor（萤石的旧称）+ spar（晶石）→ fluorspar，属于复合名词，通常作不可数名词。没有常用的直接派生词；fluorite（萤石）、fluorine（氟）和 fluoride（氟化物）属于相关术语，并非都由 fluorspar 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: fluor, an older mineral name, + spar, a crystalline mineral, → fluorspar, a compound noun normally used as a mass noun. It has no common direct derivatives; fluorite, fluorine, and fluoride are related terms rather than direct derivatives of fluorspar.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: fluorite（萤石）是同一矿物的标准矿物学名称，fluorspar 更常见于工业和贸易语境；calcium fluoride（氟化钙）强调化学成分，也可指人工制得的化合物，不一定指天然矿物。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Fluorite is the standard mineralogical name for the same mineral, while fluorspar is especially common in industry and trade. Calcium fluoride identifies the chemical substance and can also refer to manufactured material rather than a natural mineral.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: fluor 联想 flow“流动”，spar 是“晶石”：让熔料更易流动的晶石 → 萤石。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect fluor with flow and spar with a crystalline mineral: the mineral that helps molten material flow → fluorspar.

senses.meaning_en: The anion of formic acid, or a salt or ester of that acid.
senses.english_definition: A formate is a salt or ester of formic acid, and formate also names the negatively charged ion produced when formic acid loses a proton.

senses.sentence_en: Sodium formate dissolves readily in water.

etymology_story.zh: formate 由 formic acid“甲酸”的词干加化学命名后缀 -ate 构成。formic 最终源于拉丁语 formica“蚂蚁”，因为甲酸早期曾从蚂蚁中提取。
etymology_story.en: Formate was formed from the stem of formic acid with the chemical suffix -ate. Formic ultimately comes from Latin formica, meaning “ant,” because formic acid was historically obtained from ants.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词为 form-（此处取自 formic acid，与普通词 form“形式”无关）+ -ate（此处表示酸根、盐或酯）→ formate。复数为 formates；相关化学词有 formic acid（甲酸）和 formyl（甲酰基），系统命名对应词为 methanoate（甲酸根、甲酸盐或甲酸酯）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: form-, taken from formic acid and unrelated here to the ordinary word form, + -ate, denoting the anion, salt, or ester, → formate. The plural is formates; related chemical terms include formic acid and formyl, while methanoate is the systematic naming equivalent.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: methanoate（甲酸根、甲酸盐或甲酸酯）是系统命名中的对应名称；formate ion（甲酸根离子）专指 HCOO⁻；formic acid salt（甲酸盐）只涵盖盐，不包括甲酸酯，因此适用范围较窄。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Methanoate is the systematic naming equivalent; formate ion refers specifically to HCOO⁻; formic acid salt covers salts only and therefore excludes formate esters.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 蚂蚁 formica → 甲酸 formic acid → 换上 -ate，得到甲酸根、甲酸盐或甲酸酯。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Ant, formica → formic acid → the -ate ending gives its anion, salts, or esters.

senses.meaning_en: Usually plural: Louisiana-style slices of meat cooked in gravy.
senses.english_definition: In Louisiana cooking, grillades are slices of beef, veal, or pork that are browned and then cooked slowly in gravy, often served with grits.

etymology_story.zh: 该词借自法语 grillade，源于 griller“烤”，原指烤制的肉或烤肉菜肴。在路易斯安那烹饪中，复数 grillades 形成了地方特色义，指通常先煎上色再用浓汁焖煮的肉片。
etymology_story.en: The word was borrowed from French grillade, derived from griller, meaning “to grill,” and originally referred to grilled meat or a grilled dish. In Louisiana cooking, the plural grillades developed a regional meaning for meat slices typically browned and then braised in gravy.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语通常将 grillade 作为完整借词使用；若按法语来源分析，则为 grill-（烤）+ -ade（构成行为或产物名词的后缀）。常见词形为 grillade 和 grillades；英语 grill、grilled、grilling、griller 是相关词，不是由 grillade 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, grillade is normally treated as a whole borrowed word; its French structure is grill-, referring to grilling, + -ade, a noun-forming suffix. Its usual forms are grillade and grillades; grill, grilled, grilling, and griller are related English forms, not direct derivatives of grillade.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: grilled meat（烤肉）对应一般义，但不能准确概括路易斯安那的焖肉义；braised meat（焖肉）更接近地方菜的烹饪方式，却不限定肉片或调味；escalope（薄肉片）强调切片形态，不限定烹调方法。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Grilled meat matches the general meaning but does not accurately describe the Louisiana dish; braised meat better describes that dish's cooking method without specifying its cuts or seasoning; escalope emphasizes a thin slice of meat rather than a particular cooking method.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 看到 grill 想到烤架上的肉；再记住地方例外：路易斯安那的 grillades 常是浓汁焖肉片。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Let grill suggest meat on a grill; then remember the regional development: Louisiana grillades are usually meat slices braised in gravy.

senses.meaning_zh: 杂交瘤细胞；通常由产抗体的 B 淋巴细胞与骨髓瘤细胞融合形成、可持续增殖并分泌抗体的细胞或细胞系
senses.meaning_en: A continuously growing, antibody-producing hybrid cell or cell line, typically formed by fusing a B lymphocyte with a myeloma cell.
senses.english_definition: A hybridoma is a cell made by joining an antibody-producing immune cell with a myeloma cell so that it can keep dividing and produce a particular antibody.
senses.collocation_zh: 杂交瘤细胞系；杂交瘤技术
senses.sentence_en: The researchers selected a hybridoma that produced the antibody they needed.
senses.sentence_zh: 研究人员筛选出了一种能够产生所需抗体的杂交瘤细胞。

etymology_story.zh: hybridoma 是二十世纪生物医学英语中的造词，将 hybrid“杂交体”与 myeloma“骨髓瘤”的末尾成分结合。这个名称体现了细胞融合的双重来源：免疫细胞提供产生特定抗体的能力，骨髓瘤细胞提供持续增殖的能力。
etymology_story.en: Hybridoma was coined in twentieth-century biomedical English by combining hybrid with the ending of myeloma. The name reflects the fused cells' complementary contributions: specific antibody production from the immune cell and sustained growth from the myeloma cell.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词为 hybrid（杂交体）+ -oma（此处取自 myeloma“骨髓瘤”）→ hybridoma，属于融合式造词。复数为 hybridomas；常见组合有 hybridoma-derived（杂交瘤来源的）和 hybridoma-producing（产生杂交瘤的）；hybrid、hybridize、hybridization 属于基础词 hybrid 的相关词族。
morphology_enriched.en: The formation is hybrid + -oma, taken here from myeloma, → hybridoma, a blended formation. Its plural is hybridomas; combinations include hybridoma-derived and hybridoma-producing, while hybrid, hybridize, and hybridization belong to the related family of the base hybrid.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: antibody-producing hybrid cell（产抗体杂交细胞）是接近的解释性表达；hybrid cell（杂交细胞）范围更广，不一定产生抗体；antibody-secreting cell（抗体分泌细胞）强调功能，也包括并非通过细胞融合产生的细胞。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Antibody-producing hybrid cell is a close descriptive equivalent; hybrid cell is broader and need not produce antibodies; antibody-secreting cell describes a function and also includes cells that were not created by fusion.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: hybrid 记“融合”，myeloma 记“持续增殖”：把产抗体能力与持续增殖能力合到一个细胞里。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Hybrid supplies the fusion idea; myeloma supplies sustained growth: combine antibody production and continued division in one cell.

meaning: 抵押而不转移占有或所有权
forms: hypothecates；hypothecated；hypothecating，后两项去末尾 e。
family: hypothecation 抵押；hypothecator 抵押人

morphology.text: hypothec-（抵押）+ -ate（动词词尾）→ hypothecate（设定抵押）；hypothecate 去 e + -ion → hypothecation。

etymology.text: 来自中古拉丁语 hypothecare“抵押”，远源是希腊语 hypothēkē“抵押物”，与“放在下面、放作担保”有关。想象给借款垫上担保物。

usage_note: 金融、法律中的正式及物动词，指以财产担保但不交出所有权或占有；另有“假设”义，本课不取该义。

senses.meaning_en: to pledge property as security without transferring possession or ownership
senses.english_definition: If you hypothecate property, you use it as security for a debt while keeping possession and ownership of it.

senses.meaning_zh: 将税收等收入指定用于特定用途
senses.meaning_en: to earmark revenue for a specified purpose

senses.pos: v. 动词（及物或不及物；少见的正式用法）
senses.meaning_zh: 提出假设；为论证而假定
senses.meaning_en: to hypothesize or assume something for the sake of argument
senses.english_definition: If you hypothecate that something is true, you suggest it as a possible explanation or assume it for discussion.
senses.collocation_zh: 假设……；假定存在某种关系

senses.sentence_zh: 研究人员提出假设，认为温度会影响反应速率。

etymology_story.zh: 抵押义来自中古拉丁语 hypothecare，最终源于希腊语 hypothēkē，表示抵押或担保，背后的动词意为“放在下面”。“提出假设”是后来形成的同形动词，也关联希腊语中“假定”的概念，并非由抵押义直接演变而来。[词源与义项来源](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/hypothecate)
etymology_story.en: The financial verb comes through Medieval Latin hypothecare from Greek hypothēkē, meaning a pledge or security, ultimately connected with putting something underneath. The later homograph meaning “hypothesize” also draws on Greek ideas of supposition rather than developing directly from the financial meaning. [Etymology and senses](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/hypothecate)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代可分析为 hypothec（抵押、担保）+ -ate（构成动词）；不能把历史词源拆分当作现代自由构词。主要词族：hypothec（抵押权；担保权）、hypothecates（第三人称单数）、hypothecated（过去式、过去分词）、hypothecating（现在分词）、hypothecation（抵押；收入专款专用）、hypothecator／hypothecater（设定抵押或担保的人）、hypothecary（抵押的）；金融领域另有 rehypothecate（再抵押）、rehypothecation（再抵押行为）。
morphology_enriched.en: A useful modern analysis is hypothec, meaning a security interest, + the verb-forming suffix -ate; the historical Greek elements are not freely productive modern components. The main family includes hypothec, hypothecates, hypothecated, hypothecating, hypothecation, hypothecator or hypothecater, and hypothecary; finance also uses rehypothecate and rehypothecation for pledging collateral again.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: pledge（以……作担保）适用范围较广，本身不明确占有是否转移；earmark（指定用途）对应收入专用义，通常不强调法律约束；hypothesize（提出假设）对应假设义，比该义的 hypothecate 常见、清楚。[专款专用义来源](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hypothecate)
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Pledge is broader and does not itself specify whether possession changes; earmark matches the revenue-allocation sense without necessarily implying a legal restriction; hypothesize is the clearer, more usual alternative for the assumption sense. [Revenue-allocation sense](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hypothecate)

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 核心画面：把资产“垫在贷款下面”作担保；收入专用义则是把一笔钱固定在某个用途上。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture an asset placed underneath a loan to support it; for earmarked revenue, picture money tied to one purpose.

etymology_story.zh: 该词于17世纪中叶经新拉丁语进入英语，最终借自阿拉伯语 yarbūʿ，即这种动物的名称。它是借入的动物名，不宜拆成英语词根来解释。[词源来源](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/jerboa)
etymology_story.en: The word entered English in the mid-seventeenth century through modern Latin, ultimately from Arabic yarbūʿ, the animal’s name. It is a borrowed animal name rather than a combination of English roots. [Etymology source](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/jerboa)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可进一步拆分的借词词基 jerboa；jerboa + -s → jerboas（复数）。没有常用的专门派生词族；jerboa-like（像跳鼠的）是透明、可临时构造的类比形容词，不应当作高频固定派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, jerboa is an unanalyzed borrowed base; jerboa + -s gives the plural jerboas. It has no established common derivational family; jerboa-like is a transparent adjective that can be formed when needed, rather than a frequent lexicalized derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 没有常用的严格同义词。相关词 rodent（啮齿动物）是上位词；jumping mouse（蹦鼠）通常指另一类跳跃型啮齿动物；gerbil（沙鼠）也是另一类动物，不能与 jerboa 随意互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no common exact synonym. Rodent is the broader category; jumping mouse usually names a different group of jumping rodents; gerbil names another kind of rodent and is not interchangeable with jerboa.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 整词绑定一幅图：小身体、长后腿、长尾巴，在沙地上跳。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Attach the whole word to one image: a tiny desert rodent with long back legs and a balancing tail.

etymology_story.zh: 现代英语形式承接中古英语 Jutes，经中古拉丁语 Iutae，与古英语中的民族名称 Iotas、Iutan 相联系。这个名称与日耳曼民族命名传统有关，不是普通英语动词 jut 的派生形式。[词源来源](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=Jute)
etymology_story.en: The modern form continues Middle English Jutes through Medieval Latin Iutae, linked to Old English ethnic names such as Iotas and Iutan. It belongs to a Germanic naming tradition and is not derived from the ordinary English verb jut. [Etymology source](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=Jute)

morphology_enriched.zh: Jute（一个朱特人）+ -s（复数词尾）→ Jutes；Jut- + -ish → Jutish（朱特人的；与朱特人有关的）。Jutland（日德兰半岛）是相关地名，不是 Jutes 的现代派生词；小写 jute（黄麻）属于另一个词。
morphology_enriched.en: Jute, meaning one member of the people, + plural -s gives Jutes; Jut- + -ish gives Jutish, meaning relating to the Jutes. Jutland is a related place name rather than a modern derivative of Jutes; lowercase jute, the plant fiber, is a separate word.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Jutish people（朱特民族）可作释义性替换；Germanic people（日耳曼民族）范围更广；Anglo-Saxons（盎格鲁—撒克逊人）在宽泛历史叙述中可涵盖朱特定居者，但并非该民族名称的严格同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Jutish people is a descriptive equivalent; Germanic people is a broader category; Anglo-Saxons can include Jutish settlers in broad historical accounts but is not an exact synonym for this particular people.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 大写 J 记民族名，词尾 -s 记多人；再把朱特人与日德兰半岛联系起来。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Capital J signals a people’s name, and final -s signals its members; connect the name with Jutland.

etymology_story.zh: 该术语以研究这种摄影方法的谢苗·克里安和瓦莲京娜·克里安夫妇的姓氏命名，英语形式经俄语姓名转写而来。姓氏后来用于摄影术名称，并在相关表达中作定语。[命名与读音来源](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/kirlian-photography)
etymology_story.en: The term takes its name from Semyon and Valentina Kirlian, who developed the photographic process, with the English spelling reflecting a transliteration of their surname from Russian. The surname became part of the technique’s name and an attributive modifier in related expressions. [Naming and pronunciation source](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/kirlian-photography)

morphology_enriched.zh: Kirlian 是完整的姓氏词基，不能按英语构词法拆成 Kirl + -ian。主要术语组合有 Kirlian photography（克里安摄影术）、Kirlian photograph（克里安摄影照片）和 Kirlian effect（克里安效应）；没有常用的屈折变化或稳定的常用派生词族，不将罕见的 Kirlianography 列为核心派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Kirlian is an intact surname base, not an English formation consisting of Kirl + -ian. Its main combinations are Kirlian photography, Kirlian photograph, and Kirlian effect; it has no usual inflection or established common derivational family, and the rare formation Kirlianography is not a core derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 没有常用的严格同义形容词。corona-discharge photography（电晕放电摄影）是对该技术的物理描述；electrography（电成像术）范围更广，不能在所有语境下与 Kirlian photography 等同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no common exact adjectival synonym. Corona-discharge photography describes the physical process, while electrography is broader and is not interchangeable with Kirlian photography in every context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 姓氏连技术：Kirlian → 高压电场下，物体边缘出现放电光边。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link the surname to the technique: Kirlian → a glowing discharge fringe around an object in a high-voltage field.

etymology_story.zh: 该词由 leather（皮革）和 jacket（外套）复合而成，18世纪已有记录。动物名称中的“皮外套”比喻坚韧的体表，因此既用于某些鱼，也用于大蚊幼虫。[词源与义项来源](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/leatherjacket)
etymology_story.en: The compound combines leather and jacket and is recorded from the eighteenth century. Its image of a leather outer covering applies to the tough surface of certain fishes as well as crane-fly larvae. [Etymology and senses](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/leatherjacket)

morphology_enriched.zh: leather（皮革）+ jacket（外套）→ leatherjacket；leatherjacket + -s → leatherjackets（复数）。没有常用的专门派生词族；leatherjacket damage 等属于名词作定语，并不构成独立的形容词词性；表示衣物“皮夹克”通常写作两个词 leather jacket。
morphology_enriched.en: Leather + jacket forms leatherjacket; adding -s gives the plural leatherjackets. There is no common specialized derivational family; expressions such as leatherjacket damage use the noun attributively rather than establishing a separate adjective. The garment is normally written as two words, leather jacket.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: crane-fly larva（大蚊幼虫）直接对应昆虫义；filefish（革鲀）对应鱼类义中的一类，并不涵盖所有称作 leatherjacket 的鱼；leatherjack（皮鲹等的俗称）可对应某些鲹科鱼义，不能用于大蚊幼虫。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Crane-fly larva directly matches the insect sense; filefish matches one fish group but does not cover every fish called a leatherjacket; leatherjack can match certain carangid fish senses but does not name the insect larva.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: leather + jacket：像穿了皮外套；抓住“坚韧外皮”，连接幼虫和鱼两个主要用法。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Leather + jacket: something wearing a tough outer coat. That shared surface image connects the larva and fish meanings.

etymology_story.zh: Licht 是苏格兰语中与标准英语 light 对应的本族词，保留了英语标准读音中已经消失的擦音。表示“光亮”和“重量轻”的词在古英语中已有同形的前身，但历史上属于不同的词源支系。
etymology_story.en: Licht is the native Scots counterpart of standard English light and preserves a fricative lost from the standard English pronunciation. The meanings relating to brightness and low weight already had identically spelled predecessors in Old English, but belong to different historical word families.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代苏格兰语中 licht 是不可再分析的词基，没有前缀或后缀；“光亮”和“轻”的同形词应分别理解。主要词族及屈折形式包括 lichts（名词复数或动词第三人称单数）、lichting（现在分词）、lichtit／lichted（过去式及过去分词，拼写随用法而异）、lichtly（轻轻地）、lichtness（轻；明亮），以及复合词 daylicht（日光）和 sunlicht（阳光）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern Scots, licht is an unsegmented base with no prefix or suffix; its brightness and low-weight homonyms should be distinguished. Principal family members and inflections include lichts, lichting, lichtit/lichted, lichtly, lichtness, and the compounds daylicht and sunlicht; spelling varies across Scots usage.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: light（光；轻；点燃）是标准英语中的直接对应词；glow（柔和的光）强调持续而柔和的亮光；lightweight（重量轻的）只对应重量义，不能替代表示光亮或点燃的 licht。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Light is the direct standard English equivalent across several senses; glow specifies a steady, soft light; lightweight corresponds only to the low-weight adjective and cannot replace licht in its illumination or ignition senses.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 licht 与 light 并排记：苏格兰语仍把英语 gh 原来代表的擦音读出来；“光”和“轻”分两条线记忆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Pair licht with light: Scots still pronounces the fricative once represented by English gh. Keep the brightness and low-weight meanings on separate mental tracks.

etymology_story.zh: Mangold 是 mangold-wurzel 的缩略形式，后者来自德语 Mangoldwurzel，由 Mangold（莙荙菜；叶用甜菜）和 Wurzel（根）组成。英语中的短形式专指主要用作牲畜饲料的大根甜菜。
etymology_story.en: Mangold is a shortening of mangold-wurzel, from German Mangoldwurzel, combining Mangold, meaning chard, with Wurzel, meaning root. In English, the shortened form denotes the large-rooted beet grown chiefly as livestock feed.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 mangold 是整体借入后经缩略形成的简单名词，不宜拆成 man + gold；复数为 mangolds。相关形式包括全称 mangold-wurzel，以及同一作物名称的变体 mangel、mangel-wurzel 和 mangelwurzel；这些主要是名称变体，没有常用的派生动词或形容词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, mangold is a simple noun formed by shortening a borrowed compound, not by combining man and gold; its plural is mangolds. Related forms include the full name mangold-wurzel and the variants mangel, mangel-wurzel, and mangelwurzel; these are naming variants, with no common derived verb or adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: mangelwurzel（饲用甜菜）基本同义，是较完整的名称；fodder beet（饲料甜菜）强调饲用用途，是较透明的农业名称；sugar beet（糖用甜菜）是相关作物名称，但强调制糖用途，不能直接视为同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Mangelwurzel is essentially synonymous and is a fuller name; fodder beet is a transparent agricultural term emphasizing its use as animal feed; sugar beet names a related crop selected for sugar production and is not an interchangeable synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从全称记住“大根喂牲畜”：wurzel 是“根”，mangold 是这个饲料作物名称的短形式。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor it to the full name: Wurzel means root, and mangold is the shortened name of the big-rooted feed crop.

etymology_story.zh: Manzanilla 借自西班牙语，是 manzana（苹果）的指小形式，字面意为“小苹果”；西班牙语也用它指洋甘菊。英语沿用了其酒名、橄榄名和植物名用法，但雪利酒得名的具体缘由存在不同解释，不能仅凭“小苹果”断言它是苹果酒。
etymology_story.en: Manzanilla comes from Spanish, where it is a diminutive of manzana, meaning apple, and also names chamomile. English adopted its uses for sherry, an olive variety, and chamomile, but the precise motivation for the sherry's name is disputed; the literal meaning does not make it an apple wine.

morphology_enriched.zh: 英语中按整体借词处理；西班牙语内部可分析为 manzan-（manzana 去掉末尾 -a 的词干）+ -illa（阴性指小后缀）。表示酒或茶时通常不可数，表示单个橄榄时可数，复数为 manzanillas；相关搭配有 manzanilla sherry、manzanilla olive 和 manzanilla tea，没有常用的英语派生动词或形容词。
morphology_enriched.en: English treats it as a whole borrowed word; within Spanish, it consists of manzan-, the stem of manzana without its final -a, plus the feminine diminutive suffix -illa. It is normally uncountable for wine or tea and countable for individual olives, with the plural manzanillas; related combinations include manzanilla sherry, manzanilla olive, and manzanilla tea, with no common English-derived verb or adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: fino（菲诺干雪利酒）是风格相近的酒类名称，但并非 manzanilla 的严格同义词；green olive（青橄榄）是更宽泛的食物名称，manzanilla 只指其中一个品种；chamomile（洋甘菊）对应植物及茶饮义，是英语中更常见的说法。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Fino names a closely related style of dry sherry but is not a strict synonym; green olive is broader, while manzanilla identifies a particular variety; chamomile is the more usual English term for the plant and herbal-tea senses.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: manzana“苹果”加 -illa“小”：记住“小苹果”这个名称，再按语境分辨雪利酒、橄榄或洋甘菊。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Manzana means apple and -illa adds smallness: remember the name “little apple,” then use context to distinguish the sherry, olive, and chamomile senses.

etymology_story.zh: Marly 由英语 marl 加形容词后缀 -y 构成，表示“具有泥灰质特征的”。Marl 经古法语传入英语，其更早来源与拉丁语 marga（泥灰土）有关。
etymology_story.en: Marly was formed in English by adding the adjective suffix -y to marl, giving the meaning “having the properties of marl.” Marl entered English through Old French and ultimately connects with Latin marga, meaning marl.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式为 marl（泥灰土；泥灰岩）+ -y（含有……的；具有……性质的）→ marly。主要词族包括 marl（名词；也可作动词，指施用泥灰土）、marls、marled、marling，以及复合名词 marlstone（泥灰岩）；marly 没有常用的进一步派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: The formation is marl + -y, meaning containing or having the qualities of something, producing marly. Principal family forms include marl as a noun and as a verb meaning to apply marl, its inflections marls, marled, and marling, and the compound marlstone; marly has no common further derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: marl-rich（富含泥灰质的）强调含量较多；calcareous（钙质的）强调含碳酸钙，不一定含有泥灰土所具有的黏土成分；clayey（黏土质的）强调黏土成分，不一定富含碳酸钙。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Marl-rich emphasizes a substantial marl content; calcareous specifies calcium carbonate without necessarily implying the clay component of marl; clayey emphasizes clay without necessarily implying much calcium carbonate.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: marl 是“黏土与碳酸钙的混合物”，加 -y 就是“带这种泥灰质的”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Marl is a mixture of clay and calcium carbonate; adding -y makes it “having that marly material or character.”
