senses.meaning_zh: （绘画）在底料上、正式作画前薄施的有色底层
senses.meaning_en: A thin colored wash applied over a prepared painting ground before painting begins.
senses.english_definition: An imprimatura is a thin layer of color that an artist applies to a prepared painting surface to establish an overall tone before adding the main paint layers.
senses.collocation_en: a thin imprimatura; apply an imprimatura
senses.collocation_zh: 一层薄薄的有色底层；薄施有色底层
senses.sentence_en: She applied a warm brown imprimatura over the white ground.
senses.sentence_zh: 她在白色底料上薄施了一层暖棕色的底色。

etymology_story.zh: imprimatura 是意大利语绘画术语 imprimitura 的变体，相关词源可追溯到表示“压印、印制”的 imprimere，最终源于拉丁语。该词在绘画中专指给已准备好的画面赋予初始色调的薄色层。
etymology_story.en: Imprimatura is a variant of the Italian painting term imprimitura, related to imprimere, meaning to impress or print, and ultimately of Latin origin. In painting, it denotes the thin initial color layer that tones an already prepared surface.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语把 imprimatura 作为整体借词，不宜分析为英语中可自由组合的前后缀。常规英语复数为 imprimaturas；相关异体为 imprimitura。它没有常用的英语派生词族，也不要与表示“出版许可、认可”的 imprimatur 混淆。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats imprimatura as a whole borrowed term rather than a productive combination of English affixes. The regular English plural is imprimaturas, and imprimitura is a related variant spelling. There is no established family of common English derivatives. Distinguish it from imprimatur, meaning permission to publish or official approval.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: toning wash（调底色的薄涂层）最接近其实际作用；underpainting（底层画）范围更广，可包含明暗塑造和构图；ground（底料、绘画基底）通常指承接颜料的预备层，imprimatura 一般施于其上，二者并非同一层。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Toning wash most closely describes its function. Underpainting is broader and may establish forms, values, and composition. Ground usually means the prepared layer that receives paint; an imprimatura is generally applied over it, so the terms are not interchangeable.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 正式画之前，先给白底“印上”一层透明色调：这层薄底色就是 imprimatura。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Before the picture begins, impress a transparent tone on the white surface: that first thin tint is the imprimatura.

etymology_story.zh: 该解剖学术语由拉丁语来源的 infra-（在下方）与 temporal（颞部的）组成；这里的 temporal 对应表示头部颞区的拉丁语 temporalis，与“时间的”这一义项应分开理解。[医学词典](https://theodora.com/medical_dictionary/infraorbital_iniac.html)
etymology_story.en: This anatomical term combines Latin-derived infra-, meaning below, with temporal, referring to the temple. Here temporal belongs to the anatomical use of Latin temporalis and should be distinguished from temporal meaning relating to time. [Medical dictionary](https://theodora.com/medical_dictionary/infraorbital_iniac.html)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：infra-（在下方）+ temporal（颞部的）→ infratemporal（颞下的）；temporal 可进一步分析为 tempor-（颞部）+ -al（形容词后缀）。相关形式有 temple（太阳穴）、temporal（颞部的）以及较少见的 infratemporally（在颞下部；向颞下方）；本词没有常用的名词或动词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: infra- (below) + temporal (relating to the temple) → infratemporal; temporal can be further analyzed as tempor- (temple) + -al (adjective suffix). Related forms include temple, anatomical temporal, and the uncommon adverb infratemporally, meaning in or toward the infratemporal region; there are no common noun or verb derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: subtemporal（颞下的）是近义解剖方位词，但具体命名未必可互换；temporal（颞部的）只说明所属部位；inferior（下方的）只说明相对位置。本词同时限定“颞部”和“下方”。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Subtemporal is a close anatomical alternative, although established structure names are not automatically interchangeable; temporal identifies the region without specifying below it; inferior indicates a lower position without identifying the temporal region.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: infra-＝下方，temporal＝颞部：把位置直接读成“颞下”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Infra- means below and temporal points to the temple: read the word as below the temple.

etymology_story.zh: 英语从阿姆哈拉语 ənǰära 借入这个食物名称，19世纪已有记录。借入后，它继续指这种当地传统薄饼，没有发生显著的词义转移。[Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/injera)
etymology_story.en: English borrowed the food name from Amharic ənǰära, with records dating from the nineteenth century. It retained its reference to the traditional flatbread rather than developing a substantially different meaning. [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/injera)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是整体借词，不宜拆成英语前缀和词根；通常作不可数名词，单份可说 a piece of injera（一块英吉拉薄饼）。没有常用的固定派生词族；injera-like（像英吉拉薄饼的）是可以临时构成的描述性形容词，并非必须独立收录的固定词项。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, injera is an unanalyzed borrowing rather than a combination of English roots and affixes. It is normally uncountable, with individual portions expressed as a piece of injera; it has no common established derivative family, although injera-like is a possible descriptive formation.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Ethiopian flatbread（埃塞俄比亚薄饼）是近似解释性称呼；sourdough flatbread（酸面团薄饼）强调发酵方式，范围更广；pancake（薄煎饼）仅在形状或烹制方式上相似，不等同于 injera。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Ethiopian flatbread is a useful descriptive equivalent; sourdough flatbread emphasizes fermentation and covers a broader category; pancake describes something similar in shape or cooking method but is not an exact synonym.

senses.meaning_en: a plant storage polysaccharide composed mainly of fructose units and used as soluble dietary fiber

etymology_story.zh: 该词于19世纪初由新拉丁语植物属名 Inula（土木香属）与物质名称后缀 -in 构成，命名联系着土木香等植物中的这种成分。后来，该名称也用于从菊苣、菊芋等植物中取得的同类多糖。[Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/inulin)
etymology_story.en: The word was formed in the early nineteenth century from the New Latin plant genus Inula and the substance suffix -in, linking the name to its occurrence in elecampane. The name also came to cover this polysaccharide obtained from plants such as chicory and Jerusalem artichoke. [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/inulin)

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词：Inul(a)（土木香属，去掉末尾 a）+ -in（物质名称后缀）→ inulin（菊粉）。通常不可数；inulins 可表示不同类型的菊粉；专业派生词有 inulinase（菊粉酶，inulin + -ase），相关形容词有 inulin-rich（富含菊粉的）和 inulin-containing（含菊粉的）。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: Inul(a), the plant genus with final a removed, + -in, a substance suffix, → inulin. It is normally uncountable; inulins can refer to different types, while the technical derivative inulinase names an enzyme that breaks it down; related compound adjectives include inulin-rich and inulin-containing.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: chicory fiber（菊苣纤维）在食品语境中常指菊苣来源的菊粉，但限定了来源；fructan（果聚糖）是包含菊粉的上位类别；oligofructose（低聚果糖）指较短链的相关果聚糖，不能在所有技术语境中与菊粉互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Chicory fiber often refers to chicory-derived inulin in food contexts but specifies its source; fructan is the broader class containing inulin; oligofructose refers to related shorter-chain fructans and is not interchangeable with inulin in every technical context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Inula 是植物名，-in 标物质：从植物根中认识“菊粉”；别与 insulin（胰岛素）混淆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Inula supplies the plant name and -in marks a substance: picture plant-root fiber, and keep inulin distinct from insulin.

usage_note: 常见于 iodized salt；描述加入碘或碘化物的处理状态，不等同于加了普通调味料。

etymology_story.zh: iodized 来自19世纪已有记录的动词 iodize，由 iodine（碘）的词干与 -ize 构成，过去分词又发展为表示处理后状态的形容词。iodine 的名称经法语 iode 追溯至希腊语“紫罗兰色的”，指碘蒸气的颜色。[Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/iodize)
etymology_story.en: Iodized comes from the nineteenth-century verb iodize, formed from the stem of iodine and -ize; its past participle also became an adjective describing the resulting state. Iodine ultimately derives, through French iode, from Greek meaning violet-colored, referring to its vapor. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/iodize)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：iod-（碘，见 iodine）+ -ize（使……化；用……处理）→ iodize；iodize + -ed → iodized，词尾已有 e，拼写时只加 d。核心词族包括 iodine（碘）、iodize/iodise（加碘）、iodizes/iodises（第三人称单数）、iodizing/iodising（现在分词）、iodized/iodised（过去式、过去分词及形容词）、iodization/iodisation（加碘处理）、iodizer/iodiser（加碘装置或操作者）和 uniodized/uniodised（未加碘的）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: iod- (iodine) + -ize (treat with) → iodize; iodize + -ed → iodized, written by adding only d after the existing final e. The core family includes iodine; iodize/iodise; iodizes/iodises; iodizing/iodising; iodized/iodised; iodization/iodisation, the treatment process; iodizer/iodiser, an apparatus or operator; and uniodized/uniodised, meaning without added iodine.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: iodine-treated（经碘处理的）是较直接的解释性近义表达；iodine-fortified（经碘强化的）强调营养强化；iodinated（碘化的）在化学中常强调引入碘或碘原子，不能与 iodized 在所有语境中直接互换。[Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/iodize)
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Iodine-treated is a close explanatory equivalent; iodine-fortified emphasizes nutritional enrichment; iodinated often emphasizes the chemical introduction of iodine or iodine atoms and is not interchangeable with iodized in every context. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/iodize)

mnemonic_anchor.zh: iod-＝碘，-ize＝加以处理，-ed＝已完成：已经加过碘。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Iod- points to iodine, -ize marks treatment, and -ed marks completion: iodine has been added.

etymology_story.zh: 该词由 jar（罐子）与 head（头）组成，20世纪用于称呼美国海军陆战队员；更早也曾用于指骡子。军人义的确切形成过程尚无定论，短发像罐子的解释只是流行说法之一。[韦氏词典编辑的词源说明](https://www.deseret.com/1996/3/10/19229860/are-u-s-marines-stubborn-as-a-jarhead/)
etymology_story.en: The compound jar + head became a twentieth-century slang name for a U.S. Marine and had earlier been used for a mule. The precise development of the military sense is uncertain; the familiar explanation involving a jar-like haircut is only one proposed account. [Etymological account by Merriam-Webster editors](https://www.deseret.com/1996/3/10/19229860/are-u-s-marines-stubborn-as-a-jarhead/)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：jar（罐子）+ head（头）→ jarhead，为合成名词；复数 jarheads（多名海军陆战队员）。没有常用的固定动词或副词派生形式；作名词修饰语时也不因此另立形容词词性。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: jar + head → jarhead, a compound noun; its regular plural is jarheads. It has no common established verb or adverb derivatives, and attributive use of the noun does not by itself establish a separate adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Marine（海军陆战队员）是中性、正式称呼；leatherneck（海军陆战队员）也是美国俚称，常带传统军旅色彩；soldier（士兵）范围更广，通常尤其指陆军军人，不能准确替代 jarhead。[Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/jarhead)
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Marine is the neutral, official designation; leatherneck is another American slang name with a traditional military flavor; soldier is broader and usually refers especially to an army member, so it is not a precise substitute for jarhead. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/jarhead)

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 jar＋head 想成“罐子头”的军中外号，联想到海军陆战队员；这是记忆画面，不是已证实的词源。

etymology_story.en: Jillion was coined on the model of large-number names such as million and billion, using their familiar sound to suggest an enormous quantity without assigning an exact value. [Etymological source: American Heritage](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=jillion)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中通常作为完整词基学习；词形体现对 -illion 大数名称模式的类推，不能把 j- 当作有固定意义的词根。词族：jillions（复数，常用于 jillions of）；jillion + -th → jillionth（夸张的序数词，也可作名词）；jillion + -aire → jillionaire（极其富有的人，诙谐用语）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, learn jillion as a whole base patterned after number names ending in -illion; j- is not a root with an independent meaning. Its family includes jillions, the plural commonly used in jillions of; jillion + -th → jillionth, a humorous ordinal adjective or noun; and jillion + -aire → jillionaire, a humorous term for an extremely wealthy person.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: zillion（无数）、gazillion（天文数字般的数量）、countless（数不清的）：前两者与 jillion 一样是非正式的夸张数目，彼此没有确定的大小等级；countless 是形容词，强调多得无法计数，通常较少诙谐色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Zillion and gazillion are similarly informal, exaggerated numbers, with no fixed numerical ranking relative to jillion. Countless is an adjective emphasizing that there are too many to count and usually sounds less playful.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 听起来像 million，意思却是“多到懒得数”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: It sounds like million, but means “too many to bother counting.”

etymology_story.zh: keister 在19世纪末的俚语中曾指手提箱或装物品的箱子，后来用于臀部和肛门；更早的来源有争议，部分词典将其追溯至德语 Kiste（箱子）。动词义由身体部位名转化而来。[名词词源：American Heritage](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=keister)；[动词记录：Routledge 俚语词典](https://thariqalfathih.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/ulrlklwnrnekihejaojl-signature-13e671e7ce00256288168433c3e3892dc737b7bd85e3450f6bb8fe797ddcf76d-poli-141104171516-conversion-gate01-1.pdf)
etymology_story.en: In late nineteenth-century slang, keister referred to a suitcase or carrying case before developing bodily meanings; its deeper origin is disputed, though some dictionaries trace it to German Kiste, meaning “box.” The verb developed by conversion from the bodily noun. [Noun etymology: American Heritage](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=keister); [verb documentation: Routledge slang dictionary](https://thariqalfathih.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/ulrlklwnrnekihejaojl-signature-13e671e7ce00256288168433c3e3892dc737b7bd85e3450f6bb8fe797ddcf76d-poli-141104171516-conversion-gate01-1.pdf)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为完整词基；结尾 -er 不是表示人的施事后缀。keister（名词）→ keister（动词）属于零派生。名词复数及动词第三人称单数：keisters；过去式、过去分词：keistered；现在分词：keistering。keester 是异体拼写。
morphology_enriched.en: Keister is a whole base in modern English; its ending -er is not an agent suffix. Noun keister → verb keister is conversion without an added affix. Keisters is the noun plural and third-person singular verb; keistered is the past tense and past participle; keistering is the present participle. Keester is a variant spelling.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: bottom（屁股）、buttocks（臀部）、conceal（隐藏）：bottom 是较温和的日常称呼，buttocks 较中性或偏解剖用语，keister 带俚语及诙谐色彩；动词 conceal 不限定藏匿部位，而 keister 明确指藏入直肠。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Bottom is a mild everyday term, while buttocks is neutral or anatomical; keister sounds slangy and often humorous. For the verb, conceal is much broader, whereas keister specifically identifies concealment in the rectum.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: “箱子装东西”联想“屁股”；动词再联想“把东西藏进去”。这是记忆联想，不是确证的语义演变解释。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link a carrying case with the backside, then link the verb with hiding something inside. This is a memory association, not a proven account of the semantic change.

usage_note: 本课取小写通名 kewpie；作为品牌名称时写 Kewpie。娃娃常有圆脸、红脸颊和一撮卷发。

etymology_story.zh: 这个医学术语形成于19世纪后期，由源自希腊语 larynx、laryng-（喉）的构词成分与 -ectomy（外科切除）组合而成。它直接标明切除部位，现代用法包括部分切除和全部切除。[词源：Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/laryngectomy)；[定义：NIDCD](https://www.nidcd.nih.gov/glossary/laryngectomy)
etymology_story.en: This medical term was formed in the late nineteenth century from a combining element based on Greek larynx, stem laryng-, and -ectomy, meaning surgical removal. It names the organ removed and now covers both partial and total removal. [Etymology: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/laryngectomy); [definition: NIDCD](https://www.nidcd.nih.gov/glossary/laryngectomy)

morphology_enriched.zh: laryng-（喉）+ -ectomy（切除术）→ laryngectomy；也可从结合形式 laryng/o 分析，连接元音 o 在以元音开头的 -ectomy 前省去。复数：laryngectomies。直接相关词：laryngectomize（施行喉切除术）、laryngectomized（接受过喉切除术的）、laryngectomee（接受过喉切除术的人）。同根词包括 larynx（喉）、laryngeal（喉的）、laryngitis（喉炎）、laryngoscope（喉镜）、laryngoscopy（喉镜检查）、laryngotomy（喉切开术）、laryngostomy（喉造口术）；后几项是同根词，不是本词的直接派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Laryng- “larynx” + -ectomy “surgical removal” → laryngectomy; alternatively, analyze the combining form as laryng/o, with linking o omitted before vowel-initial -ectomy. The plural is laryngectomies. Directly related forms include laryngectomize, to perform the operation; laryngectomized, having undergone it; and laryngectomee, a person who has undergone it. Other root-family members include larynx, laryngeal, laryngitis, laryngoscope, laryngoscopy, laryngotomy, and laryngostomy; these share the anatomical root rather than deriving directly from laryngectomy.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: excision of the larynx（喉切除）、laryngeal resection（喉切除或切除部分喉组织）、removal of the voice box（切除发声器官）：第一项是正式释义性表达，resection 常用于说明切除范围，最后一项是通俗说法；三者均需结合语境明确是部分切除还是全部切除。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Excision of the larynx is a formal descriptive equivalent. Laryngeal resection often appears when discussing the extent of tissue removal. Removal of the voice box is a plain-language expression; context must establish whether removal is partial or total.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: laryng- 指“喉”，-ectomy 指“切除”：喉切除术。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Laryng- identifies the voice box; -ectomy means removing it surgically.

etymology_story.en: English liverwurst is a partial translation of German Leberwurst: Leber, meaning 'liver,' was replaced by English liver, while Wurst, meaning 'sausage,' was retained. The name preserves the German ingredient-plus-food pattern.

morphology_enriched.zh: liver（肝）+ wurst（借自德语，意为香肠）→ liverwurst（肝肠），属于复合名词。表示食品整体时通常不可数；指不同品种或若干根肝肠时可用复数 liverwursts。没有常用的直接派生词；liverwurst sandwich 中仍是名词作定语。
morphology_enriched.en: liver + wurst, a borrowing meaning 'sausage,' → liverwurst, a compound noun. It is usually uncountable as a food, but liverwursts can refer to varieties or individual sausages. It has no common direct derivatives; in liverwurst sandwich, the noun is used attributively.

synonyms_and_nuances.en: Liver sausage is the closest equivalent; Braunschweiger commonly denotes a smoked variety of liver sausage in North America; liver pâté emphasizes a liver paste or spread and is not necessarily a sausage.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: liver 是肝，wurst 是香肠：两部分合起来就是肝肠。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Liver names the ingredient; wurst names the sausage: liver sausage.

etymology_story.zh: 这个词来自北美麦基诺／麦基纳克一带的地名，该地名最终源于奥吉布瓦语中与“大龟”有关的名称。厚毛毯、呢料和外套等义项与当地贸易及御寒用品有关，船和鱼的名称也与这一地区相关。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from the Mackinaw/Mackinac place name in North America, ultimately derived from an Ojibwe name associated with a 'great turtle.' The blanket, fabric, and coat senses reflect regional trade and cold-weather goods, while the boat and fish names also have regional associations.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 mackinaw 是由专名转化而来的完整词干，不能可靠地拆成常用词根和词缀。指外套、毛毯或船时，复数为 mackinaws；指呢料时通常不可数。常见组合有 mackinaw coat、mackinaw blanket、mackinaw boat 和 mackinaw trout；没有常用的直接派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, mackinaw is a whole stem derived from a proper name, without a useful productive root-and-affix analysis. Mackinaws is the plural for coats, blankets, or boats; the fabric sense is usually uncountable. Established combinations include mackinaw coat, mackinaw blanket, mackinaw boat, and mackinaw trout. There are no common direct derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: pea coat（海军式厚呢短大衣）与外套义接近，但通常指双排扣的海军风格外套；woolen cloth（羊毛呢料）范围更广，不限定麦基诺式厚呢；lake trout（湖红点鲑）是鱼类义的通行名称，mackinaw 则带地域色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Pea coat overlaps with the coat sense but usually denotes a double-breasted naval-style coat; woolen cloth is broader than the specific heavy fabric; lake trout is the general name for the fish, whereas mackinaw is regional.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把麦基诺地区与北方厚毛毯、厚呢外套连起来；船和湖鳟也沿着这个地名记。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link the Mackinaw region with northern blankets and heavy coats; attach the regional boat and trout names to the same place.

etymology_story.zh: matrilateral 由表示“母亲”的组合形式 matri- 与 lateral（侧面的）构成，二者分别可追溯到拉丁语 mater 和 latus。这个词用于亲属关系研究，表示“母亲这一侧”，本身不表示世系必须按母系传承。
etymology_story.en: Matrilateral combines matri-, meaning 'mother,' with lateral, meaning 'of the side,' ultimately from Latin mater and latus. In kinship studies it identifies the mother's side without itself implying descent through a maternal line.

morphology_enriched.zh: matri-（母亲）+ lateral（侧面的；词族上与 later-、-al 有关）→ matrilateral（母方的）。直接派生形式有 matrilaterally（从母方；在母方一侧）和较少见的 matrilaterality（母方关联性）；对照词为 patrilateral（父方的）。matrilineal（母系传承的）是相关词，但含义不同。
morphology_enriched.en: matri- ('mother') + lateral ('of the side,' belonging to the later-/-al family) → matrilateral. Direct derivatives include matrilaterally and the less frequent matrilaterality; the contrasting term is patrilateral. Matrilineal is related but has a different meaning: descent through the maternal line.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: maternal（母方的）在 maternal relatives 等表达中意思接近，但也可表示母亲般的；on the mother's side（在母亲一方）是最清楚的日常释义；matrilineal（母系的）强调通过女性一线计算世系，不能普遍替换 matrilateral。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Maternal is close in expressions such as maternal relatives but can also mean motherly; on the mother's side is the clearest everyday paraphrase; matrilineal specifically concerns descent through women and is not generally interchangeable with matrilateral.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: matri- 是母亲，lateral 是侧面：站到家谱中母亲那一边。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Mother + side: look at the mother's side of the family tree.

etymology.text: 19世纪英语用拉丁语 mens 的词干 ment-（心智）接上 -ation，组成表示心智活动的词。可把它想成脑中持续进行的思考过程。

usage_note: 正式或医学、心理学用语，指思维活动；日常交流通常用 thinking。

senses.meaning_zh: 思维活动；心智活动或运作过程
senses.meaning_en: mental activity or the process of thinking
senses.english_definition: Mentation is the activity of thinking or the way a person's mind is functioning.
senses.collocation_zh: 心智状态改变；正常心智活动
senses.sentence_en: The doctor noted altered mentation during the examination.
senses.sentence_zh: 医生在检查过程中注意到患者的心智状态出现了改变。

etymology_story.zh: mentation 是19世纪形成的词，以拉丁语 mens（心智）的词干 ment- 加上表示过程或活动的 -ation 构成。它保留了“心智活动”的基本含义，现代主要见于医学、心理学及其他正式语境。
etymology_story.en: Mentation was formed in the nineteenth century from ment-, the stem of Latin mens, meaning 'mind,' and the process suffix -ation. It retains the meaning 'mental activity' and now occurs chiefly in medical, psychological, and other formal contexts.

morphology_enriched.zh: ment-（心智，拉丁语词干）+ -ation（过程、活动）→ mentation，通常为不可数名词。直接相关的形容词为 mentational（心智活动的，较少见）；同源词族包括 mental（心智的）、mentally（在心智上）和 mentality（心态；思维方式），它们并非都由 mentation 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: ment- ('mind,' a Latin stem) + -ation ('process or activity') → mentation, usually an uncountable noun. A directly related adjective is mentational, which is uncommon. The wider cognate family includes mental, mentally, and mentality; these are not all direct derivatives of mentation.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: thinking（思考）最日常，常指主动思考某事；cognition（认知）范围较广，包括感知、记忆与推理；mental activity（心智活动）是中性的释义，而 mentation 更正式，临床中也用于描述整体心智运作。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Thinking is the everyday term and often suggests actively considering something; cognition covers processes such as perception, memory, and reasoning; mental activity is a neutral paraphrase, while mentation is more formal and can describe overall mental functioning in clinical use.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: ment- 表示心智，-ation 表示活动：心智正在运转。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Mind + activity: mentation is the mind at work.

family: metalepsis 远代法，借一个转义再引出另一个转义。

morphology.text: metalept-（与 metalepsis 对应的词干）+ -ic（……的）→ metaleptic（远代法的）。

etymology.text: 来自希腊语 metalēptikos，与表示交换、参与的 metalambanein 相连。修辞中，意义经过一层转义再转到另一层，像接力一样传下去。

usage_note: 修辞学术语。本课指经过相联的转义间接表达；不是把所有比喻都叫 metaleptic。

senses.meaning_zh: 远代法的；通过中间联系进行连环转喻的
senses.meaning_en: involving a figurative substitution through an intermediate association
senses.english_definition: A metaleptic expression refers to something through a chain of associations rather than through one direct connection.
senses.collocation_zh: 连环转喻式替代；远代法修辞
senses.sentence_en: The critic explains the metaleptic substitution by tracing the associations between the terms.
senses.sentence_zh: 这位批评家通过追溯这些词语之间的联系，解释了这种连环转喻式替代。

senses.meaning_zh: 叙事越界的；涉及不同叙事层级相互跨越的
senses.meaning_en: involving a crossing between different narrative levels
senses.english_definition: A metaleptic event occurs when a narrator, character, or other element crosses the boundary between different levels of a story.
senses.collocation_zh: 叙事层级越界；越界叙述
senses.sentence_en: The character's argument with the narrator creates a metaleptic moment.
senses.sentence_zh: 人物与叙述者争论，构成了一个叙事越界的时刻。

etymology_story.zh: 源自希腊语 metalēptikos，与 metalēpsis（转换、替代）及 metalambanein（参与、分享、交换）同源。该词先用于描述间接的修辞替代，后来也用于叙事学，描述不同叙事层级之间的越界。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Greek metalēptikos, related to metalēpsis, meaning a change or substitution, and metalambanein, meaning to share, participate, or exchange. It describes indirect rhetorical substitution and later acquired a narratological use for crossings between narrative levels.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代可分析为 metalept-（与 metalepsis 对应的词干）+ -ic（……的）；不宜按普通英语词根继续拆分。相关词族包括 metalepsis（远代法；叙事越界，复数 metalepses）、metaleptic、较少见的 metaleptical（同义形容词）和 metaleptically（以远代法或叙事越界的方式）。
morphology_enriched.en: The modern analysis is metalept-, the stem corresponding to metalepsis, + -ic, meaning relating to; further division into ordinary English roots would be misleading. The family includes metalepsis, plural metalepses, metaleptic, the less common adjective metaleptical, and the adverb metaleptically.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: transumptive（远代法的）是修辞学中的近义词；metonymic（转喻的）范围更广，不一定经过中间联系；metafictional（元小说的）强调作品对自身虚构性质的关注，不一定跨越叙事层级。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Transumptive is a close rhetorical synonym; metonymic is broader and need not involve an intermediate association; metafictional concerns a work's awareness of its own fictionality and does not necessarily involve crossing narrative levels.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“跨一步”：修辞跨过一层联想，叙事跨过一层边界。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think of crossing a step: rhetoric crosses an intermediate association, while narrative crosses a boundary.

etymology_story.zh: 这是一个形成于20世纪的英语合成词，由表示“小型”的 mini- 与 camera（照相机；摄像机）的缩略形式 cam 组成。它用来称呼便于携带的小型摄像设备，尤其是电视摄像机。
etymology_story.en: This twentieth-century English formation combines mini-, meaning small, with cam, a shortened form of camera. It names compact, portable camera equipment, especially television cameras.

morphology_enriched.zh: mini-（小型）+ cam（camera 的截短形式）→ minicam；复数为 minicams。相关构词包括 mini-camera（小型相机或摄像机）、camera（相机；摄像机）、cam（相机或摄像机的非正式简称）和 camcorder（摄录一体机）；这些是相关形式，并非全由 minicam 派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Mini-, meaning small, + cam, a clipping of camera, forms minicam; the plural is minicams. Related formations include mini-camera, camera, informal cam, and camcorder; these are related forms rather than derivatives all formed from minicam.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: video camera（摄像机）是较宽泛的名称，不限定大小；camcorder（摄录一体机）强调摄像与录像功能集于一体；miniature camera（微型相机或摄像机）强调尺寸很小，也可指拍摄静态照片的设备。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Video camera is a broader term with no size restriction; camcorder emphasizes an integrated camera and recorder; miniature camera emphasizes very small size and can also refer to a still camera.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: mini 是“小”，cam 是 camera：能随身带走的小摄像机。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Mini means small and cam means camera: picture a camera small enough to carry with you.

etymology.text: 英语用源自拉丁语 multus（多）的 multi- 与 factor 组合。这个构词把“几个因素一起起作用”的意思直接装进了一个词里。

usage_note: 用于分析、模型或身份验证等；在身份验证中 factor 指不同类别的验证因素，并非简单重复输入同一个密码。

senses.meaning_en: involving or depending on several factors
senses.english_definition: A multifactor system, model, or process involves several different factors.

etymology_story.zh: 由 multi-（多）与 factor（因素）组合而成；multi- 源自拉丁语 multus（多），factor 则最终源自拉丁语表示“做、制造”的 facere。factor 从“做事者”发展出数学中的“因子”和一般意义上的“影响因素”，multifactor 因而表示涉及多个因素。
etymology_story.en: The word combines multi-, from Latin multus, meaning much or many, with factor, ultimately from Latin facere, meaning to do or make. Factor developed from the idea of a doer or maker into mathematical and causal meanings, so multifactor describes the involvement of several factors.

morphology_enriched.zh: multi-（多个）+ factor（因素）→ multifactor，也写作 multi-factor。相关词族包括 factor（因素；因子）、multifactorial（由多种因素造成的；多因素的）和 multifactorially（以多因素方式）；multifactorial 常用于医学、遗传学和因果分析。
morphology_enriched.en: Multi-, meaning many, + factor forms multifactor, also written multi-factor. Related family members include factor, multifactorial, meaning involving or caused by several factors, and multifactorially; multifactorial is especially used in medicine, genetics, and causal analysis.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: multifactorial（多因素的）常强调多个成因共同作用；multivariable（多变量的）强调模型或分析包含多个变量；multidimensional（多维度的）强调存在多个方面或维度，不一定涉及多个因果因素。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Multifactorial often emphasizes several contributing causes; multivariable emphasizes multiple variables in a model or analysis; multidimensional emphasizes several aspects or dimensions rather than necessarily several causal factors.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: multi 是“多”，factor 是“因素”：多个因素共同参与。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Multi means many and factor means a contributing element: several factors take part.

senses.meaning_en: relating to multinomials or their expansion
senses.english_definition: A multinomial formula or coefficient is used when working with a sum of several algebraic terms.
senses.collocation_zh: 多项式定理；多项式系数
senses.sentence_en: The multinomial theorem gives the coefficients in the expansion of (x + y + z) to any positive integer power.

senses.meaning_zh: 多项分布的；涉及多个互斥结果类别的
senses.meaning_en: relating to several mutually exclusive outcome categories or their counts
senses.english_definition: A multinomial model describes outcomes in several categories, such as the numbers of times different results occur in repeated trials.
senses.collocation_zh: 多项分布；多项逻辑回归

senses.sentence_zh: 重复独立投掷一枚均匀骰子时，六个点数各自出现的次数服从多项分布。

etymology_story.zh: 该词仿照 binomial（二项式）构成，用源自拉丁语 multus（多）的 multi- 替换表示“二”的部分。它最初用于代数中的多项表达式，后来也用于统计学，因为多类别计数的概率公式涉及多项式展开。
etymology_story.en: The word was formed on the pattern of binomial, replacing the element meaning two with multi-, from Latin multus, meaning many. Its algebraic use extended into statistics because probability formulas for counts across several categories involve multinomial expansions.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代可分析为 multi-（多）+ -nomial（仿照 binomial 等数学词形成的构词成分，表示与代数项有关）。“项”这一解释属于现代数学构词，不应把 -nomial 当作独立英语单词。直接相关形式有 multinomials（名词复数）和 multinomially（按多项式或多项分布方式）；同系列数学词有 monomial（单项式）、binomial（二项式）、trinomial（三项式）和 polynomial（多项式）。
morphology_enriched.en: The modern analysis is multi-, meaning many, + -nomial, a mathematical combining element patterned on words such as binomial and associated with algebraic terms. This modern interpretation does not make -nomial an independent English word. Directly related forms include the plural multinomials and the adverb multinomially; the wider mathematical series includes monomial, binomial, trinomial, and polynomial.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: polynomial（多项式；多项式的）是代数中的主要近义词，通常也涵盖单项式和二项式；categorical（分类的）在统计语境中强调结果属于不同类别，范围更广；polytomous（多分类的）常强调一个响应变量具有两个以上类别，不直接表示特定的多项分布。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Polynomial is the main algebraic near-synonym and generally also covers one-term and two-term expressions; categorical is broader and emphasizes membership in distinct categories; polytomous commonly describes a response with more than two categories without specifying a multinomial distribution.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从 binomial 的“两项”扩展到 multinomial 的“多项”；统计中再联想到“多个结果类别”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Extend binomial from two terms to many terms; in statistics, connect those terms with several outcome categories.

etymology_story.zh: 英语从克里语借入该词，其来源通常转写为 maskek，意思是“沼泽”。它在北美英语中用于指称北方潮湿、常覆盖苔藓并积累泥炭的沼泽地。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed the word from Cree, from a form commonly transliterated as maskek, meaning swamp. In North American English it denotes northern bogland that is often moss-covered and accumulates peat.

morphology_enriched.zh: muskeg 在现代英语中是不可再作有意义拆分的借入词。它既可作物质或地貌总称，也可指一处沼泽，复数为 muskegs；muskeg + -y 构成 muskeggy（多泥炭沼泽的；沼泽般松软潮湿的），拼写时双写词尾 g。
morphology_enriched.en: Muskeg is a borrowed base with no useful internal breakdown in modern English. It can be a mass noun for the terrain or a count noun for an individual bog, with plural muskegs; adding -y gives muskeggy, meaning full of muskeg or boggy, with the final g doubled.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: bog（泥炭沼泽）最接近，强调积水和泥炭积累；peatland（泥炭地）是更宽泛的地貌或生态学名称；swamp（沼泽）通常更强调树木或灌木生长，而 muskeg 带有北美北方地域色彩，常见苔藓和低矮植被。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Bog is the closest general term and emphasizes waterlogging and peat accumulation; peatland is a broader geographical or ecological term; swamp usually suggests more woody vegetation, whereas muskeg has a northern North American association and often features mosses and low vegetation.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Attach the whole word to one image: northern North America, with waterlogged peat beneath a mossy surface.

etymology_story.zh: muskmelon 由 musk（麝香；麝香般的浓香）与 melon（瓜）合成，名称指向果实浓郁的香气。这里的 musk 描述气味，并不表示甜瓜含有麝香。
etymology_story.en: Muskmelon combines musk, referring to a strong fragrance, with melon, naming the fruit for its pronounced aroma. Musk describes its smell rather than an ingredient.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：musk（浓香）+ melon（瓜）→ muskmelon，属于名词复合词；复数为 muskmelons。相关词包括 musk（麝香）、musky（有麝香气味的）、muskiness（麝香般的气味）和 melon（瓜）；它们是构词成分及其词族成员，并非都由 muskmelon 派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: musk + melon → muskmelon, a compound noun; the plural is muskmelons. Related words include musk, musky, muskiness, and melon; these belong to its component families rather than all being derivatives of muskmelon.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: melon（瓜、甜瓜）是范围更广的名称；cantaloupe（坎塔卢普甜瓜，北美英语中常指网纹甜瓜）与 muskmelon 在日常用法中常重合；honeydew（蜜露甜瓜）属于广义甜瓜中的另一类型，通常果皮光滑，不能在具体品种语境中直接替换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Melon is the broader term; cantaloupe often overlaps with muskmelon in everyday North American usage; honeydew is another type within the broader muskmelon group, usually with smooth skin, and is not interchangeable when a particular variety matters.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: musk 浓香 + melon 瓜：切开就闻到香气的甜瓜。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Musk-like fragrance + melon: picture the sweet aroma released when you cut it open.

etymology_story.zh: myelogenous 是近代医学术语，其构词基础可追溯到希腊语 myelos（髓）以及表示产生或来源的词根。这个词将“由髓产生”的含义用于骨髓来源的疾病和细胞，尤其常见于白血病名称。
etymology_story.en: Myelogenous is a modern medical formation built from elements tracing back to Greek myelos, meaning marrow, and a root expressing production or origin. Its meaning of arising from marrow became especially established in names for leukemias.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：myelo-（骨髓）+ -genous（产生于……的）→ myelogenous。相关同根词包括 myelogenic（骨髓源性的）、myeloid（髓系的）、myelocyte（中幼粒细胞）和 myelopoiesis（骨髓造血；髓系细胞生成）；这些是共享构词成分的术语，并非全部由本词直接派生。本词没有常用的其他词性形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: myelo- (bone marrow) + -genous (originating in) → myelogenous. Related formations include myelogenic, myeloid, myelocyte, and myelopoiesis; these share combining elements rather than all deriving directly from myelogenous. There are no common forms in other parts of speech.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: myelogenic（骨髓源性的）在来源义上接近本词；marrow-derived（来自骨髓的）是较直白、范围较宽的表达；myeloid（髓系的）在白血病名称中常与本词对应，但通常强调细胞谱系，不能在所有语境中简单等同于“来自骨髓”。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Myelogenic is close in its meaning of marrow origin; marrow-derived is a plainer, broader description; myeloid often corresponds to myelogenous in leukemia names but usually identifies a cell lineage, so it does not always mean simply originating in marrow.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: myelo- 骨髓 + -genous 来源：把来源箭头指回骨髓。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Myelo- means marrow and -genous marks origin: trace the arrow back to bone marrow.

etymology_story.zh: myxoid 由源自希腊语 myxa（黏液）的 myx- 与表示“像……的”的 -oid 构成。它进入医学用语后，用于描述组织或基质的黏液样性质，而不必表示其中含有真正的黏液。
etymology_story.en: Myxoid combines myx-, from Greek myxa meaning mucus, with -oid, meaning resembling. In medical usage, it describes a mucus-like quality in tissue or its matrix without necessarily indicating actual mucus.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：myx-（黏液）+ -oid（像……的）→ myxoid。相关同根词包括 myxoma（黏液瘤）、myxomatous（黏液瘤性的；黏液样变的）和 myxomatosis（黏液瘤病）；这些词共享 myx- 词根，但含义不能互换。本词没有常用的名词或动词派生形式。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: myx- (mucus) + -oid (resembling) → myxoid. Related words include myxoma, myxomatous, and myxomatosis; they share the root myx- but are not interchangeable in meaning. Myxoid has no common noun or verb derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: mucoid（黏液样的）强调类似黏液的外观或稠度；gelatinous（胶冻状的）仅描述质地；mucinous（黏液性的）在病理学中常指含有或分泌黏蛋白性黏液，不能与描述特定间质性质的 myxoid 随意替换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Mucoid emphasizes a mucus-like appearance or consistency; gelatinous describes a jelly-like texture; mucinous often indicates the presence or production of mucin-containing material in pathology and is not freely interchangeable with myxoid, which can characterize a particular tissue matrix.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: myx- 黏液 + -oid 像：组织看起来像黏液或果冻。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Myx- means mucus and -oid means like: picture tissue with a jelly-like matrix.

meaning: 牙源性的；源于成牙组织的

morphology.text: odonto-（牙齿）+ -genic（产生、来源的）→ odontogenic（牙源性的）。

etymology.text: 现代医学英语使用希腊语 odōn 的词干 odont-（牙齿），与表示生成或来源的 -genic 组合。把来源追到牙齿形成的组织，就能记住它。

etymology_story.zh: odontogenic 由希腊语 odous、属格 odontos（牙齿）所提供的词干 odont-，与表示生成或来源的 -genic 构成。医学用法保留了两个相关方向：参与牙齿形成，以及由牙齿或成牙组织产生。
etymology_story.en: Odontogenic combines odont-, from Greek odous, genitive odontos, meaning tooth, with -genic, expressing production or origin. Medical usage preserves two related directions: contributing to tooth formation and arising from teeth or tooth-forming tissues.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：odonto-（牙齿）+ -genic（生成的；源于……的）→ odontogenic。相关词族包括 odontogenesis（牙齿发生、形成）、odontogenetic（牙齿发生的）、odontoblast（成牙本质细胞）、odontoma（牙瘤）、odontology（牙科学）和 odontologist（牙科学研究者）；这些词共享牙齿词根，并非都由 odontogenic 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: odonto- (tooth) + -genic (producing or originating in) → odontogenic. The related family includes odontogenesis, odontogenetic, odontoblast, odontoma, odontology, and odontologist; these share the tooth root rather than all deriving directly from odontogenic.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: tooth-derived（源于牙齿的）直白地表达来源；tooth-forming（成牙的）对应促进或参与牙齿形成的含义；dental（牙齿的、牙科的）范围更广，仅说明与牙齿有关，不必说明来源或生成作用。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Tooth-derived directly expresses origin; tooth-forming corresponds to involvement in producing teeth; dental is broader and indicates a connection with teeth without necessarily specifying origin or a role in formation.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: odonto- 牙 + -genic 生成或来源：既可“形成牙”，也可“源于牙”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Odonto- means tooth; -genic signals formation or origin: forming teeth or arising from them.

etymology_story.zh: oenophile 是一个在19世纪出现的葡萄酒爱好者称谓，由源自希腊语 oinos（葡萄酒）的 oeno- 和表示“爱好者”的 -phile 构成。它强调对葡萄酒的喜爱和兴趣，并不自动意味着具有专业资质。
etymology_story.en: Oenophile is a nineteenth-century term combining oeno-, from Greek oinos meaning wine, with -phile, meaning lover. It denotes affection for and interest in wine without automatically implying professional qualifications.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：oeno-（葡萄酒）+ -phile（爱好者）→ oenophile；复数为 oenophiles。直接相关形式包括 oenophilia（对葡萄酒的喜爱）和 oenophilic（喜爱葡萄酒的）；同根词还有 oenology（葡萄酒酿造学）和 oenologist（葡萄酒酿造学专家）。美式英语中也可见省去首字母 o 的 eno- 拼写变体，如 enophile、enology。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: oeno- (wine) + -phile (lover) → oenophile; the plural is oenophiles. Directly related forms include oenophilia and oenophilic; root-related terms include oenology and oenologist. American English also permits eno- spelling variants, such as enophile and enology.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: wine lover（葡萄酒爱好者）最通俗，强调喜爱；wine enthusiast（葡萄酒爱好者）常突出积极品鉴和学习；wine connoisseur（葡萄酒鉴赏家）强调辨别品质的知识与判断力，比 oenophile 更明确地暗示鉴赏水平。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Wine lover is the plainest expression and emphasizes enjoyment; wine enthusiast often suggests active tasting and learning; wine connoisseur emphasizes knowledgeable judgment of quality and implies expertise more strongly than oenophile.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: oeno- 葡萄酒 + -phile 爱好者：把“爱”指向葡萄酒。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Oeno- means wine and -phile means lover: direct the love toward wine.

meaning: 空洞乏味的言论或内容

morphology.text: pablum 整词作为独立词素记忆；pablum + -like → pablum-like（像空洞套话的），可描述演说内容。

etymology.text: 来自婴儿谷物食品商标 Pablum，名称与拉丁语 pabulum（食物）有关。像没有滋味的糊状食物一样，它后来被用来比喻空洞乏味的内容。

usage_note: 带批评意味，常指过分简单、缺乏思想的文字或言论；这个比喻义通常小写。

etymology_story.zh: Pablum 原是婴儿谷物食品的商标名，名称取自拉丁语 pabulum，意为“食物、饲料”。英语后来将其小写形式用于比喻经过过度简化、缺乏思想营养的内容。
etymology_story.en: Pablum began as a trademark for an infant cereal, with its name adapted from Latin pabulum, meaning food or fodder. The lowercase word later developed a disparaging figurative sense for bland, oversimplified intellectual material.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中视为不可再作有效拆分的词基 pablum，没有常用的能产前后缀结构。通常作不可数名词；Pablum 是商标形式，pabulum 是词源相关的独立英语词，并非由 pablum 派生；没有常用的标准派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, pablum is an unanalyzed base with no productive prefix–root–suffix structure. It is normally uncountable; Pablum is the trademark form, and pabulum is a separate, historically related English word rather than a derivative of pablum. There is no established common derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: platitudes（陈词滥调）强调反复出现、貌似有道理的套话；drivel（胡言废话）强调内容愚蠢或无意义；pap（乏味浅薄的内容）最接近 pablum，同样以软食比喻缺乏思想营养的内容。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Platitudes are familiar statements presented as meaningful wisdom; drivel emphasizes foolishness or meaninglessness; pap is closest to pablum, likewise suggesting intellectual material as bland and insubstantial as soft food.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“婴儿糊”想到“思想糊”：容易吞下，却没有多少值得咀嚼的内容。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think of intellectual baby food: easy to swallow, with little to chew on.

senses.meaning_zh: 帕丘科青年：尤指与20世纪三四十年代祖特服、独特俚语和青年亚文化相关的墨西哥裔美国男性青年
senses.meaning_en: A young Mexican American man associated especially with the zoot-suit subculture of the 1930s and 1940s.
senses.english_definition: A pachuco is a young Mexican American man associated with a historical youth culture known for distinctive clothing, slang, and social identity.

senses.sentence_en: The exhibition explores how the pachuco used clothing and language to express a distinct identity.

senses.meaning_zh: 帕丘科青年或其亚文化的；亦可分析为名词作定语
senses.meaning_en: Relating to pachucos or their distinctive youth culture; also used attributively as a noun.
senses.english_definition: Pachuco clothing, speech, or style is associated with the Mexican American youth culture represented by pachucos.
senses.collocation_zh: 帕丘科风格；帕丘科俚语
senses.sentence_en: The costumes draw on pachuco style, especially its broad shoulders and loose trousers.
senses.sentence_zh: 这些戏服借鉴了帕丘科风格，尤其是宽阔的肩部造型和宽松的长裤。

etymology_story.zh: 英语从墨西哥西班牙语借入 pachuco，用来指称一种具有鲜明服饰和语言特征的墨西哥裔美国青年身份。这个西班牙语词的更早来源尚不确定，不能把流行的地名关联说法当作定论。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed pachuco from Mexican Spanish to name a Mexican American youth identity marked by distinctive dress and speech. The word's earlier origin is uncertain, and popular explanations connecting it with particular place names are not established facts.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，pachuco 是整体借入的词基，不宜拆成英语词根和词缀。常用复数为 pachucos；相关借词 pachuca 指这一文化中的女性，复数为 pachucas；词尾 -o/-a 的性别对应来自西班牙语。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, pachuco is a borrowed base rather than an English root-plus-affix formation. Its regular plural is pachucos; the related borrowing pachuca denotes a woman associated with the culture, with plural pachucas. The -o/-a gender correspondence comes from Spanish.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: zoot-suiter（穿祖特服的人）按服装界定，范围不限于墨西哥裔美国人；Chicano（奇卡诺人、具有特定文化认同的墨西哥裔美国人）范围更广，不专指帕丘科亚文化；两者都不是 pachuco 的完全同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Zoot-suiter identifies someone by clothing and is not restricted to Mexican Americans; Chicano is a broader Mexican American cultural identity and does not specifically denote pachuco culture. Neither is an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 用文化画面记：宽肩长外套、宽松长裤、独特俚语，共同指向帕丘科青年。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember the cultural image: a long, broad-shouldered jacket, loose trousers, and distinctive slang.

etymology_story.zh: 英语的 paisano 主要借自西班牙语，西班牙语形式经法语 paysan 追溯到表示乡土、地区的词；英语中的同乡称呼也与意大利语 paesano 有关联。美国西南部还沿用该词称呼走鹃，这是区域性的词义发展。
etymology_story.en: English paisano comes chiefly from Spanish, whose form is traced through French paysan to words associated with one's country or locality; the English term of fellowship is also associated with Italian paesano. Its use for a roadrunner is a regional southwestern US development.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，paisano 通常作为整体借词处理，复数为 paisanos，不宜强拆为英语词根和后缀。相关形式有西班牙语阴性 paisana，以及意大利语对应词 paesano、复数 paesani；这些是相关借词或源语言形式，并非都由英语 paisano 派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English normally treats paisano as a complete borrowed base, with plural paisanos, rather than splitting it into English roots and suffixes. Related forms include Spanish feminine paisana and Italian paesano, plural paesani; these are related borrowings or source-language forms, not all English derivatives of paisano.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: compatriot（同胞）强调同一国家，语体较正式；fellow countryman（同胞）直接说明国籍联系；homeboy（老乡、哥们）更口语化，可强调同一社区或朋友圈。paisano 常带共同地域或文化背景所产生的亲切感。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Compatriot emphasizes shared nationality and is relatively formal; fellow countryman states the national connection directly; homeboy is more informal and may refer to someone from the same neighborhood or social circle. Paisano often conveys warmth based on shared regional or cultural origins.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“同一片乡土”记“老乡”；走鹃义另记为美国西南部的地方鸟名。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think “from the same home territory” for the fellowship sense; learn the roadrunner sense separately as a southwestern regional bird name.

etymology.text: 来自希腊语 panoptēs，意思是“看见一切的”。它把“全部”与“看”连在一起，后来英语用它形容全景或全面的观察。

usage_note: 较正式，既可说实际的全景视野，也可说涵盖广泛的分析；本词不等同于表示全知的 omniscient。

senses.meaning_en: Providing a view or understanding of an entire area or subject.

senses.meaning_zh: 全方位监视的；与全景敞视监控机制有关的

etymology_story.zh: panoptic 的词源核心是希腊语中表示“全部”和“看见”的成分，整体表达“看见一切”。它与边沁提出的 panopticon（全景敞视式监狱）在词源上相关，后来的社会理论进一步发展了其全面监视和规训的含义。
etymology_story.en: Panoptic combines Greek elements meaning all and seeing, expressing the idea of seeing everything. It is historically related to Bentham's panopticon, a prison designed around comprehensive observation, and later social theory developed its associations with surveillance and discipline.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词可分析为 pan-（全部）+ optic（视觉的）→ panoptic。相关词族包括 panoptical（同义形容词）、panoptically（以全面观察或全景监视的方式）、panopticon（全景敞视式建筑或监控模式，复数 panopticons）和 panopticism（全景敞视主义或监控机制）；这些词并非全都直接由 panoptic 加后缀产生。
morphology_enriched.en: The modern structure is pan- (all) + optic (relating to sight) → panoptic. The related family includes panoptical, an alternative adjective; panoptically, an adverb; panopticon, an observation-centered building or surveillance model, plural panopticons; and panopticism, the associated principle or system. These are not all formed directly by adding suffixes to panoptic.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: panoramic（全景的）主要强调开阔、连续的视觉景象；comprehensive（全面的）强调内容覆盖充分，不必涉及观看；all-seeing（无所不见的）强调观察能力，常带修辞色彩。panoptic 兼有整体视野和系统性监视的意味。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Panoramic mainly describes a broad, continuous visual scene; comprehensive emphasizes thorough coverage without necessarily involving sight; all-seeing stresses the power to observe, often rhetorically. Panoptic can suggest both an overall view and systematic surveillance.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: pan- 全部 + optic 看：一眼统观全局，也可能意味着人人处于监视之下。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Pan- means all, and optic concerns sight: see the whole scene, or keep everyone within view.

etymology_story.zh: 英语直接借用了意大利语面食名称 pappardelle，该名称与意大利语 pappare（大口吃、狼吞虎咽）有关。它把令人食欲大开的进食动作与宽带状面食联系起来，并非单纯由表示“宽”的词构成。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed the Italian pasta name pappardelle, which is related to pappare, meaning to gobble or eat eagerly. The name connects the pasta with hearty eating rather than simply deriving from a word meaning wide.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中视为整体借词 pappardelle，没有常用的英语派生词族。它在意大利语中是复数，单数为 pappardella；英语通常把 pappardelle 当作食品名称使用，不另加 -s，相关源动词 pappare 也不是英语词内可自由使用的词根。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats pappardelle as a complete borrowing with no established common English derivational family. It is plural in Italian, with singular pappardella; English usually uses pappardelle as a food name without adding -s. The related Italian verb pappare is not a productive root within English.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: ribbon pasta（带状意大利面）是上位类别；tagliatelle（意式扁长面）通常比 pappardelle 窄；fettuccine（意式细宽面）也是带状面，通常同样较窄。后两者是相近面食品种，不是严格同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Ribbon pasta is the broader category; tagliatelle is generally narrower than pappardelle; fettuccine is another ribbon pasta that is also usually narrower. The latter two are related pasta types rather than exact synonyms.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Link pappare, “to gobble,” with broad ribbons of pasta ready for a hearty meal.

etymology_story.zh: 这是由希腊语来源的 para-（在旁；超出通常范围）与 -philia（喜爱；倾向）组成的现代学术术语，后来用于描述非典型的性兴趣。该词所指的兴趣本身并不必然构成障碍。
etymology_story.en: This modern learned term combines Greek-derived para-, meaning 'beside' or 'beyond the usual,' with -philia, meaning 'love' or 'inclination,' and came to describe atypical sexual interests. The interest denoted by the word does not necessarily constitute a disorder.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：para-（超出通常范围）+ -philia（喜爱；倾向）。词族：paraphilias（名词复数），paraphilic（形容词：非典型性兴趣的），paraphiliac（名词：有此类兴趣的人；亦可作形容词）；描述人时，person with a paraphilia（有非典型性兴趣的人）更少带有标签化色彩。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: para- ('beyond the usual') + -philia ('love; inclination'). Word family: paraphilias (plural), paraphilic (adjective), and paraphiliac (noun for a person with such an interest, also used adjectivally); 'person with a paraphilia' is a less labeling expression.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: atypical sexual interest（非典型性兴趣）是最直接、中性的释义；atypical sexual preference（非典型性偏好）更强调偏好；sexual variation（性兴趣或行为的差异）范围更广，并非严格同义词。paraphilic disorder（性偏好障碍）不能直接当作本词的同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Atypical sexual interest is the most direct, neutral paraphrase; atypical sexual preference emphasizes preference; sexual variation is broader and is not an exact synonym. Paraphilic disorder is not interchangeable with paraphilia.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: para-＝偏离通常，-philia＝喜好：记住“非典型的性兴趣”，不要自动等同于障碍。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Para- suggests departure from the usual, and -philia means an inclination: remember an atypical sexual interest, without automatically equating it with a disorder.

etymology_story.zh: 英语将源于拉丁语 pater（父亲）的构词成分 patri- 与 lateral（侧面的）组合，形成表示“父亲这一侧”的亲属术语。它标明亲属关系来自父方，并不表示世系必须逐代通过男性传承。
etymology_story.en: English formed this kinship term from patri-, derived from Latin pater ('father'), and lateral ('of the side'). It identifies the father's side of a family without requiring descent to pass exclusively through men.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：patri-（父亲）+ lateral（侧面的）；lateral 本身可分析为 later-（侧）+ -al（……的）。词族：patrilaterally（副词：在父方一侧），patrilaterality（名词：父方关系或父方取向，专业用语）；matrilateral（母方的）是对应词，patrilineal（父系传承的）是相关词，均不是由本词直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: patri- ('father') + lateral ('of the side'); lateral itself contains later- ('side') + -al (adjective suffix). Word family: patrilaterally (adverb) and patrilaterality (a specialist noun for a patrilateral relationship or orientation). Matrilateral is its maternal counterpart, while patrilineal is a related term rather than a direct derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: paternal（父亲的；父方的）含义更广，还可指父亲般的关爱；on the father's side（在父亲这一方）是最清楚的日常表达；patrilineal（父系传承的）强调通过男性连续追溯世系，与 patrilateral 不完全相同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Paternal is broader and can also describe fatherly care; on the father's side is the clearest everyday equivalent; patrilineal specifically concerns descent traced through men and is not an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: patri-＝父亲，lateral＝一侧：家谱上“爸爸这一边”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Patri- means father and lateral means side: picture the father's side of a family tree.

etymology_story.zh: 本词经中世纪拉丁语追溯到希腊语 perikardion，指心脏周围的包膜，其中 peri- 意为“周围”，kardia 意为“心脏”。英语保留了这一解剖学含义，用来指包围心脏的心包。
etymology_story.en: The word comes through Medieval Latin from Greek perikardion, referring to the covering around the heart, with peri- meaning 'around' and kardia meaning 'heart.' English retained this anatomical meaning for the sac surrounding the heart.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代医学构词分析：peri-（周围）+ cardi-（心脏）+ -um（拉丁化名词词尾）；组合形式为 pericardi/o-（心包）。常见词族及同词干术语：pericardia（复数），pericardial（心包的），pericarditis（心包炎），pericardiectomy（心包切除术），pericardiotomy（心包切开术），pericardiocentesis（心包穿刺术）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern medical analysis: peri- ('around') + cardi- ('heart') + -um (a Latinized noun ending); the combining form is pericardi/o- ('pericardium'). Common family members and shared-stem terms include pericardia (plural), pericardial, pericarditis, pericardiectomy, pericardiotomy, and pericardiocentesis.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: pericardial sac（心包囊）是明确的解剖学同义表达，突出囊状结构；heart sac（心脏外的囊）是较通俗的解释性说法。两者都指心包，而不是心脏的肌肉壁。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Pericardial sac is an explicit anatomical equivalent emphasizing the sac-like structure; heart sac is a less technical explanatory expression. Both refer to the surrounding sac rather than the muscular wall of the heart.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: peri-＝围绕，cardi-＝心脏：围在心脏外的“保护囊”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Peri- means around and cardi- means heart: picture the protective sac around the heart.

usage_note: 指强调人与自然环境协调的农业设计方法；不是所有不施化肥的做法都自动等同于 permaculture。

senses.meaning_zh: 永续农业；借鉴自然生态系统的可持续土地利用与生活设计体系
senses.meaning_en: A system of sustainable land use and living designed around the relationships found in natural ecosystems.
senses.english_definition: Permaculture is a way of designing farms, gardens, and places to live so that plants, animals, people, and resources work together sustainably.
senses.collocation_zh: 永续设计；永续农业原则
senses.sentence_en: They used permaculture principles to design a garden that collects rainwater and produces food.

etymology_story.zh: Bill Mollison 与 David Holmgren 在20世纪70年代将 permanent agriculture（可长期维持的农业）缩合为 permaculture。随着理念发展，该词的范围扩展到土地利用、聚落与生活方式设计，并常用 permanent culture（可持续延续的生活文化）来说明这一扩展。
etymology_story.en: Bill Mollison and David Holmgren coined permaculture in the 1970s as a blend of permanent agriculture. Its scope later expanded to land use, settlements, and ways of living, an extension often expressed as permanent culture.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：perma(nent)（持久的）+ (agri)culture（农业），属于截取两词部分成分的混成构词，并非 per- 加普通后缀。词族：permacultural（形容词：永续农业的），permaculturist（名词：永续农业实践者），permaculturalist（实践者，另一形式）；permaculture 通常作不可数名词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern formation: perma(nent) + (agri)culture, a blend made from parts of two words rather than a prefix-plus-suffix construction. Word family: permacultural (adjective), permaculturist (a practitioner), and permaculturalist (an alternative practitioner noun). Permaculture is normally uncountable.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sustainable agriculture（可持续农业）是更广的目标与实践类别；agroecology（农业生态学）侧重生态学原理及其在农业中的应用；regenerative agriculture（再生农业）强调恢复土壤与生态健康。三者与 permaculture 有交集，但 permaculture 更突出整体系统设计，也涵盖农业以外的生活安排。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sustainable agriculture is a broader category of goals and practices; agroecology emphasizes ecological principles and their application to agriculture; regenerative agriculture emphasizes restoring soil and ecosystem health. All overlap with permaculture, which particularly stresses integrated system design and also extends beyond farming.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: permanent + agriculture：让农业像生态系统一样长期运转，再把这种设计思路扩展到生活。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Permanent + agriculture: design farming to keep working like an ecosystem, then extend that thinking to everyday living.

etymology_story.zh: 本词来自新拉丁语 peroneus，最终源于希腊语 peronē，原义为“别针”，也用于指腓骨。以别针命名细长骨骼的比喻，后来延伸到与腓骨及小腿外侧有关的肌肉、肌腱和神经。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from New Latin peroneus, ultimately from Greek peronē, meaning 'pin' and also used for the fibula. This comparison with a slender pin extended to the muscles, tendons, and nerves associated with the fibula and the outer lower leg.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代医学构词分析：perone-（腓骨）+ -al（……的）；相关组合形式为 perone/o-。同词干词族包括 peroneus（腓骨肌，常见于肌肉拉丁名称）及其复数 peronei（腓骨肌群）；peroneal 本身没有常用的动词或副词派生形式。fibular（腓骨的）是同义形容词，词根来源不同。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern medical analysis: perone- ('fibula') + -al (adjective suffix); a related combining form is perone/o-. Shared-stem family members include peroneus, used in Latin muscle names, and its plural peronei. Peroneal has no commonly used verb or adverb derivatives. Fibular is a synonymous adjective formed from a different root.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: fibular（腓骨的）是最接近的解剖学同义词，例如 common fibular nerve 与 common peroneal nerve 均指腓总神经；lateral（外侧的）只表示相对位置，范围更广，不能在具体解剖名称中随意替换 peroneal。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Fibular is the closest anatomical synonym: common fibular nerve and common peroneal nerve name the same nerve. Lateral merely specifies an outer-side position, is much broader, and cannot freely replace peroneal in anatomical names.

mnemonic_anchor.en: The historical root means 'pin': picture the slender fibula on the outer side of the lower leg as a long pin.

etymology_story.en: This modern scientific name combines elements meaning phenyl, propane, alcohol, and amine. Its structural chemical name also became the name of the compound as a drug. [Etymology reference: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/phenylpropanolamine).

morphology_enriched.zh: 结构式拆解：phenyl（苯基）+ propan-（丙烷骨架）+ -ol（醇，指羟基）+ amine（胺，指氨基）→ phenylpropanolamine。这里是化学命名成分的组合，不是普通英语词缀的自由叠加；常用缩写为 PPA，相关形式有 phenylpropanolamine hydrochloride（盐酸苯丙醇胺），没有常用的动词、副词或独立派生形容词。
morphology_enriched.en: Structural breakdown: phenyl + propan- (a propane framework) + -ol (an alcohol group) + amine (an amino group). These are chemical naming elements rather than freely combined everyday English affixes; the usual abbreviation is PPA, and a related expression is phenylpropanolamine hydrochloride. There are no common derived verbs, adverbs, or independent adjectives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: PPA（苯丙醇胺的缩写）是同一名称的简写；phenylpropanolamine hydrochloride（盐酸苯丙醇胺）明确指其盐酸盐，并不严格等同于游离碱；sympathomimetic（拟交感神经药）是包含它在内的药物类别名称，范围更广。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: PPA abbreviates the same name; phenylpropanolamine hydrochloride specifies its hydrochloride salt rather than strictly the free base; sympathomimetic names the broader drug class rather than this particular compound.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 苯基 + 三碳骨架 + 醇羟基 + 胺基：长名称就是一张结构提示卡。

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代结构可记作 phor-（分类名称词干）+ -id（动物分类中表示某科成员或属性的结尾）；对应科名为 Phoridae（蚤蝇科），其分类命名基础是属名 Phora。名词复数为 phorids（多只蚤蝇）；常见组合有 phorid fly（蚤蝇）和 phorid larva（蚤蝇幼虫），没有常用动词或副词派生形式。

morphology_enriched.zh: 直接构词：physiatr-（physiatrics 去掉 -ics 后的词干）+ -ist（专业人员）→ physiatrist；进一步可分析为 physi-（自然、身体）+ -iatr-（医治）+ -ist（从业者）。核心词族包括 physiatry（康复医学）、physiatrics（物理医学）、physiatric（康复医学的）和 physiatrists（康复医学科医师，复数）。
morphology_enriched.en: Immediate formation: physiatr- (the stem of physiatrics without -ics) + -ist (a specialist). Its standard plural is usually pice; the related form paisa comes from the same South Asian naming tradition rather than being an English derivative of pice. synonyms_and_nuances.en: Paisa overlaps with pice in some historical uses but may have a different value in modern decimal systems; copper coin describes material and coin type without specifying denomination; small change refers broadly to low-value coins rather than this historical unit.

etymology_story.zh: pigweed 是 pig（猪）与 weed（杂草）构成的英语复合词，约在十八世纪末至十九世纪初已有记录。它发展为多种植物共用的俗名，所以不能仅凭这个名称认定某一物种。[词源与义项参考：Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/pigweed)。

It became a shared common name for several plants, so the name alone does not establish a particular species. [Etymology and sense reference: Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/pigweed).

morphology_enriched.zh: pig（猪）+ weed（杂草）→ pigweed，属于名词加名词的复合构词。pigweed 可作集合性或不可数名词，也可按植株或种类计数，复数为 pigweeds；常见复合名称包括 redroot pigweed（反枝苋）、smooth pigweed（杂交苋）和 prostrate pigweed（匍匐苋）。这些是植物名称组合，没有常用的派生动词或副词。

Pigweed can be collective or uncountable, while pigweeds can refer to individual plants or kinds; common compound names include redroot pigweed, smooth pigweed, and prostrate pigweed. These are plant-name combinations, with no common derived verbs or adverbs.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代学术构词可分析为 pir-（梨）+ -iform（……形的）→ piriform（梨形的），也可教学性地写作 piri- + -form。相关形式包括异拼 pyriform（梨形的）及解剖学相关词 piriformis（梨状肌）；piriform cortex（梨状皮质）可省略为名词 piriform。
morphology_enriched.en: The learned structure can be analyzed as pir- meaning pear + -iform meaning shaped, giving piriform; piri- + -form is an alternative teaching breakdown. synonyms_and_nuances.zh: pear-shaped（梨形的）是日常表达；pyriform（梨形的）与 piriform 是同义异拼；teardrop-shaped（泪滴形的）强调一端尖细，与梨形接近但并不完全相同。名词义最准确的对应语是 piriform cortex（梨状皮质）。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Pear-shaped is the everyday equivalent; pyriform is an alternative spelling with the same meaning. Teardrop-shaped emphasizes a pointed end and is only an approximate match. For the noun sense, piriform cortex is the exact expanded term.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 梨 + 形：想象一端鼓圆、另一端收窄的梨；脑区义再联想到“梨状皮质”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Pear + shape: picture a rounded base narrowing toward the top; connect the brain sense with piriform cortex.

etymology_story.zh: pissant 由 piss“尿”与 ant“蚂蚁”组成，原是蚂蚁的俗称，后来发展为对无足轻重的人或事物的蔑称。现代英语也把它用作形容词，表示“微不足道而可鄙的”。[来源：柯林斯词典](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/pissant)
etymology_story.en: Pissant combines piss and ant and originally served as a popular name for an ant. It later became an insult for someone or something insignificant and also developed an adjective meaning contemptibly unimportant. [Source: Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/pissant)

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：piss（尿，粗俗）+ ant（蚂蚁）→ pissant；名词复数为 pissants（无足轻重的人或事物），形容词用法形式不变，另有连字符异拼 piss-ant。没有常用的标准副词或抽象名词派生形式；旧时“蚂蚁”义不属于现代通用核心义。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: piss + ant → pissant. The plural noun is pissants; the adjective has the same form, and piss-ant is a hyphenated variant. There are no common standard adverbial or abstract-noun derivatives; the old literal ant sense is outside the modern general core.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: nobody（无名小卒）强调缺乏名望或地位，通常没有同等粗俗色彩；small fry（小人物）常作集合称呼，强调权力或影响力小；petty（琐碎的；心胸狭窄的）可对应部分形容词义，但还可能指计较小事。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Nobody emphasizes a lack of status or recognition without the same vulgar force. Small fry often collectively describes people with little power; petty overlaps with the adjective but can also suggest narrow-minded concern with minor matters.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“小蚂蚁”到“小人物”：词义核心是带蔑视地把人或事物说得微不足道。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Tiny ant → insignificant person or thing: the central idea is contemptuous smallness.

morphology.text: pone 整词作为独立词素记忆；pone + -like → pone-like（像玉米面饼的），可描述烘烤食品。

etymology.text: 来自弗吉尼亚阿尔冈昆语的 appone，经借用和缩短形成英语 pone。把这个美洲本土语言传来的名称与烤制的玉米面饼一起记。

usage_note: 主要是美国南部和中部地区的食物名称，指一种玉米面饼；不同家庭的做法可能不同。

etymology_story.zh: 食品义的 pone 来自弗吉尼亚阿尔冈昆语 appone，借入英语后保留了美洲原住民玉米面包的名称。纸牌义是来源不同的同形词，来自拉丁语 pōne“放下！”，即动词 pōnere“放置”的命令式。[来源：韦氏词典（食品义）](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/pone)；[柯林斯词典（纸牌义）](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/pone)
etymology_story.en: The food word comes from Virginia Algonquian appone, preserving an Indigenous American name for maize bread. The card-playing word has a separate origin in Latin pōne, meaning put down!, the imperative of pōnere, meaning to place. [Sources: Merriam-Webster, food sense](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/pone); [Collins Dictionary, card sense](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/pone)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，两种来源的 pone 都作为独立词基使用，不能按英语前后缀拆分；可数用法的复数为 pones。食品相关形式包括 corn pone、合写 cornpone 和 pone bread，均指玉米面包或面饼；两种词义都没有常用的派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Both independently originating words function as simple bases in modern English, without productive internal English affixes; countable uses take the plural pones. Food-related forms include corn pone, cornpone, and pone bread. Neither word has a common derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: corn pone（玉米面饼）是食品义最直接的同义表达；cornbread（玉米面包）范围更广，涵盖多种配方与形态。纸牌义中，nondealer（非发牌方）只在双人牌局中与 pone 准确对应。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Corn pone is the closest equivalent for the food sense; cornbread is broader and covers many recipes and forms. For the card sense, nondealer is an exact equivalent specifically in a two-player game.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 分开记两个来源：餐桌上的 pone 是玉米饼；牌桌上的 pone 是特定座位的玩家，双人局中就是非发牌方。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep two origins separate: at the dinner table, pone is corn bread; at the card table, pone identifies a player's position or the nondealer.

etymology_story.zh: 该词由 pot 与 hunter 复合而成：pot 可指烹饪用的锅，也曾用于指奖杯，因此产生了“为食物打猎者”和“逐奖者”等义项。在考古语境中，pot 又使人联想到古代陶器，该词遂用于指私挖古物者。
etymology_story.en: The word combines pot and hunter: pot can refer to a cooking vessel and has also been used for a trophy, supporting the food-hunting and prize-seeking senses. In archaeological use, the association with ancient pottery supports the sense of someone who digs for collectible artifacts.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：pot（锅；奖杯；陶罐）+ hunter〔hunt（打猎；搜寻）+ -er（从事者）〕。主要相关形式：pothunt（为食物打猎；搜寻古物）、pothunting（相应活动）；也见连字符拼写 pot-hunter、pot-hunting。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: pot (cooking vessel, trophy, or pottery vessel) + hunter, itself hunt + the agent suffix -er. Main related forms include pothunt and pothunting; hyphenated spellings include pot-hunter and pot-hunting.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: subsistence hunter 指为维持生计而狩猎的人，通常不含贬义；prize hunter 强调追逐奖项；looter 强调掠夺或盗取财物，在考古语境中可与 pothunter 接近，但不专指搜寻陶器或古物。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: A subsistence hunter hunts to meet basic needs and is usually described neutrally; a prize hunter seeks awards; a looter steals or plunders property and overlaps with the archaeological sense without specifically suggesting pottery or artifact collecting.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 盯着 pot 去 hunt：锅里要食物，赛场要奖杯，遗址要陶罐。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Hunt for the pot: food for a cooking pot, prizes for a trophy cabinet, or pottery from an ancient site.

senses.meaning_zh: 器官向前突出，尤指眼球突出

senses.english_definition: Proptosis is a condition in which an organ, especially an eyeball, projects forward beyond its normal position.

senses.sentence_en: The examination revealed mild proptosis of the left eye.

etymology_story.zh: 该词经医学拉丁语源于希腊语 próptōsis，原义为“向前倒落”，与 pro-（向前）和表示“落下”的词根有关。医学用法将这一空间意象用于器官向前移位或突出，尤其是眼球突出。
etymology_story.en: The word comes through medical Latin from Greek próptōsis, meaning a falling forward, with pro- meaning forward and a base associated with falling. Medical usage applies this spatial idea to forward displacement or protrusion, especially of the eyeball.

morphology_enriched.zh: 学术词素分析：pro-（向前）+ -ptosis（落下；移位）；整个术语的意思是“向前突出”，不能机械译成“向前下垂”。主要相关形式：proptotic（突出的；眼球突出的）、proptosed（已突出的）；复数为 proptoses。
morphology_enriched.en: Learned structure: pro- (forward) + -ptosis (falling or displacement); the established term means forward protrusion, rather than simply forward drooping. Main related forms are proptotic and proptosed; the plural is proptoses.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: protrusion 是一般性的“突出”，不限器官；exophthalmos 专指眼球突出，与眼部 proptosis 常可互换，但常见于甲状腺相关眼病语境；displacement 泛指位置改变，不一定朝前。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Protrusion is a general term for projecting outward; exophthalmos specifically concerns protruding eyeballs and often overlaps with ocular proptosis, especially in thyroid-related contexts; displacement means a change of position in any direction.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: pro- 指向前：把眼球想成向前移出了正常位置。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Let pro- point forward: picture an eyeball displaced forward from its normal position.

senses.english_definition: The psoas is a deep muscle that runs from the lower spine toward the thigh and helps you bend at the hip.

etymology_story.zh: 该词经新拉丁语源于希腊语 psóa，意为“腰部；腰部肌肉”；psoas 保留了希腊语属格 psóas 的形式。它在解剖学中成为腰部深层肌肉的名称。
etymology_story.en: The word entered anatomical vocabulary through New Latin from Greek psóa, meaning the loin or its muscle; psoas preserves the Greek genitive form psóas. It became the anatomical name for a deep muscle of the lower back.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中把 psoas 作为完整的解剖学词基，不拆成英语前缀和词根。主要相关形式：psoatic（腰肌的）；复合词 iliopsoas = ilio-（髂骨的）+ psoas，指髂腰肌；psoas major 和 psoas minor 分别指腰大肌和腰小肌。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, psoas is a whole anatomical base rather than a combination of English prefixes and roots. Related forms include psoatic (relating to the psoas) and iliopsoas, formed from ilio- (ilium) + psoas; psoas major and psoas minor name the larger and smaller muscles respectively.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: psoas major 是日常解剖或运动语境中 psoas 常指的腰大肌；iliopsoas 指腰大肌与髂肌组成的肌群，范围更广；hip flexor 是功能类别“髋屈肌”，还包括其他参与屈髋的肌肉。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Psoas major is the specific muscle usually intended by psoas in everyday anatomical or exercise contexts; iliopsoas denotes the combined psoas major and iliacus; hip flexor is a broader functional category that includes other muscles.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“腰部”定位：深藏腰腹、连接脊柱与大腿的抬腿肌；开头的 p 不发音。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor it to the loin: a deep muscle linking spine and thigh to help lift the leg; the initial p is silent.

etymology.text: 由源自希腊语的 psycho-（心灵）与 kinesis（运动）组成，进入英语后用于描述所谓以心灵力量影响物体的能力。

senses.meaning_zh: 意念致动；所谓以心灵力量影响物体或物理过程的能力
senses.meaning_en: the supposed ability to affect objects or physical events through mental power
senses.english_definition: Psychokinesis is the supposed ability to move objects or influence physical events using only the power of your mind.
senses.collocation_en: claims of psychokinesis; experiments on psychokinesis
senses.collocation_zh: 有关意念致动的声称；关于意念致动的实验

senses.sentence_zh: 影片主角利用意念致动，让物体在房间里移动。

etymology_story.zh: 该词由源自希腊语的 psycho-（心灵）与 kínēsis（运动）组合而成，字面意思是“心灵引发的运动”。它后来成为超心理学术语，用来描述所谓心灵直接影响物质的能力。
etymology_story.en: The word combines Greek-derived psycho- (mind) with kínēsis (movement), literally suggesting movement produced by the mind. It became a term in parapsychology for the supposed direct influence of mental activity on matter.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：psycho-（心灵；心理）+ kinesis（运动）。主要词族：psychokinetic（意念致动的）、psychokinetically（以意念致动方式）；常用缩写为 PK。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: psycho- (mind or mental activity) + kinesis (movement). The main word family includes psychokinetic and psychokinetically; PK is a common abbreviation.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: telekinesis 常与 psychokinesis 互用，但更突出“隔空移动物体”；mind over matter 是较宽泛的表达，也可指意志克服身体限制；ESP 指所谓超感官知觉，侧重获取信息，与影响物质的 psychokinesis 不同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Telekinesis is often interchangeable with psychokinesis but more specifically suggests moving objects at a distance; mind over matter is broader and can describe willpower overcoming physical limits; ESP concerns supposedly obtaining information rather than influencing matter.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: psycho- 是心灵，kinesis 是运动：心念一动，物体跟着动。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Psycho- means mind and kinesis means movement: imagine a thought making an object move.

senses.english_definition: A pupfish is a small fish of a group that includes species living in isolated springs and other waters in North America.
senses.collocation_zh: 沙漠鳉；魔鬼洞鳉
senses.sentence_en: The spring supports a small population of pupfish.

etymology_story.zh: 该词由 pup（幼犬）与 fish（鱼）复合而成，其名称通常被解释为与这些鱼活泼、嬉闹般的活动有关。这个形象化名称后来用于若干类小型鳉鱼，尤其是北美的相关种类。
etymology_story.en: The name combines pup and fish and is commonly explained as referring to the fishes' lively, seemingly playful movements. This descriptive name came to be used for several small killifishes, especially North American species.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：pup（幼犬）+ fish（鱼），属于名词复合词；单复数通常同形，均为 pupfish。没有常用的直接派生词；desert pupfish、Devils Hole pupfish 等是具体鱼类的复合名称。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: pup (young dog) + fish, forming a compound noun; the usual singular and plural forms are both pupfish. There are no common direct derivatives; desert pupfish and Devils Hole pupfish are compound names for particular fishes.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: killifish 是范围更广的“鳉鱼”通称，pupfish 属于其中的一部分；Cyprinodon 是许多 pupfish 所属的鲤齿鳉属的学名，并非所有用法中都能直接替换 pupfish；minnow 常泛指小鱼，但并不是 pupfish 的准确分类同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Killifish is a broader common name that includes pupfish; Cyprinodon is the scientific genus containing many pupfishes and is not an interchangeable name in every context; minnow can loosely mean a small fish but is not an exact taxonomic synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: pup + fish：把活泼游动的小鳉鱼想成水里的小狗。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Pup + fish: picture a tiny fish darting about like a playful puppy.

senses.meaning_zh: 气功；结合调息、姿势或动作及专注的中国传统身心练习
senses.meaning_en: A traditional Chinese practice combining controlled breathing, posture or movement, and mental concentration.
senses.english_definition: Qigong is a traditional Chinese practice in which you combine controlled breathing with particular postures or movements and mental concentration.
senses.collocation_zh: 练气功；气功练习
senses.sentence_en: She practises qigong in the park every morning.
senses.sentence_zh: 她每天早晨都在公园里练气功。

etymology_story.zh: 借自汉语普通话“气功”的拼音 qìgōng，其中“气”指呼吸或传统观念中的生命之气，“功”指通过练习获得的功夫或技能。英语借入该词，用来统称这类中国传统身心练习。
etymology_story.en: Qigong comes from Mandarin Chinese qìgōng, combining qì, meaning breath or vital energy in traditional Chinese thought, with gōng, meaning skill developed through practice. English borrowed the term for these traditional Chinese mind-and-body practices.

morphology_enriched.zh: 来源语言结构：qi（气）＋ gong（功）；在现代英语中通常视为不可进一步进行英语词缀分析的借词，而不是英语前缀与词根的组合。通常用作不可数名词，没有常用的英语派生词；qi gong 和 chi kung 是相关拼写形式，qigong practitioner 指“气功练习者”。
morphology_enriched.en: Source-language structure: qi, breath or vital energy, + gong, cultivated skill. In modern English, qigong is normally treated as an unanalysed loanword and an uncountable noun, with no established everyday derivatives; qi gong and chi kung are alternative spellings, and qigong practitioner is a related phrase.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: breathing exercises（呼吸练习）只突出调息，范围更广；meditative movement（冥想式运动）强调专注与动作的结合；tai chi（太极拳）是一种独立的中国武术与身心练习，虽与气功有重叠，但不能完全互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Breathing exercises emphasize breath control and cover a broader range of practices; meditative movement emphasizes movement combined with focused awareness; tai chi is a distinct Chinese martial art and mind-and-body practice that overlaps with qigong but is not an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 气＋功：通过调息与练习积累身心功夫。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Qi + gong: cultivate skill through breath, attention, and practice.

etymology_story.zh: 源自北美阿尔冈昆语族中的纳拉甘西特语 poquauhock，即当地一种硬壳蛤的名称。英语借入并缩短了这个名称，后来又由名词发展出“采捕这种蛤”的动词用法。
etymology_story.en: Quahog comes from Narragansett poquauhock, an Indigenous Algonquian name for the hard clam. English shortened the borrowed name and later also used it as a verb meaning to collect these clams.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 quahog 是不可进一步拆分的借词词根；名词复数为 quahogs，名词可通过零派生转为动词。动词形式为 quahogs、quahogged、quahogging；quahog＋-er 构成 quahogger（采蛤者），后两类形式在相应词尾前双写 g。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, quahog is an unanalysed borrowed base; its noun plural is quahogs, and the verb is formed by conversion without an added suffix. Verb forms are quahogs, quahogged, and quahogging; quahog + -er gives quahogger, a person who gathers quahogs, with final g doubled before -ed, -ing, and -er.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: hard clam（硬壳蛤）是最直接的常用同义名称；clam（蛤）范围更广，包含许多其他种类；littleneck（小规格圆蛤）在北美海鲜语境中常指较小规格的圆蛤，不适用于所有大小的圆蛤。动词可用 dig for clams（挖蛤）或 gather clams（采蛤）解释，但这两个表达不限定圆蛤。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Hard clam is the closest everyday equivalent; clam is a broader term covering many species; littleneck often denotes a small market-size quahog in North American seafood usage, rather than quahogs of every size. For the verb, dig for clams and gather clams describe the activity but do not specify quahogs.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 整词对应“硬壳圆蛤”；名词变动词，就是“去挖这种蛤”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor the whole word to a hard clam: the noun names it, and the verb means gathering it.

senses.meaning_zh: 舌下囊肿；口底因唾液积聚而形成的囊样肿胀
senses.meaning_en: A saliva-filled, cystlike swelling in the floor of the mouth.
senses.english_definition: A ranula is a swelling under the tongue that forms when saliva collects in the surrounding tissue or in a cyst.
senses.collocation_zh: 口内型舌下囊肿；潜突型舌下囊肿
senses.sentence_en: The specialist identified the swelling under her tongue as a ranula.
senses.sentence_zh: 专科医生确认她舌下的肿块是舌下囊肿。

etymology_story.zh: 来自拉丁语 ranula，字面义为“小蛙”，由 rana（蛙）加指小后缀构成。这个名称因舌下肿胀的外观被比作小蛙或蛙腹而进入医学用语。
etymology_story.en: Ranula comes from Latin ranula, meaning little frog, a diminutive of rana, frog. The name entered medical usage because the swelling beneath the tongue was compared in appearance to a small frog or a frog’s belly.

morphology_enriched.zh: 历史结构为拉丁语 ran-（来自 rana，蛙）＋-ula（指小后缀）；现代英语中通常将 ranula 作为完整医学词根学习。复数为 ranulas 或 ranulae；相关形容词 ranular 表示“舌下囊肿的”，可分析为 ranul-＋-ar。
morphology_enriched.en: Historically, the Latin formation is ran-, from rana, frog, + the diminutive suffix -ula; modern English normally treats ranula as a complete medical base. The plurals are ranulas and ranulae; the related adjective ranular, meaning relating to a ranula, can be analysed as ranul- + -ar.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sublingual mucocele（舌下黏液囊肿）是最接近的描述性对应词；mucocele（黏液囊肿）范围更广，可发生于其他部位；salivary pseudocyst（唾液假性囊肿）强调唾液外溢后形成、缺乏上皮衬里的病变结构，适用于许多舌下囊肿，但不是所有病例的严格同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sublingual mucocele is the closest descriptive equivalent; mucocele is broader and includes lesions at other sites; salivary pseudocyst emphasizes an extravasation lesion without an epithelial lining and describes many ranulas, but is not an exact equivalent for every case.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: rana＝蛙，-ula＝小：舌下鼓起一个“小蛙肚”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Rana means frog and -ula means little: picture a little frog-like bulge beneath the tongue.

etymology_story.zh: rifampin 是由 rifamycin（利福霉素）这一抗生素名称改造而来的现代药名，体现了它与利福霉素类药物的联系。它主要用于美国命名体系，同一种药在国际上也称 rifampicin。
etymology_story.en: Rifampin is a modern drug name formed by modifying rifamycin, reflecting its relationship to the rifamycin group of antibiotics. It is principally the US name for the drug also known internationally as rifampicin.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中应将 rifampin 作为完整药名学习，不宜把它硬拆为有独立意义的普通英语词根和词缀。rifampicin 是同一种药的另一名称，rifamycin 是相关药物类别名称；常见复合形式有 rifampin-resistant（耐利福平的）、rifampin-sensitive（对利福平敏感的）和 rifampin resistance（利福平耐药性）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, rifampin is best learned as a complete drug name rather than divided into ordinary English roots and affixes. Rifampicin is an alternative name for the same drug, while rifamycin names the related antibiotic class; common compounds include rifampin-resistant, rifampin-sensitive, and rifampin resistance.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: rifampicin（利福平）是同一种药的另一通用名称，差异主要在命名体系；rifamycin（利福霉素）指相关抗生素类别，不能直接替换具体药名；antibiotic（抗生素）是更宽泛的上位词，不指定具体药物。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Rifampicin is an alternative generic name for the same drug, with the difference mainly reflecting naming conventions; rifamycin refers to the related antibiotic class and is not interchangeable with the specific drug name; antibiotic is a much broader category term.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 rifampin 与 rifamycin 连在一起记：利福霉素家族中的利福平。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link rifampin to rifamycin: a specific antibiotic in the rifamycin family.
