senses.meaning_zh: 清真寺；穆斯林礼拜场所
senses.meaning_en: A mosque; a Muslim place of worship.
senses.english_definition: A masjid is a building where Muslims gather to pray.
senses.collocation_en: the local masjid; attend prayers at the masjid
senses.collocation_zh: 当地的清真寺；到清真寺参加礼拜
senses.sentence_en: They gathered at the local masjid for Friday prayers.
senses.sentence_zh: 他们聚集在当地的清真寺参加主麻日礼拜。

etymology_story.zh: 英语 masjid 借自阿拉伯语 masjid，字面意思是“叩拜之所”，与表示“叩拜”的动词 sajada 同源。它在英语中保留了宗教场所的含义，常见于穆斯林社群的表达。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed masjid from Arabic masjid, literally a place of prostration, related to the verb sajada, meaning to prostrate oneself. In English it retains its religious meaning and is especially used within Muslim communities.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 masjid 通常视为不可再分的借词；复数为 masjids，也使用阿拉伯语复数 masajid。源语言构词为词根 s-j-d（叩拜）套入地点名词格式 maCCiC → masjid；这是阿拉伯语构词，不是英语前后缀分析。相关英语词 mosque（清真寺）与它最终同源，但不是 masjid 在英语中的派生词；没有常用的英语前后缀派生词。未指定未经核实的 CEFR 等级或考试标签。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, masjid is normally treated as an unanalysed loanword; its plurals are masjids and the borrowed Arabic form masajid. In Arabic, the root s-j-d, associated with prostration, fits the place-noun pattern maCCiC to form masjid; this is Arabic morphology, not English affixation. Mosque ultimately shares its origin but is not an English derivative of masjid; there are no common English affixal derivatives. No unverified CEFR level or examination tag is assigned.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: mosque（清真寺）是通用英语中最直接的对应词；musalla（穆斯林礼拜处）通常指礼拜空间或场地，不一定是专门建造的清真寺。masjid 与 mosque 通常可指同一建筑，但前者保留阿拉伯语名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Mosque is the closest equivalent in general English. Musalla usually denotes a Muslim prayer space or prayer ground and need not be a purpose-built mosque; masjid and mosque commonly refer to the same building, with masjid retaining the Arabic term.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 词根表示“叩拜”，地点格式表示“所在之处”：叩拜之所就是清真寺。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Prostration plus a place pattern gives a place of prayer: a masjid.

meaning: 帕拉第奥；意大利建筑师安德烈亚·帕拉第奥

pronunciation.note: 采用 Collins 所列意大利语姓名读法，重音在 la 音节。

forms: 专有姓名，无普通复数；形容词 Palladian。
family: Palladian 帕拉第奥式的；Palladianism 帕拉第奥式建筑风格。

morphology.text: Palladio 整词作为独立词素记忆；Palladi- + -an → Palladian（帕拉第奥式的），派生时把姓名末尾 o 换成 -an。

etymology.text: 这是建筑师在意大利使用的名字，由他的赞助人 Trissino 为他取用；该名让人联想到智慧女神 Pallas Athena。用“智慧与建筑”连起人名。

usage_note: 人名首字母必须大写。本课指建筑师本人；Palladian 才是形容词，表示他的建筑风格。

senses.meaning_zh: 帕拉第奥；意大利文艺复兴建筑师安德烈亚·帕拉第奥
senses.meaning_en: Andrea Palladio, an Italian Renaissance architect.
senses.english_definition: Palladio was an Italian Renaissance architect whose buildings and writings strongly influenced later classical architecture.
senses.collocation_en: Palladio's villas; the architecture of Palladio
senses.collocation_zh: 帕拉第奥的别墅建筑；帕拉第奥的建筑

etymology_story.zh: 帕拉第奥原名 Andrea di Pietro della Gondola；人文主义者兼赞助人 Gian Giorgio Trissino 为他取用了 Palladio 这个名字。该名通常被解释为与智慧女神帕拉斯·雅典娜有关，后来又成为建筑风格名称 Palladian 的来源。
etymology_story.en: Born Andrea di Pietro della Gondola, the architect received the name Palladio from his humanist patron Gian Giorgio Trissino. The name is generally associated with Pallas Athena, the goddess of wisdom, and later supplied the architectural term Palladian.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 Palladio 是不可按普通英语词缀拆分的人名。词族：Palladio → Palladian（帕拉第奥式的；帕拉第奥风格的追随者），构形时去掉末尾 o，再加 -an；Palladian + -ism → Palladianism（帕拉第奥主义；帕拉第奥式建筑风格）。此人名不宜强行指定统一 CEFR 等级或考试标签。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Palladio is a personal name without an ordinary English root-and-affix breakdown. Its word family includes Palladian, meaning relating to Palladio or a follower of his style, formed by replacing final o with -an, and Palladianism, formed with -ism and naming the architectural movement or style. No uniform CEFR level or examination tag is assigned to this personal name.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 人名没有普通词义上的近义词：Andrea Palladio（安德烈亚·帕拉第奥）是完整通用姓名，Andrea di Pietro della Gondola 是其原名。前者适合一般建筑史语境，后者主要用于传记与姓名沿革说明。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Personal names do not have ordinary lexical synonyms: Andrea Palladio is the standard full name, and Andrea di Pietro della Gondola is his birth name. The former suits general architectural discussion, while the latter mainly appears in biographical accounts.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Pallas 的“智慧”联想，连接 Palladio 的古典建筑与 Palladian 风格。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link Pallas and wisdom with Palladio's classical buildings and the word Palladian.

meaning: 综丝；织机上引导经线的带孔部件

forms: 复数 heddles；heddled 可作形容词，表示装有综丝的。

morphology.text: heddle 整词作为独立词素记忆；heddle + -ed → heddled（装有综丝的），词尾已有 e，只添 d。

senses.pos: v. 动词（纺织专业用语；technical weaving use）
senses.meaning_zh: 把经纱穿入综丝；给织机装配综丝
senses.meaning_en: To thread warp yarn through heddles or equip a loom with heddles.
senses.english_definition: When you heddle a warp or a loom, you pass the warp threads through heddles or fit the loom with them.
senses.collocation_en: heddle the warp; heddle a loom
senses.collocation_zh: 给经纱穿综；给织机装综
senses.sentence_en: She heddled the warp according to the threading plan.
senses.sentence_zh: 她按照穿综图把经纱穿入综丝。

etymology_story.zh: heddle 源自古英语织造词 hefeld，经中古英语的相关形式演变而来，词形在流传中发生了变化。它一直与织机上控制经纱的部件有关，后来也用作表示穿综或装综的动词。
etymology_story.en: Heddle descends from the Old English weaving term hefeld through related Middle English forms, with changes in its shape over time. It retained its association with controlling warp threads on a loom and also developed a verb use for threading or fitting heddles.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 heddle 是不可再分的基本词；名词直接转用为动词，不添加词缀。词族与变化形式：heddles（名词复数；动词第三人称单数）、heddled（过去式、过去分词；装有综丝的）、heddling（现在分词；穿综作业）；常见复合词有 rigid-heddle loom（刚性综片织机）、heddle eye（综眼）。词尾 -le 在此不是可自由拆出的现代派生后缀。未指定未经核实的 CEFR 等级或考试标签。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, heddle is a simple base; the noun becomes a verb by conversion without an added affix. Its family and inflections include heddles, heddled, and heddling; heddled can also describe something fitted with heddles, and heddling can name the threading operation. Common compounds include rigid-heddle loom and heddle eye. Final -le is not a freely separable modern derivational suffix here. No unverified CEFR level or examination tag is assigned.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: heald（综丝）是纺织术语中的对应名称，尤见于英国用法；harness（综框或综丝组件）在织造语境中通常指承载或组织综丝的整体，不能总与单根 heddle 互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Heald is an equivalent weaving term, especially in British usage. Harness usually denotes the frame or assembly that carries or organizes heddles, so it is not always interchangeable with an individual heddle.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 一根经纱穿一只综眼；综丝升降，经纱随动。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A warp thread goes through an eye; move the heddle, and the thread follows.

morphology.text: dak 整词作为独立词素记忆；dak + bungalow → dak bungalow（驿站客舍），由驿递和住宿建筑合成。

etymology.text: 英语从印地语 dak 借入，指印度旧时的驿递或接力运输。记住一路更换递送人和马匹的邮件。

usage_note: 历史及南亚语境用语。本课讲驿递制度；可说 send something by dak，不是 Dakota 的大写缩写 Dak.。

senses.meaning_zh: 南亚的邮政、邮递或邮件；历史上的接力驿递制度
senses.meaning_en: Post, mail, or a postal service in South Asia, especially the historical relay system.
senses.english_definition: Dak is a South Asian word for mail or the service that carries it, and can refer to the historical system of delivery by relays.
senses.collocation_zh: 驿递跑差；驿站客舍
senses.sentence_en: The dak runner carried the mail to the next relay station.
senses.sentence_zh: 驿递跑差把邮件送到了下一个接力驿站。

etymology_story.zh: dak 借自印地语和乌尔都语的 ḍāk，意为“邮政、邮件”，在英属印度时期进入英语。它在历史语境中常指接力驿递，也保留了南亚地区“邮政、邮件”的较广泛含义。
etymology_story.en: Dak was borrowed into English during the British period in India from Hindi and Urdu ḍāk, meaning post or mail. In historical contexts it often denotes relay delivery, while South Asian usage also retains the broader meanings of mail and postal service.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 dak 是不可再分的借词，通常作不可数名词；没有常用的前后缀派生词。复合词包括 dak runner（驿递跑差）、dak bungalow（驿站客舍）和 dak post（驿递）；这些组合中的 dak 是名词前置修饰语，不因此另列为形容词。未指定未经核实的 CEFR 等级或考试标签。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, dak is an unanalysed loanword, normally used as a mass noun, with no common affixal derivatives. Compounds include dak runner, dak bungalow, and dak post; dak functions as a noun modifier in these expressions, which does not establish a separate adjective use. No unverified CEFR level or examination tag is assigned.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: post（邮政；邮件）侧重邮递制度或所寄物品；mail（邮件）尤其常指递送的信件和包裹；relay post（接力驿递）突出分段接力的运输方式。dak 带有南亚地域色彩，在历史叙述中常兼有驿递含义。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Post can denote the postal system or the items sent through it; mail especially denotes the letters and parcels carried; relay post emphasizes delivery in successive stages. Dak has a South Asian association and often carries a historical relay-service meaning.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 想象邮件一站接一站传递：dak 就是南亚语境中的邮递与邮件。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture mail passing from station to station: dak is South Asian post and mail.

meaning: 铠甲下缘护片；保护腹部和髋部的裙甲

pronunciation.note: 单数 fauld 读 /fɔːld/；复数在有声音 /d/ 后加 /z/。复数读法按英语规则推得。

forms: 目录目标是复数 faulds；单数 fauld。本课例句保留 faulds。
family: fauld 单数裙甲；fold 折叠、褶层，与历史拼写有关。

morphology.text: fauld（裙甲） + -s（复数） → faulds（裙甲护片）；这是真实复数构成，护片常呈横向层叠。

etymology.text: 英语 fauld 是 fold 的历史变体，用来称呼像折叠裙摆一样层叠的铠甲部分；faulds 是其复数形式。

usage_note: 铠甲史用语，用复数动词。本课讲胸甲下缘保护腹部和髋部的护片，与头盔不是同一部位。

senses.meaning_zh: 裙甲；铠甲腰部以下保护腹部和髋部的层叠护片
senses.meaning_en: Overlapping armour plates protecting the lower trunk and hips.
senses.english_definition: Faulds are overlapping metal plates that hang below a breastplate to protect the lower part of the body.
senses.collocation_zh: 可活动连接的裙甲护片；相互搭接的裙甲护片
senses.sentence_en: The overlapping faulds allowed the knight to bend at the waist.
senses.sentence_zh: 相互搭接的裙甲护片使骑士能够弯腰。

etymology_story.zh: Faulds 是 fauld 的复数；fauld 经中古英语来自古法语 faude，指甲衣的下摆或裙部。这个词通常被追溯到与英语 fold“折叠”相关的日耳曼语词源，其含义后来专指铠甲下部的护甲。
etymology_story.en: Faulds is the plural of fauld, which entered Middle English from Old French faude, referring to the skirt or lower portion of armour. The word is generally traced to a Germanic source related to fold and later became a technical name for lower-body armour.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：fauld（裙甲或裙甲护片）+ -s（规则复数）→ faulds。现代英语中 fauld 作为完整词基处理，不再拆分；相关复合表达有 fauld plate（裙甲护片），没有常用的派生动词或副词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: fauld, an armour skirt or plate, + the regular plural suffix -s → faulds. Fauld is treated as an unsegmented base in modern English; related compounds include fauld plate, and there are no commonly used derived verbs or adverbs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Skirt armour（裙式护甲）是较宽泛的描述；tassets（腿裙甲、护腿上片）通常指悬挂在裙甲以下、保护大腿上部的独立甲片，不能与 faulds 完全互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Skirt armour is a broader descriptive term; tassets are usually separate plates suspended below the fauld to protect the upper thighs, so they are related components rather than exact equivalents.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 联想 fold“折叠”：腰下像折叠裙摆一样层层搭接的护甲。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think of fold: overlapping armour below the waist resembles a folded metal skirt.

meaning: 西班牙或葡萄牙王子；传统上尤指非王储的国王之子

pronunciation.note: 采用词典所列英式读法。

forms: 复数 infantes；相应女性称号 infanta。
family: infanta 公主称号；infant 婴儿，二者有共同的拉丁语来源。

morphology.text: infante 在英语中整词作为独立词素记忆；其拉丁语底层 in-（不） + fans（说话的） → infans（尚不会说话的孩子），后来发展出王室子弟的称号。

etymology.text: 拉丁语 infans 原指孩子，传入西班牙语、葡萄牙语后形成 infante 这一王室称号；英语在16世纪借入。记成“王家的孩子”。

usage_note: 历史称号，主要用于西班牙和葡萄牙王室，尤其指非王储的国王之子；不能当作英语 infant“婴儿”使用。

senses.meaning_zh: 西班牙或葡萄牙的王子称号，传统上通常用于非王储的王室之子
senses.meaning_en: A title traditionally given to a Spanish or Portuguese prince, usually one who is not the heir to the throne.
senses.english_definition: An infante is a prince of the Spanish or Portuguese royal family, traditionally one who is not the heir to the throne.

etymology_story.zh: 英语从西班牙语或葡萄牙语借入 infante，其源头是拉丁语 infans“幼儿”，字面意思是“尚不会说话的”。这个表示孩子的词在伊比利亚王室制度中发展成了王族子弟的称号。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed infante from Spanish or Portuguese, ultimately from Latin infans, meaning a young child and literally someone not yet speaking. In Iberian royal usage, the word developed into a title for a royal child.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语将 infante 作为完整借词处理，复数为 infantes。历史构词为拉丁语 in-（不）+ fant-（说话，动词 fari 的分词词干）；相关词有 infanta（对应的女性王族称号），同源英语词有 infant（婴儿）、infancy（婴儿期）和 infantile（婴儿的；幼稚的），但它们并非由英语 infante 派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats infante as a complete borrowed base; its plural is infantes. Historically, Latin in- means not, and fant- is the participial stem of fari, to speak; related vocabulary includes infanta, the corresponding female royal title, and the English cognates infant, infancy, and infantile, which are not derivatives of English infante.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Prince（王子、亲王）适用范围最广；royal son（君主之子）只描述亲属身份；infante 是西班牙和葡萄牙传统中的特定称号，通常与王储称号有所区别。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Prince is the broadest title; royal son describes a family relationship without specifying a title. Infante belongs specifically to Spanish and Portuguese royal traditions and is usually distinguished from the title of the heir.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 与 infant“婴儿”同源：从“孩子”想到“王家的孩子”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect it with its cognate infant: a child becomes a royal child with a title.

etymology_story.en: Padi comes from Malay padi, meaning the rice plant or unhusked rice; paddy is the more usual English spelling. Paddy also developed the meaning of a rice field, while padi remains especially associated with Southeast Asian agricultural contexts.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：padi 是不可进一步拆分的借入词基，通常作不可数名词。相关形式包括异体拼写 paddy，以及复合词 padi field（稻田）、padi cultivation（水稻种植）和 padi farmer（稻农）；没有常用的英语词缀派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: padi is an unsegmented borrowed base, normally used as a mass noun. Related forms include the spelling variant paddy and compounds such as padi field, padi cultivation, and padi farmer; there are no commonly used English affixal derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Paddy（稻、稻谷）是更常见的对应拼写，也可指稻田；unhusked rice（未脱壳稻谷）明确强调外壳尚在；rice（稻、米、米饭）范围更广，需要靠语境判断加工或烹饪状态。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Paddy is the more usual equivalent spelling and can also mean a rice field; unhusked rice explicitly identifies grain with its husk intact; rice is broader and can refer to the crop, processed grain, or cooked food.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 padi 与 paddy field“稻田”相连：田里长着、收后仍带壳的稻。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link padi with paddy field: rice growing in the field or harvested with its husk still on.

meaning: 夫人；女士（葡萄牙语或巴西语境中的尊称）

pronunciation.note: 采用 Collins 英式词条对该葡萄牙语称谓的标音；重音在中间音节。

forms: 复数 senhoras；称谓缩写 Sra.；对应男性称谓 Senhor。
family: Senhor 先生；Sra. 称谓缩写。

morphology.text: 葡萄牙语 senhor（先生） + -a（女性形式） → senhora（夫人、女士）；英语将 Senhora 整词作为独立称谓记忆。

etymology.text: 英语借入葡萄牙语 senhora，是 senhor 的女性形式；senhor 上溯拉丁语 senior“年长者”。从尊敬年长者联想到礼貌称呼。

usage_note: 放在人名前时首字母大写，如 Senhora Costa。相当于夫人或礼貌称呼女士，不用于男性。

senses.meaning_zh: 夫人；女士；葡萄牙语使用地区对女性的礼貌称呼
senses.meaning_en: A Portuguese title or respectful form of address for a woman.
senses.english_definition: Senhora is a Portuguese title used before a woman's name or as a polite way of addressing her.
senses.collocation_zh: 席尔瓦女士；科斯塔女士
senses.sentence_en: Senhora Silva welcomed the guests into her home.
senses.sentence_zh: 席尔瓦女士迎接客人到她家做客。

etymology_story.zh: 英语借用葡萄牙语 senhora，作为 senhor“先生”的女性对应称谓。Senhor 源自拉丁语 senior“年长者”，体现了从年龄或地位上的尊长发展为礼貌尊称的过程。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Portuguese senhora as the feminine counterpart of senhor, meaning sir or Mr. Senhor comes from Latin senior, meaning older or elder, reflecting a development from seniority to respectful address.

morphology_enriched.zh: 葡萄牙语构词关系：senhor（先生）+ -a（阴性词尾）→ senhora；英语将 Senhora 作为完整借入称谓使用，复数为 senhoras。相关葡萄牙语形式有 senhor（男性对应称谓）和 senhorita（小姐）；后者并非英语中由 Senhora 生产性派生的词。
morphology_enriched.en: Portuguese structure: senhor, a male title, + the feminine ending -a → senhora; English uses Senhora as a complete borrowed title, with the plural senhoras. Related Portuguese forms include senhor, the male counterpart, and senhorita, meaning Miss; the latter is not a productive English derivative of Senhora.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Madam（女士、夫人）与其直接称呼功能接近；Mrs（夫人、太太）通常表示已婚身份；Ms（女士）不标明婚姻状况。Senhora 的具体对应译法应结合当地用法和人物身份判断。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Madam is close when addressing someone directly; Mrs normally indicates that a woman is married; Ms leaves marital status unspecified. The best English equivalent of Senhora depends on local usage and the woman's circumstances.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Senhor 是“先生”，添上阴性词尾 -a，成为“女士”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with senhor, sir, and add the feminine ending -a to address a woman respectfully.

meaning: 环状把手；尤指古代器皿的环形把手

pronunciation.note: 采用词典所列英式读法。

forms: 复数 ansae，常读 /ˈænsiː/。
family: ansate 有把手的；ansated 同义形容词。

morphology.text: ansa 整词作为独立词素记忆；拉丁语 ansa（把手） + -atus（具有……的） → ansatus，英语对应形容词 ansate（有把手的）。

etymology.text: 英语从拉丁语 ansa“把手”借入。想象古瓶侧面弯成环、供人握持的耳状把手。

usage_note: 本课取考古器物的把手义。天文学也用它形容土星环两端的把手状部分，本课不考后者。

senses.meaning_zh: 环形把手；尤指古代器皿上的耳形或环形把手
senses.meaning_en: A loop-shaped handle, especially on an ancient vessel.
senses.english_definition: An ansa is a handle shaped like a loop, especially one attached to an ancient vessel.
senses.collocation_en: the ansa of a vessel; a bronze ansa
senses.collocation_zh: 器皿的环形把手；青铜环形把手
senses.sentence_en: Only one ansa of the ancient vessel remained intact.
senses.sentence_zh: 这件古代器皿只有一个环形把手保存完好。

senses.meaning_zh: 袢；神经等解剖结构形成的环状部分
senses.meaning_en: A loop-shaped anatomical structure, particularly a loop of nerves.
senses.english_definition: An ansa is a loop formed by a structure in the body, such as a nerve.
senses.collocation_zh: 颈袢；豆状核袢
senses.sentence_en: The surgeon identified the ansa cervicalis during the operation.
senses.sentence_zh: 外科医生在手术中辨认出了颈袢。

senses.meaning_zh: 环耳；从地球观察时土星环在行星两侧显现的突出部分之一
senses.meaning_en: Either apparent projecting end of Saturn's rings as viewed from Earth.
senses.english_definition: An ansa is either of the two parts of Saturn's rings that appear to project from opposite sides of the planet.
senses.collocation_en: the eastern ansa; the western ansa
senses.collocation_zh: 东侧环耳；西侧环耳
senses.sentence_en: The eastern ansa of Saturn's rings appeared brighter through the telescope.
senses.sentence_zh: 透过望远镜观察，土星环的东侧环耳显得更亮。

etymology_story.zh: Ansa 直接借自拉丁语 ansa“把手、柄”。器皿把手的环状外形使这个词进一步用于解剖学中的袢状结构，以及看起来像行星两侧把手的土星环突出部分。
etymology_story.en: Ansa was borrowed directly from Latin ansa, meaning a handle. The looped shape of a handle motivated its extension to anatomical loops and to the apparent handle-like projections of Saturn's rings.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：ansa 是完整的拉丁语借入词基，保留拉丁式复数 ansae。相关形容词有 ansate 和 ansated（有把手的；具环形结构的），以及 ansiform（袢状的、环形的）；这些是专业词汇，ansa 本身没有可拆出的现代英语前缀或后缀。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: ansa is a complete Latin loan base and retains the Latin plural ansae. Related adjectives include ansate and ansated, meaning furnished with a handle or loop, and ansiform, meaning loop-shaped; these are technical words, and ansa itself has no separable modern English prefix or suffix.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Handle（把手）强调抓握功能；loop（环、袢）强调弯曲成环的形状；projection（突出部分）只描述外形上的伸出。Ansa 是专业名称，其具体近义表达随器物学、解剖学或天文学语境而变化。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Handle emphasizes a part used for holding; loop emphasizes a curved or returning shape; projection simply describes something that extends outward. Ansa is a technical term whose nearest equivalent depends on the archaeological, anatomical, or astronomical context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 一个“环形把手”串起三义：器皿的把手、身体里的袢、土星两侧的环耳。
mnemonic_anchor.en: One looped handle links the meanings: a vessel's handle, a bodily loop, and a handle-like end of Saturn's rings.

meaning: 德国北部及邻近地区的沙质荒原

pronunciation.note: 采用词典所列英式读法。

forms: 地貌类别通常作不可数名词；特指一片此类地貌时可用 a geest。
family: 德语 Geestland 指这类沙质高地；与英语 geest 所指地貌相关。

morphology.text: geest 在英语中整词作为独立词素记忆；相关德语 Geest + Land（土地） → Geestland（沙质高地），用真实复合词联想地貌。

etymology.text: 19世纪英语从低地德语 Geest“干燥土地”借入。想象北德相对干燥、沙土覆盖的高地。

usage_note: 地理学用语，主要说德国北部及邻近地区的沙质荒原；与沿海湿润的 marshland（沼泽地）相区别。

senses.meaning_zh: 沙质高地；尤指德国北部及邻近地区高于沿海沼泽的干燥沙地
senses.meaning_en: Dry, sandy upland, especially above the coastal marshes of northern Germany and neighboring regions.
senses.english_definition: Geest is an area of relatively high, dry, sandy land, especially in northern Germany and nearby regions.
senses.collocation_zh: 沙质高地；沙质高地的土壤
senses.sentence_en: The village stands on the geest above the surrounding marshes.
senses.sentence_zh: 这座村庄坐落在高于周围沼泽的沙质高地上。

etymology_story.zh: 英语于19世纪从低地德语 Geest 借入，原词指干燥、通常较贫瘠的沙地。这一地貌名称强调它与邻近低湿沼泽之间的差别。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed the word in the nineteenth century from Low German Geest, referring to dry, generally infertile sandy land. The geographical term distinguishes this terrain from neighboring low, wet marshland.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可进一步分析的借词：geest；通常作不可数地貌名词，也可用复数 geests 指不同的沙质高地区域。没有常用的英语派生词；geest soils 是名词作定语的组合，德语 Geestland 则是相关的德语复合词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, geest is an unanalyzable loanword. It is usually a mass noun, though geests can denote separate areas of this terrain. It has no common English derivatives; geest soils uses the noun attributively, while German Geestland is a related German compound.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sandy upland（沙质高地）是最接近的描述性表达；heath（荒原）强调低矮灌木植被；moor（荒野、高沼地）常涉及酸性土壤或泥炭，不能与 geest 直接互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sandy upland is the closest descriptive equivalent. Heath emphasizes low, shrubby vegetation, while moor often suggests acidic or peaty terrain; neither is an exact substitute for geest.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 地貌对照记忆：低处是湿沼泽，高处是干沙地——高而干的那片就是 geest。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture wet marshes below and dry sand above: the higher, drier ground is the geest.

meaning: 丹尼鱼；鲤科的热带淡水观赏鱼

pronunciation.note: 采用词典所列英式读法。

forms: 复数 danios，不加 -es。
family: zebra danio 斑马鱼；giant danio 大型丹尼鱼。

morphology.text: danio 整词作为独立词素记忆；zebra（斑马） + danio → zebra danio（斑马鱼），按身上的条纹命名。

etymology.text: 19世纪英语借入新拉丁语鱼类属名 Danio，随后小写用于鱼名。把它和水族箱里成群游动的小鱼连起来。

usage_note: 指一类小型淡水观赏鱼，常与 zebra、giant 等词连用。普通鱼名 danio 小写，科学属名 Danio 大写并按学名排版。

senses.meaning_zh: 丹鱼；常饲养为观赏鱼的亚洲小型淡水鱼，包括斑马鱼等
senses.meaning_en: A small Asian freshwater fish of a group that includes the zebrafish and other aquarium fishes.
senses.english_definition: A danio is a small freshwater fish from Asia that is often kept in an aquarium.
senses.collocation_en: zebra danio; a shoal of danios
senses.collocation_zh: 斑马鱼；一群丹鱼
senses.sentence_en: A shoal of danios swam near the surface of the aquarium.
senses.sentence_zh: 一群丹鱼在水族箱靠近水面的地方游动。

etymology_story.zh: 英语鱼名来自新拉丁语属名 Danio，而该属名源于孟加拉语中的当地鱼名。属名进入普通英语后小写为 danio，用来指这类小型淡水鱼。
etymology_story.en: The English fish name comes from the New Latin genus name Danio, which was based on a Bengali local fish name. The scientific name became the lowercase common noun danio for these small freshwater fishes.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可进一步分析的借词：danio；规则复数为 danios。没有常用的普通英语派生词；zebra danio（斑马鱼）和 giant danio（大丹鱼）是复合鱼名，Danio 是首字母大写、通常用斜体书写的科学属名。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, danio is an unanalyzable loanword; its regular plural is danios. It has no common everyday derivatives. Zebra danio and giant danio are compound fish names; capitalized Danio, normally italicized, is the scientific genus name.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: zebrafish（斑马鱼）与 zebra danio 通常指同一种鱼，范围比 danio 窄；minnow（鲦类小鱼）是较宽泛且用法不统一的名称；aquarium fish（观赏鱼）强调饲养用途，不限定丹鱼这一类。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Zebrafish usually names the same species as zebra danio and is narrower than danio. Minnow is a broader, variably applied fish name, while aquarium fish describes how a fish is kept rather than its particular group.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 用代表种记整类：zebra danio 是带斑马条纹的丹鱼，danio 就是它所属的鱼名。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Use the representative species as your anchor: a zebra danio has zebra-like stripes; danio names the fish group.

etymology_story.zh: 单数 dor 源于古英语 dora，当时可指熊蜂等发出嗡嗡声的昆虫，后来用于嗡嗡飞行的甲虫，尤指粪金龟。dors 是它加上规则复数词尾 -s 的形式。
etymology_story.en: The singular dor descends from Old English dora, which could refer to a bumblebee or another buzzing insect, and later came to denote buzzing beetles, especially dung beetles. Dors adds the regular plural ending -s.

morphology_enriched.zh: dor（嗡嗡飞行的金龟子）+ -s（复数）→ dors；这里 -s 在 /r/ 后读 /z/。相关形式有单数 dor、变体 dorr，以及复合词 dor beetle、dor-beetle；复数也可写作 dorrs，对应单数变体 dorr。
morphology_enriched.en: Dor + plural -s → dors; after /r/, the ending is pronounced /z/. Related forms include singular dor, the spelling variant dorr, and the compounds dor beetle and dor-beetle; dorrs is the plural of the variant dorr.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: dung beetles（蜣螂、粪金龟）强调利用粪便的习性，是最接近的常用表达；dor beetles（金龟子）保留这一旧名称；beetles（甲虫）范围大得多，不限于此类昆虫。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Dung beetles is the closest everyday expression and emphasizes association with dung. Dor beetles preserves the older name, while beetles covers a much larger group of insects.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 先记 dor 是一只嗡嗡飞的甲虫，再加 -s：dors 就是一群。
mnemonic_anchor.en: One buzzing beetle is a dor; add -s to picture several dors.

senses.meaning_zh: 懒猴；生活在亚洲、眼睛大且夜间活动的树栖小型灵长类动物
senses.meaning_en: A small, large-eyed, nocturnal, tree-dwelling primate native to Asia.
senses.english_definition: A loris is a small Asian primate with large eyes that lives in trees and is active at night.
senses.collocation_zh: 蜂猴；纤懒猴
senses.sentence_en: The loris gripped a branch and watched us with its large eyes.
senses.sentence_zh: 那只懒猴抓着树枝，用大眼睛注视着我们。

etymology_story.zh: 英语于18世纪从法语 loris 借入这一动物名。法语名称通常被认为可能与荷兰语 loeris（傻瓜、小丑）有关，但更早的来源并不完全确定。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed this animal name from French loris in the eighteenth century. The French name is often connected, tentatively, with Dutch loeris, meaning a fool or clown, but its earlier origin is not entirely certain.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可进一步分析的借词：loris；复数为 lorises，不能把词尾 -is 当作英语复数词尾。相关名称包括 slow loris（蜂猴）和 slender loris（纤懒猴）；动物学相关词有 lorisid（懒猴科动物；懒猴科的）及科名 Lorisidae（懒猴科）。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, loris is an unanalyzable loanword; its plural is lorises, and final -is is not an English plural ending. Related names include slow loris and slender loris. Zoological relatives include lorisid, meaning a member of or relating to the family Lorisidae, and the family name Lorisidae.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: slow loris（蜂猴）和 slender loris（纤懒猴）分别指懒猴中的不同类群，并非可在所有语境中替换 loris 的同义词；strepsirrhine（湿鼻类灵长动物）是更宽泛的分类名称。loris 没有同样精确的常用单词同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Slow loris and slender loris name different groups of lorises and are not interchangeable with loris in every context. Strepsirrhine is a broader taxonomic term. Loris has no equally precise common single-word synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor the word to one image: a small, large-eyed primate on a branch at night.

meaning: 胜人一筹的做派；压人一头的攀比

pronunciation.note: 采用词典所列英式读法。

forms: 通常不可数；常见完整形式 one-upmanship；另写 upsmanship。
family: one-upmanship 争强、压人一头；one-up 比别人占优势。

morphology.text: one-up（胜人一筹） + -manship（本领或做派） → one-upmanship（压人一头的做派）；upmanship 是这个词缩去 one- 的形式，整词记忆。

etymology.text: 20世纪英语把 one-up 与表示做派的 -manship 结合成 one-upmanship，随后缩短成 upmanship。想象两个人不断试图在话头上高对方一等。

usage_note: 非正式用语，通常带批评意味，强调要显得比别人更强或更有地位，不是普通的互相帮助。

senses.meaning_zh: 力求胜人一筹的做派；通过言行压人一头的攀比，通常带贬义
senses.meaning_en: The practice of trying to outdo others or establish superiority, usually with a disapproving implication.
senses.english_definition: Upmanship is behavior in which someone tries to appear better, more successful, or more important than other people.
senses.collocation_zh: 政治上的争强斗胜；言语上的争高下
senses.sentence_en: Their discussion soon became an exercise in upmanship.
senses.sentence_zh: 他们的讨论很快变成了一场互相压人一头的较量。

etymology_story.zh: upmanship 是20世纪词语 one-upmanship 的缩略形式；其中 one-up 表示比别人占先一步。one-upmanship 经英国作家斯蒂芬·波特的著作而广为人知，用来描写在人际交往中巧妙占上风的做派。
etymology_story.en: Upmanship is a shortened form of the twentieth-century word one-upmanship, built on one-up, meaning one step ahead of someone else. One-upmanship became widely known through the writings of Stephen Potter and describes maneuvering for social advantage.

morphology_enriched.zh: 直接形成过程为 one-upmanship 去掉 one- → upmanship；原词可分析为 one-up（胜人一筹）+ -manship（仿 gamesmanship 等词形成的、表示技巧或做派的结尾）。通常不可数；相关表达有 one-up、动词 one-up、one-ups、one-upped、one-upping 和名词 one-upmanship，没有常用的 upmanship 派生动词或形容词。
morphology_enriched.en: The immediate formation is one-upmanship minus one- → upmanship. The longer word combines one-up with -manship, an ending denoting skill or behavior modeled on words such as gamesmanship. Upmanship is normally uncountable; related forms include one-up, the verb one-up, one-ups, one-upped, one-upping, and one-upmanship. It has no common derived verb or adjective.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: one-upmanship（处处争高下）是更常见、意义最接近的形式；outdoing（胜过别人）侧重实际超过对方的行为；gamesmanship（取胜伎俩）强调为占优势而运用心理或策略手段，不一定涉及炫耀。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: One-upmanship is the more usual and closest equivalent. Outdoing focuses on surpassing someone, while gamesmanship emphasizes psychological or tactical methods of gaining an advantage and need not involve showing off.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 up 想成“高一头”：总想在别人头上再高一点，就是 upmanship。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think of up as being one step above: constantly trying to stand above others is upmanship.

etymology_story.zh: 中古英语 eglentyn 经盎格鲁法语 eglent 借入，最终可追溯至拉丁语 acus“针”及表示“多刺的”的相关形式。名称着眼于枝条上的刺，后来成为甜蔷薇的名称。[词源依据：Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/eglantine)
etymology_story.en: Middle English eglentyn came through Anglo-French eglent, ultimately from Latin acus, meaning 'needle', through a related form meaning 'prickly'. The name highlights the plant's prickles and became a name for sweetbrier. [Etymological source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/eglantine)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为整体词干 eglantine 记忆，不宜拆成现代英语中可自由组合的词根和词缀。常规屈折形式为 eglantine + -s → eglantines（多株甜蔷薇）；没有常用的派生动词、形容词或副词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, eglantine is a whole lexical stem rather than a transparent combination of productive roots and affixes. Its regular inflection is eglantine + -s → eglantines; it has no commonly used derived verb, adjective, or adverb.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sweetbrier（亦拼 sweetbriar，甜蔷薇）是直接同义词，名称突出香气；wild rose（野蔷薇）范围更广，不能确定具体物种；dog rose（犬蔷薇）通常指另一物种 Rosa canina，不宜在植物学语境中直接互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sweetbrier, also spelled sweetbriar, is a direct synonym whose name emphasizes fragrance. Wild rose is broader and does not identify a particular species. Dog rose usually denotes Rosa canina, a different species, so it is not botanically interchangeable.

etymology_story.zh: Gadarene 经晚期拉丁语和希腊语传来，原指“加大拉的”或“加大拉人”。《圣经》中被鬼附身的猪群冲入海中的故事，使它进一步获得“不顾后果地猛冲的”这一比喻义。[词义与典故依据：Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Gadarene)
etymology_story.en: Gadarene came through Late Latin and Greek and originally designated someone or something associated with Gadara. The biblical story of possessed swine rushing into the sea supplied its figurative meaning of reckless, potentially disastrous haste. [Senses and biblical background: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Gadarene)

morphology_enriched.zh: 可分析为 Gadara（加大拉，去末尾 -a）+ 表地域关联的 -ene → Gadarene；这是对既有借词结构的分析。形容词和居民名词同形，名词复数为 Gadarenes；比喻义也可小写为 gadarene，没有常用的派生副词或抽象名词。
morphology_enriched.en: The borrowed formation can be analyzed as Gadara, with final -a removed, + the geographical suffix -ene → Gadarene. The adjective and inhabitant noun share the same form; the noun plural is Gadarenes. Lowercase gadarene also occurs figuratively, and there is no commonly used derived adverb or abstract noun.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: headlong（猛冲的）突出急速、失控的前进；reckless（鲁莽的）突出漠视危险，不一定涉及速度；precipitate（轻率仓促的）突出考虑不足便采取行动。Gadarene 尤其容易让人联想到群体一拥而上、走向灾难的场面。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Headlong emphasizes rapid, uncontrolled movement; reckless emphasizes disregard for danger without necessarily implying speed; precipitate emphasizes action taken before adequate consideration. Gadarene particularly evokes a collective rush toward disaster.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 加大拉猪群冲入海：一拥而上，不顾后果。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture the swine rushing into the sea: a headlong rush without regard for consequences.

etymology_story.zh: 中古英语 manche 借自中古法语，源于拉丁语 manica“衣袖”，进一步与 manus“手”有关。衣袖本身的名称后来用于纹章中描绘中世纪长垂袖的图案。[词义与词源依据：Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/manche)
etymology_story.en: Middle English manche was borrowed from Middle French, from Latin manica, meaning 'sleeve', ultimately related to manus, 'hand'. The garment name was subsequently used for the heraldic representation of a medieval hanging sleeve. [Senses and etymology: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/manche)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为整体借词 manche，无可自由拆分的现代词缀；manche + -s → manches（复数）。异体拼写有 maunche、maunch，相应复数为 maunches；没有常用的派生动词、形容词或副词。
morphology_enriched.en: Manche is a whole borrowed stem in modern English, with no productive internal affixation; manche + -s → manches. Variant spellings are maunche and maunch, with plural maunches. There are no commonly used derived verbs, adjectives, or adverbs.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sleeve（衣袖）指实际服装部件，是古义的普通对应词；heraldic sleeve（纹章衣袖图案）是纹章义的解释性近义表达；charge（纹章图记）是上位词，可包括动物、兵器等多种图案，并非 manche 的专指同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sleeve is the ordinary word for the actual garment part and corresponds to the archaic sense. Heraldic sleeve is an explanatory equivalent for the heraldic sense. Charge is a broader heraldic term covering many designs, so it does not specifically mean manche.

etymology_story.en: The name comes from a defensive tower at Cape Mortella in Corsica, captured by British forces in 1794. Mortella became Martello in English, and the altered name was applied to similar coastal defence towers. [Definition and etymology: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/martello-tower)

morphology_enriched.zh: Martello 是源于地名的整体词干，不宜按现代英语词根、词缀拆分。主要复合词为 Martello + tower → Martello tower，复数 Martello towers；单独用作可数名词时复数为 Martellos，没有常用派生词。Martello 在 Martello tower 中作名词修饰语，无须另立常用形容词词性。
morphology_enriched.en: Martello is a whole stem derived from a place-name rather than a transparent modern English root-and-affix formation. Its principal compound is Martello + tower → Martello tower, plural Martello towers; the standalone count noun has plural Martellos. It has no common derivatives, and its modifying use in Martello tower does not require a separate common adjective entry.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: coastal defence tower（海防塔）是范围较广的解释性近义表达；fort（堡垒）可指规模和形制各异的防御建筑；blockhouse（碉堡）通常指紧凑、设射击孔的防御工事。Martello 专指特定类型的小型海防塔。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Coastal defence tower is a broader descriptive equivalent. Fort covers defensive structures of many sizes and forms. Blockhouse usually denotes a compact fortified building with firing openings. Martello identifies a particular type of small coastal tower.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Mortella's tower became Martello: picture a stout round gun tower beside the sea.

etymology_story.zh: 容量单位义可追溯至古英语 windel“篮子”，与 windan“缠绕、编织”有关，由编篮发展出容器容量的含义。绕纱器和动词义也属于“缠绕”这一词源系统，但不宜假定所有方言义都由谷物量单位直接演变而来。[历史用例：约克郡历史词典](https://yorkshiredictionary.york.ac.uk/words/windle)；[词义与词源：Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/windle)
etymology_story.en: The measure sense goes back to Old English windel, 'basket', related to windan, 'to wind or twist', with the woven container giving its name to a quantity. The yarn-winding noun and verb likewise belong to the winding word group, but the dialect senses should not all be treated as direct developments of the grain measure. [Historical evidence: Yorkshire Historical Dictionary](https://yorkshiredictionary.york.ac.uk/words/windle); [senses and etymology: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/windle)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中宜把 windle 作为整体词干；历史上可联系表示“缠绕”的 wind 和旧的构词成分 -le，但不是现代可自由造词的公式。名词复数 windles；动词屈折为 windles、windled、windling；相关词族有 wind（缠绕）、winder（绕线器或绕线者）、winding（缠绕）。这些是词源相关词，不都是由 windle 派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat windle as a whole stem in modern English. Historically it is associated with wind meaning 'to twist or wrap' and an old formative -le, rather than a freely productive modern formula. The noun plural is windles; verb forms are windles, windled, and windling. Related family members include wind, winder, and winding; these are etymological relatives, not all derivatives of windle.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 容量义没有通行的精确同义词：bushel（蒲式耳）是另一计量单位，不能直接画等号；绕纱器义可用 yarn-winder（绕纱器）解释，reel（卷轴、绕线轮）范围更广；动词 wind（缠绕）是普通英语中最接近的对应词。草捆义可用 bundle（捆）解释，但 bundle 不限定材料。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The measure has no usual exact synonym: bushel names a different unit and is not automatically equivalent. For the device, yarn-winder is a close descriptive equivalent, while reel is broader. The verb wind is the nearest ordinary-English equivalent. Bundle explains the straw-or-hay sense but does not specify the material.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Start with winding: wind yarn, weave a basket, then picture a basketful of grain.

etymology_story.zh: tsarina 是 czarina 的另一种拼写，其形成与德语 Zarin 等欧洲语言中的沙皇女性称谓有关。词基 tsar 最终源自拉丁语 Caesar，原为人名，后来成为帝王称号。
etymology_story.en: Tsarina is a spelling variant of czarina, a title shaped by continental European feminine forms such as German Zarin. Its base, tsar, ultimately comes from Latin Caesar, a personal name that developed into an imperial title.

morphology_enriched.zh: 可辨认结构为 tsar（沙皇）+ 女性称谓词尾 -ina；这是借入称谓的结构，不宜把 -ina 当作现代英语中可自由使用的女性后缀。复数：tsarinas；异体：czarina；相关词族：tsar/czar（沙皇）、tsarist/czarist（沙皇的；沙皇制度支持者）、tsarism/czarism（沙皇制度）、tsarevich（沙皇之子；尤指皇储）、tsarevna（沙皇之女）。
morphology_enriched.en: The recognizable structure is tsar + the feminine title ending -ina; this belongs to a borrowed title and does not make -ina a freely productive feminine suffix in modern English. Plural: tsarinas; variant: czarina. Related family: tsar/czar, tsarist/czarist, tsarism/czarism, tsarevich, meaning a tsar's son, especially the heir, and tsarevna, meaning a tsar's daughter.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: czarina：同一称谓的另一种拼写，意义相同；empress（女皇；皇后）：适用于不同帝国的更宽泛称谓；queen consort（王后）：指国王之妻，婚姻身份相近，但并非沙皇体系中的对应头衔。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Czarina is an alternative spelling with the same meaning. Empress is a broader imperial title used across different empires. Queen consort describes a king's wife and parallels the marital role, but belongs to a different system of titles.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住 tsar“沙皇”：女性对应称谓 tsarina，可指皇后，也可指女沙皇。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Anchor it to tsar: tsarina is the corresponding female title, covering both a ruler's wife and a female ruler.

etymology_story.zh: wright 来自古英语 wyrhta、wryhta，意为“制作者、工人”，与 work 属于同源词。独立使用的 wright 如今带有古旧色彩，但在 shipwright、wheelwright 和 playwright 等复合词中仍然保留。
etymology_story.en: Wright comes from Old English wyrhta or wryhta, meaning a maker or worker, and is historically related to work. The independent noun is now old-fashioned, but it survives in compounds such as shipwright, wheelwright, and playwright.

morphology_enriched.zh: wright（工匠）+ 复数词尾 -s → wrights；词尾在清辅音 /t/ 后读 /s/。相关复合词：shipwright（造船工）、wheelwright（车轮制造工）、cartwright（大车制造工）、millwright（磨坊机械或工业机械安装维修工）、playwright（剧作家）；playwright 的常用派生词为 playwriting（剧本创作）。
morphology_enriched.en: Wright + plural -s → wrights; the ending is pronounced /s/ after voiceless /t/. Related compounds include shipwright, wheelwright, cartwright, millwright, and playwright. Playwriting is the established related noun for writing plays.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: craftspeople（手艺人）：现代通用词，涵盖多种手工技艺；artisans（工匠）：常强调传统手艺和制作质量；woodworkers（木工）：专指加工木材的人，而 wrights 更突出制作或建造某类成品。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Craftspeople is a modern general term covering many skilled crafts. Artisans often emphasizes traditional skill and workmanship. Woodworkers specifically work with wood, whereas wrights emphasizes making or building particular kinds of finished objects.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: wright 与 work 同源：wrights 就是“把东西做出来的人们”；不要与 writes“写”混淆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect wright with its historical relative work: wrights are people who make things. Keep it distinct from writes.

etymology_story.zh: arak 与 arrack 属于同一组流传于多种语言的酒名，最终与阿拉伯语 ʿaraq“汗；蒸馏酒”有关；马来语 arak 也是亚洲用法的重要相关形式。“汗”的意象与蒸馏时凝结的液滴相联系，不同地区则用这一名称指称不同原料或风味的烈酒。
etymology_story.en: Arak and arrack belong to a group of spirit names circulating across several languages, ultimately associated with Arabic ʿaraq, meaning sweat or distilled liquor; Malay arak is an important related Asian form. The image of sweat connects with condensed drops produced during distillation, while regional usage developed around different ingredients and flavors.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可再作有意义词素切分的借词，通常作为不可数名词使用，无常用的标准派生词族。相关拼写 arrack 尤其常见于南亚及东南亚酒类名称，但具体酒种不能仅凭拼写认定为相同。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, arak is an unsegmented loanword, usually used as a mass noun, with no established common family of derivatives. The related spelling arrack is especially associated with South and Southeast Asian spirits, but the spellings do not guarantee that the drinks are identical.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: arrack（阿拉克酒）：与 arak 有历史及拼写联系，常指亚洲蒸馏酒；ouzo（乌佐酒）：希腊茴香味烈酒，与西亚 arak 风味相近，但属于不同酒种；raki（土耳其拉克酒）：另一种相关的茴香味烈酒名称，并非所有 arak 的同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Arrack is historically and orthographically related and often names Asian distilled spirits. Ouzo is a Greek anise-flavored spirit similar in flavor to western Asian arak but is a distinct drink. Raki names another related anise-flavored spirit and is not an interchangeable term for every kind of arak.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“汗珠”联想到蒸馏液滴；再记住两条地域线索：西亚常有茴香味，亚洲其他地区常用棕榈汁或稻米。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture sweat-like drops of distillate, then attach two regional cues: anise in western Asia, and palm sap or rice in other Asian traditions.

senses.meaning_zh: 偶氮的；含有连接两个有机基团的 —N=N— 基团的
senses.meaning_en: containing an —N=N— group linking two organic groups
senses.english_definition: An azo compound contains two nitrogen atoms joined by a double bond, with each nitrogen atom also bonded to an organic group.

etymology_story.zh: azo 来自科学构词成分 azo-，源于法语 azote“氮”；azote 由表示“无”的希腊语成分 a- 与表示“生命”的 zōē 构成，反映氮气不能维持呼吸的性质。化学中的 azo 后来专指含有 —N=N— 连接结构的基团或化合物。
etymology_story.en: Azo comes from the scientific combining form azo-, derived from French azote, meaning nitrogen; azote combines Greek elements meaning without and life, reflecting nitrogen's inability to sustain breathing. In chemistry, azo developed a specialized reference to the —N=N— linkage and compounds containing it.

morphology_enriched.zh: azo 可作前置形容词，也可作科学构词成分 azo-；不能按现代英语把它拆成 a- 与 zo 两个有效词素。相关构词包括 azobenzene（偶氮苯）、azo compound（偶氮化合物）、azo dye（偶氮染料）及 azo coupling（偶氮偶联）；diazo（重氮的）和 azoxy（氧化偶氮的）是结构不同的相关术语。
morphology_enriched.en: Azo functions as an attributive adjective and as the scientific combining form azo-; it is not synchronically divisible into meaningful English elements a- and zo. Related formations include azobenzene, azo compound, azo dye, and azo coupling. Diazo and azoxy are related chemical terms describing different structures.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: azo-containing（含偶氮基的）：强调含有偶氮结构，是解释性近义表达；azo-linked（由偶氮基连接的）：强调两个部分通过偶氮基相连。二者均为描述性表达，适用范围取决于具体分子结构。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Azo-containing emphasizes the presence of an azo group and is a close explanatory equivalent. Azo-linked emphasizes that two parts are connected through that group. Both are descriptive expressions whose suitability depends on the molecular structure.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 看到 azo，就画出 —N=N—：两个氮原子以双键相连，两端连接有机基团。
mnemonic_anchor.en: When you see azo, picture —N=N—: two double-bonded nitrogen atoms connecting organic groups.

etymology_story.zh: 在电子技术义中，CRT 由 cathode-ray tube 的三个主要单词的首字母组成，后来也用于指采用这种显像管的显示器。批判种族理论和心脏再同步化治疗分别有独立的全称，只是使用了相同的首字母组合。[电子技术与医学义](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/crt)；[批判种族理论](https://www.nycbar.org/blogs/critical-race-theory-what-it-is-what-it-isnt-and-what-lawyers-can-do-to-clarify-misinformation-and-move-the-debate-forward/)
etymology_story.en: In electronics, CRT consists of the initials of cathode-ray tube and subsequently also came to denote a monitor using that technology. Critical race theory and cardiac resynchronization therapy are independent expressions that happen to share the same initials. [Electronics and medical senses](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/crt); [critical race theory](https://www.nycbar.org/blogs/critical-race-theory-what-it-is-what-it-isnt-and-what-lawyers-can-do-to-clarify-misinformation-and-move-the-debate-forward/)

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词方式为首字母缩略：cathode（阴极）+ ray（射线）+ tube（管）→ CRT；critical（批判性的）+ race（种族）+ theory（理论）→ CRT；cardiac（心脏的）+ resynchronization（再同步化）+ therapy（治疗）→ CRT。逐个读字母；电子设备义复数为 CRTs，理论义和治疗义通常不可数。CRT monitor 中的 CRT 是名词作定语，不据此另立形容词词性；无常用的直接派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation is by initialism: cathode + ray + tube → CRT; critical + race + theory → CRT; cardiac + resynchronization + therapy → CRT. The letters are pronounced separately. The electronic device sense has the plural CRTs; the theory and treatment senses are normally uncountable. CRT in CRT monitor is a noun modifier, which does not require a separate adjective entry. There are no common direct derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 电子技术义：cathode-ray tube 是完整名称；picture tube（显像管）主要用于电视语境；monitor（显示器）范围更广，也包括其他显示技术。批判种族理论义和治疗义的准确替换分别为 critical race theory 和 cardiac resynchronization therapy。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For electronics, cathode-ray tube is the full equivalent; picture tube is associated especially with television; monitor is broader and includes other display technologies. The exact expansions for the theory and treatment senses are critical race theory and cardiac resynchronization therapy, respectively.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 看屏幕想到 Cathode–Ray–Tube；见种族议题想到 Critical–Race–Theory；见心脏治疗想到 Cardiac–Resynchronization–Therapy。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A screen suggests Cathode–Ray–Tube; a discussion of race suggests Critical–Race–Theory; heart treatment suggests Cardiac–Resynchronization–Therapy.

etymology_story.zh: 英语借自新拉丁语属名 Hyla；该名称取自神话人物 Hylas 的拉丁语呼格 Hyla。寻找失踪的许拉斯时反复呼喊其名字的传说，被联想到群蛙此起彼伏的鸣叫，而不是简单地由“森林”一词派生。[词源依据](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/hyla)
etymology_story.en: English borrowed the New Latin genus name Hyla, taken from Hyla, the Latin vocative of the mythological name Hylas. The repeated cries of those searching for Hylas were fancifully associated with a chorus of frogs, rather than the name being simply derived from a word meaning forest. [Etymological reference](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/hyla)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是不可再拆分的借入名词：hyla；规则复数为 hylas。科学属名写作 Hyla，首字母大写，通常用斜体；普通名词 hyla 小写。相关分类词包括 Hylidae（雨蛙科）、hylid（雨蛙科动物；雨蛙科的）；它们是相关科学名称，不宜机械分析为 hyla 加英语后缀。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, hyla is an unanalyzed borrowed noun, with the regular plural hylas. The scientific genus name Hyla is capitalized and normally italicized; the common noun hyla is lowercase. Related taxonomic vocabulary includes Hylidae, the tree frog family, and hylid, a member of or relating to that family; these are related scientific formations rather than simple English suffixations of hyla.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: tree frog（树蛙）是更宽泛的名称，不限于雨蛙属；hylid（雨蛙科动物）按科分类，范围也更大；frog（蛙）则是一般名称。三者都不能在精确分类语境中无条件替换 hyla。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Tree frog is broader and is not restricted to Hyla; hylid identifies a member of the larger family Hylidae; frog is the general term. None is an unconditional substitute for hyla in precise taxonomic writing.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 呼喊“Hyla！”的回声，联想到池塘边群蛙齐鸣。

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为不可再拆分的借词：kef，无可独立识别的英语词根与词缀。两个核心义通常作不可数名词；部分词典也收录复数 kefs。相关异体拼写有 kaif、kif、kief、keef，但各拼写的具体词义可能不同，尤其现代 kief 常专指大麻树脂腺体颗粒；无常用的直接派生词。

etymology_story.zh: 动词经中古英语承自古英语 hladan，原有堆装、装载和舀水等意义，现代尤以 laden 形式保留。地方名词“引水渠”则与古英语表示路径、水道的 lād、ġelād 有关，应与装载动词区分。[动词历史](https://music.amazon.com/podcasts/d1c17062-111b-4148-8ad5-c4913ce72187/episodes/008cf3db-3a2a-4331-b4f5-61e202e1e9f1/merriam-webster%27s-word-of-the-day-lade)；[名词历史](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/dost/lade_n_3)
etymology_story.en: The verb descends through Middle English from Old English hladan, which covered heaping, loading, and drawing water; modern use survives especially in laden. The regional noun meaning a water channel belongs with Old English lād and ġelād, referring to a course or channel, and should be distinguished from the loading verb. [Verb history](https://music.amazon.com/podcasts/d1c17062-111b-4148-8ad5-c4913ce72187/episodes/008cf3db-3a2a-4331-b4f5-61e202e1e9f1/merriam-webster%27s-word-of-the-day-lade); [noun history](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/dost/lade_n_3)

morphology_enriched.zh: 动词 lade 为基本词：lade + -s → lades；去末尾 e 加 -ed → laded；去末尾 e 加 -ing → lading；另有不规则过去分词 laden。相关词族：lading（装载；货物）、lader（装载者，罕用）、unlade（卸货）、unladen（未装载的）、laden（满载的；充满……的）；laden with 和 bill of lading（提单）尤其值得掌握。laden 的独立形容词用法属于 laden 词条，不等于 lade 本身有形容词词性。名词 lade 的复数为 lades，复合词有 mill-lade。
morphology_enriched.en: The verb lade is a simplex base: lade + -s → lades; dropping final e before -ed gives laded, and before -ing gives lading; laden is an irregular past participle. Its family includes lading, meaning loading or cargo; rare lader, a person who loads; unlade, to unload; unladen, not loaded; and adjectival laden, heavily loaded or full of something. Especially useful expressions are laden with and bill of lading. The independent adjective laden belongs under laden, rather than establishing an adjective lade. The regional noun has the plural lades and the compound mill-lade.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 装载义：load 是现代日常用词；lade 较陈旧，常见于航运及 laden 形式；burden 强调沉重负担。舀水义接近 scoop 或 ladle；水渠名词义接近 leat、millrace，均需注意地方或专业语域。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For loading, load is the ordinary modern verb; lade is older in style and survives especially in shipping language and laden; burden emphasizes an oppressive weight. For liquid handling, scoop and ladle are close equivalents. For the channel noun, leat and millrace are close regional or technical equivalents.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 装上去 → laden（满载）；装载的货物 → lading；水渠名词另记“引水走的路”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Load it → laden; the loading or cargo → lading. Remember the separate channel noun as a path for water.

etymology_story.zh: 英语在十九世纪中叶借入西班牙语 loma，意为小丘或山脊，主要进入美国西南部的地形用语。它与西班牙语 lomo“背部、山脊”相关，体现了把隆起地形比作背部的形象联系。[词源与地域用法](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/loma)
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Spanish loma, meaning a hill or ridge, in the mid-nineteenth century, chiefly for southwestern American landscapes. It is related to Spanish lomo, meaning back or ridge, reflecting an image of raised ground resembling a back. [Origin and regional usage](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/loma)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为不可再拆分的西班牙语借词：loma；loma + -s → lomas（复数）。末尾 -a 是借入词的一部分，不是英语后缀；本地形义没有常用的直接英语派生词，临时组合 loma-like 不宜作为固定词族成员收录。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, loma is an unanalyzed Spanish loanword: loma + -s → lomas, its plural. Final -a is part of the borrowed word, not an English suffix. The landscape sense has no common direct English derivatives; an ad hoc formation such as loma-like should not be treated as an established family member.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: hill（小山、丘陵）是一般名称；knoll（圆丘）通常指较小、圆顶的丘；ridge（山脊）强调狭长的高地。loma 的突出特征是顶部较宽，并带有美国西南部的地域色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Hill is the general term; knoll usually suggests a small, rounded hill; ridge emphasizes an elongated elevation. Loma specifically suggests a broad top and carries a southwestern American regional association.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 loma 想成大地宽阔隆起的“背”：背形地势 → 宽顶丘。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture loma as the land's broad, raised back: a back-shaped rise becomes a broad-topped hill.

etymology_story.zh: 英语借自葡萄牙语 senhor，其源头是拉丁语 senior，原义为“较年长的”，后来发展出“主人、尊长”的含义。这种由年龄引申出的敬意最终形成了相当于“先生”的称谓。[词源参考](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/senhor)
etymology_story.en: English borrowed Portuguese senhor, ultimately from Latin senior, meaning 'older', which developed the sense 'lord' or 'master'. Respect associated with seniority became a polite title equivalent to Mr. or sir. [Etymology reference](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/senhor)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中视为不可再分析的借词：senhor；复数为 senhors 或 senhores，姓名前作称谓通常首字母大写。相关葡萄牙语称谓有 senhora（女士、夫人）和 senhorita（小姐）；这些属于借入的相关形式，不是英语中可自由套用的派生规则。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, senhor is an unanalyzed loanword; its plurals are senhors and senhores, and the title is normally capitalized before a name. Related Portuguese titles include senhora ('Mrs.' or 'madam') and senhorita ('Miss'); these are related borrowed forms rather than products of a freely productive English derivational rule.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Mr.（先生）用于姓名前；sir（先生）用于直接尊称对方；gentleman（绅士、先生）用于指称男性。Senhor 具有相应的称谓或指称功能，同时保留葡萄牙语文化背景。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Mr. precedes a name, sir addresses a man respectfully, and gentleman refers to a man politely. Senhor can perform the corresponding title or reference functions while retaining a Portuguese-speaking cultural setting.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: senior“较年长的”→值得尊敬的人→Senhor“先生”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Latin senior, 'older' → someone treated with respect → Senhor, 'Mr.' or 'sir'.

etymology_story.en: Cabomba is a New Latin genus name derived from Spanish cabomba; English also uses lowercase cabomba for a plant belonging to that genus. Its spelling should not be divided into invented English roots describing its leaves. [Etymology reference](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/cabomba)

morphology_enriched.zh: Cabomba 为整体借入的属名，无现代英语前缀或后缀；小写 cabomba 为植物通名，可数复数为 cabombas。植物分类命名中，Cabomba 去掉词尾 -a，再加科名后缀 -aceae，形成 Cabombaceae（莼菜科，亦称水盾草科）；该词没有常用的英语动词或副词派生形式。[分类参考](https://www.iplant.cn/foc/pdf/Cabombaceae.pdf)
morphology_enriched.en: Cabomba is a borrowed genus name without modern English prefixes or suffixes; lowercase cabomba is a common plant name, with the countable plural cabombas. In botanical nomenclature, removing final -a and adding the family suffix -aceae gives Cabombaceae; there are no usual English verb or adverb derivatives. [Taxonomic reference](https://www.iplant.cn/foc/pdf/Cabombaceae.pdf)

morphology_enriched.zh: 屈折结构：fil-（线、丝）+ -um（拉丁语中性单数词尾）→ filum；将 -um 换为 -a → fila。fila 已是复数，不能再加 -s；相关词有 filar（丝的）、filiform（丝状的）、filament（细丝）、filamentous（丝状的）和 filamentary（细丝的），它们共享“线、丝”的词源。
morphology_enriched.en: Inflection: fil- ('thread') + the Latin neuter singular ending -um → filum; replacing -um with plural -a gives fila. Fila is already plural and does not take another -s; related words sharing the thread root include filar, filiform, filament, filamentous, and filamentary.

synonyms_and_nuances.en: Filaments emphasizes threadlike shape and has broad applications; fibers emphasizes slender components of tissue or material; nerve filaments is restricted to neural contexts. Fila is a specialist anatomical term retaining a Latin plural.

etymology_story.zh: stade 经中古法语 stade（较早形式为 estade）进入英语，来自拉丁语 stadium，最终源于希腊语 stadion，指长度单位及相应长度的赛道。地质学用义则将“阶段”的概念用于冰川活动的分期。[词源与专业用义参考](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/stade)
etymology_story.en: Stade entered English through Middle French stade, earlier estade, from Latin stadium and ultimately Greek stadion, a measure of length and a racecourse of that length. Geological usage applies the idea of a stage to a subdivision of glacial activity. [Etymology and specialist usage reference](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/stade)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为整体借词 stade，复数 stades，没有可自由分析的前后缀。相关词包括 stadial（冰阶；冰阶的）、interstadial（间冰阶；间冰阶的）和同源词 stadium（体育场；古代长度单位）；stadial 与 stade 相关，但不是简单保留词尾 e 再加 -ial，stade-like 也不是需要列入词族的固定派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats stade as a whole loanword, with the plural stades and no freely analyzable prefix or suffix. Related vocabulary includes stadial ('a stade' or 'relating to one'), interstadial ('a milder interval between stadials' or 'relating to it'), and the cognate stadium; stadial is not formed by simply retaining final e and adding -ial, and stade-like is not an established derivative that needs a separate family entry.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 长度义中，stadion 和 stadium 可表示同一类古代单位，但具体数值须看地区和文献；地质义中，stadial 是较常见的对应术语。glaciation（冰期、冰川作用期）通常指更大的时间单位，不能直接等同于一个 stade。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the distance sense, stadion and stadium can name the same ancient unit, whose exact value depends on location and source. For the geological sense, stadial is the more usual equivalent; glaciation generally denotes a larger interval rather than a single stade.

senses.collocation_en: a choice between Tweedledum and Tweedledee; political Tweedledum and Tweedledee
senses.collocation_zh: 在两个几乎没有区别的选项之间作选择；政治上几无区别的两方

senses.sentence_zh: 选民抱怨说，在这两名候选人之间作选择，简直就是在两个几乎没有区别的人之间作选择。

etymology_story.zh: Tweedledum 与 Tweedledee 因约翰·拜罗姆在18世纪讽刺亨德尔与博农奇尼之争的诗句而广为人知，名字以相近的拟乐音突出差别之小。两者后来成为童谣人物，并出现在刘易斯·卡罗尔的《爱丽丝镜中奇遇记》中，进一步形成“几无实质区别的两方”这一比喻义。
etymology_story.en: Tweedledum and Tweedledee became well known through John Byrom's eighteenth-century verse mocking the rivalry between Handel and Bononcini; their similar musical-sounding names emphasized a trivial difference. They later appeared in a nursery rhyme and Lewis Carroll's Through the Looking-Glass, reinforcing their figurative use for two barely distinguishable alternatives.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中主要作为不可自由拆分的专名使用；历史上可理解为拟声成分 tweedle 加上与 dee 对举的 dum，而不是普通词根加生产性后缀。Tweedledee 是配对名称，不是其派生词；没有常用的派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, this is primarily a fixed proper name rather than a freely analyzable formation. Historically, it combines the sound-imitating element tweedle with dum, contrasting with dee; Tweedledee is its paired name, not a derivative, and there is no established everyday derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 专名无真正近义词；比喻义可比较 double（外貌或身份上的相似者）、lookalike（强调长相相似的人）和 interchangeable alternatives（强调实际选择上可以互换的选项）。Tweedledum and Tweedledee 尤其讽刺表面竞争却没有实质区别的双方。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The proper name has no true synonym. In figurative use, double suggests a close counterpart, lookalike emphasizes physical resemblance, and interchangeable alternatives emphasizes practical equivalence; Tweedledum and Tweedledee particularly mocks rivals whose differences are superficial.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 同样的 tweedle，只把 dum 换成 dee：名字略不同，实质差不多。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep tweedle and swap dum for dee: a tiny change in name, almost no change in substance.

etymology_story.zh: 英语 arista 借自拉丁语 arista，原指谷物的芒或穗。科学术语沿用其“细长尖突”的形态特征，又将它用于某些昆虫触角上的刚毛状结构。
etymology_story.en: English arista comes from Latin arista, meaning an awn or ear of grain. Scientific usage retained the image of a slender pointed projection and extended it to a bristle-like structure on certain insects' antennae.

morphology_enriched.zh: arista 在现代英语中是完整借入的词干，不宜机械拆成英语词根和后缀；其拉丁式复数为 aristae，也可见英语式复数 aristas。相关构词包括 arist- + -ate → aristate（有芒的）和 arist- + -al → aristal（芒的；触角芒的）。
morphology_enriched.en: Arista is a borrowed stem in modern English, rather than a transparent combination of English roots and affixes. Its Latin plural is aristae, and the regular plural aristas also occurs; related formations include arist- + -ate → aristate, meaning bearing an awn, and arist- + -al → aristal, meaning relating to an arista.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: awn（芒）是植物学义最直接的对应词；bristle（刚毛）泛指短而硬的毛状结构；seta（刚毛）是生物学中更广泛的毛状或刚毛状结构名称。arista 在昆虫学中特指特定的触角附属结构，不能与这些词任意互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Awn is the closest equivalent in the botanical sense; bristle is a general word for a stiff hair-like structure; seta is a broader biological term for a hair or bristle. In entomology, arista names a specific antennal structure, so these terms are not freely interchangeable.

etymology_story.zh: brazils 是 Brazil nuts 的简称 brazil 的复数形式，名称来自巴西这一地名。巴西国名本身与早期贸易中的 brazilwood（巴西红木）有关，但坚果义直接来自完整名称 Brazil nut 的缩略。
etymology_story.en: Brazils is the plural of brazil, a shortening of Brazil nut named after Brazil. The country's name is historically connected with brazilwood, but the nut sense comes directly from shortening the compound Brazil nut.

morphology_enriched.zh: Brazil nut → brazil（复合名称缩略）；brazil + -s → brazils（规则复数），也可写作 Brazils。相关完整形式为 Brazil nut / Brazil nuts；Brazilian（巴西的；巴西人）由地名 Brazil 派生，不是由坚果名 brazils 派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Brazil nut → brazil by shortening; brazil + -s → brazils by regular plural formation, also written Brazils. The corresponding full forms are Brazil nut and Brazil nuts; Brazilian derives from the place name Brazil, not from the nut name brazils.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Brazil nuts（巴西坚果）是完全对应且更明确的全称；Brazil nut kernels（巴西果仁）明确指去壳后的可食部分。brazils 是较简短的称呼，尤其见于英国英语。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Brazil nuts is the exact, more explicit full form; Brazil nut kernels specifically identifies the edible parts after shelling. Brazils is a shorter name used especially in British English.

etymology_story.zh: manciple 在中古英语时期经盎格鲁法语传入，词源属于拉丁语 manceps（购买者、承包人）及 mancipium 这一词族。其英语意义专门化为替学院、修道院等机构采购日常物资的人。

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将 manciple 作为完整词干记忆，不宜按 man + ciple 拆解；manciple + -s → manciples（复数）。没有常用的现代派生词族；其历史词源不等于现代英语的构词公式。

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 pandy 是完整词干；动词变形为 pandies（第三人称单数）、pandied（过去式及过去分词）和 pandying（现在分词及动名词）。名词复数为 pandies；名词与动词形式相同，没有常用的其他派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Pandy is a whole stem in modern English. Its verb forms are pandies, pandied, and pandying; the noun plural is pandies. The noun and verb share the same form, and there are no other commonly used derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: cane（用藤条打）强调工具，不限定打手心；slap（掌掴、拍打）通常指用张开的手击打，不限定惩罚或身体部位；smack（打、掴）常指惩罚性拍打。pandy 特指把手心作为受击部位的旧式惩罚。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Cane specifies the instrument but not necessarily the palm; slap usually means striking with an open hand and need not involve punishment; smack often describes a punitive slap. Pandy specifically identifies the old practice of striking the palm as punishment.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: pande：“伸开！”——伸出手掌，随后挨打。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Pande means spread out: the pupil opens a hand before the punitive stroke.

senses.meaning_zh: 女预言者；被认为能预知未来的女人（文学用语）
senses.meaning_en: a woman regarded as having prophetic powers, especially in literary language
senses.english_definition: If someone calls a woman a sibyl, they mean that she seems able to predict the future or reveal hidden truths.
senses.collocation_en: a modern sibyl; speak like a sibyl
senses.collocation_zh: 现代女预言者；像女先知一样说话

etymology_story.zh: 该词在中古英语时期经法语和拉丁语 sibylla 传入，源自古希腊语 Sibylla，其更早来源不明。它最初指古代受神启示的女先知，后来也用于泛指具有预言能力的女人。
etymology_story.en: The word entered Middle English through French and Latin sibylla, ultimately from ancient Greek Sibylla, whose earlier origin is uncertain. Originally referring to an inspired female prophet of antiquity, it later acquired a broader literary use for a woman with prophetic powers.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 sibyl 是不可再作常规词缀拆分的单纯词；复数为 sibyls。同族形容词有 sibylline（女先知的；预言式的；隐晦的）和较少见的 sibyllic（女先知的）；两者都使用 sibyll- 这一双写 l 的词干形式。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, sibyl is a simple base without a productive prefix–root–suffix division; its plural is sibyls. Related adjectives are sibylline, meaning prophetic or cryptic, and the less common sibyllic, meaning relating to a sibyl; both use the stem form sibyll- with double l.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: prophetess 指女性先知，适用范围比 sibyl 广；seer 指能预见未来的人，不限性别；oracle 可指传达神谕的人或机构，强调神意与权威。sibyl 尤其带有古希腊、古罗马背景或文学色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Prophetess is a broader term for a female prophet; seer is gender-neutral and emphasizes foreknowledge; oracle can denote a person or institution delivering divine answers. Sibyl particularly evokes classical antiquity or a literary atmosphere.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住一个形象：古代女先知说出神秘预言；sibyl 是说话的人，sibylline 是她那种预言式、隐晦的表达。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture an ancient woman delivering a mysterious prophecy: the sibyl is the speaker, and sibylline describes her prophetic or cryptic words.

senses.meaning_zh: 西姆内尔蛋糕；传统英国杏仁糖水果蛋糕
senses.meaning_en: a traditional British fruitcake with marzipan, associated with Easter and Mothering Sunday
senses.english_definition: Simnel is a fruitcake with a layer of marzipan inside and another on top, traditionally eaten in Britain around Easter or on Mothering Sunday.

etymology_story.zh: 中古英语 simenel 经盎格鲁法语传入，最终源自拉丁语 simila，意为“细麦粉”。它早先指用精细面粉制作的面包，后来逐渐专指如今与复活节及英国传统母亲节有关的水果蛋糕。
etymology_story.en: Middle English simenel came through Anglo-French, ultimately from Latin simila, meaning fine wheat flour. The name originally referred to bread made from fine flour and later became associated with the fruitcake eaten around Easter and on Mothering Sunday.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 simnel 是不可再作常规词缀拆分的借词，没有常用的词缀派生词。simnel + cake 构成复合名词 simnel cake；需要表示多个完整蛋糕或不同品种时可用复数 simnels，但通常说 simnel cakes。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, simnel is an unanalyzable loanword with no common affix-derived family. Simnel + cake forms the compound noun simnel cake; the plural simnels is possible for whole cakes or varieties, although simnel cakes is more usual.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: fruitcake 是水果蛋糕的上位词；Easter cake 泛指复活节蛋糕；Christmas cake 通常指圣诞节食用的浓郁水果蛋糕。simnel 特指具有杏仁糖夹层和顶层的传统蛋糕，以上词语都不是完全等义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Fruitcake is the broader category; Easter cake describes cakes associated with Easter; Christmas cake usually denotes a rich fruitcake served at Christmas. Simnel specifically identifies the traditional cake with marzipan inside and on top, so these alternatives are not exact synonyms.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 沿着“细麦粉→精制节庆糕点→杏仁糖水果蛋糕”这条历史链记忆。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Follow the historical chain: fine flour → special festive baking → fruitcake with marzipan.

etymology_story.zh: 表示刀具的 ulu 借自因纽特语言中的传统刀具名称。新加坡、马来西亚英语中表示“偏远的”的 ulu 则独立借自马来语 ulu，与 hulu“上游、内陆”有关，由地理上的上游或内陆引申为偏僻难达。
etymology_story.en: The knife name ulu was borrowed from an Inuit-language term for the traditional implement. The unrelated Singaporean and Malaysian adjective comes from Malay ulu, related to hulu, meaning the upper reaches of a river or the interior, hence a remote location.

morphology_enriched.zh: 两个义项在现代英语中都是不可按英语词缀拆分的独立借词，彼此没有派生关系。刀具名词的英语复数为 ulus，可组成 ulu knife；区域性形容词可用 very ulu、more ulu 等分析式表达，没有常用的词缀派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Both senses are independent loanwords without an English affix-based breakdown, and neither is derived from the other. The knife noun has the English plural ulus and occurs in ulu knife; the regional adjective takes constructions such as very ulu and more ulu and has no common affix-derived forms.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 刀具义没有完全等义的常用英语单词：knife 是上位词，rocker knife 强调摇切方式，未必指乌卢刀。形容词义近 remote 和 out-of-the-way：remote 强调距离远，out-of-the-way 强调偏离常去之处，ulu 则带有新马口语色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: The knife sense has no exact common English synonym: knife is the broader category, while rocker knife emphasizes a rocking cutting action and need not denote an ulu. For the adjective, remote emphasizes distance and out-of-the-way emphasizes an inconvenient or little-frequented location; ulu adds a distinctly Singaporean or Malaysian informal flavor.

mnemonic_anchor.en: For the knife, picture a handle above a crescent-shaped blade; for the regional adjective, imagine travelling upriver into the remote interior.

senses.meaning_en: a Spanish fortress or fortified palace, especially one of Moorish origin
senses.english_definition: An alcazar is a fortress or fortified palace in Spain, especially one built by the Moors or influenced by their architecture.

etymology_story.zh: 英语 alcazar 借自西班牙语 alcázar，后者经安达卢西亚阿拉伯语源自阿拉伯语 al-qaṣr“宫殿、城堡”。其中 qaṣr 最终与拉丁语 castrum“堡垒”有关，词义在伊比利亚语境中形成了“宫堡”的特色。
etymology_story.en: English alcazar comes from Spanish alcázar, through Andalusian Arabic from Arabic al-qaṣr, meaning the palace or castle. Qaṣr ultimately derives from Latin castrum, meaning a fort, and the Iberian usage developed the characteristic sense of a fortified palace.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 alcazar 是整体借入的名词，不能把 al- 当作能自由使用的英语前缀；复数为 alcazars，没有常用的词缀派生词。历史结构可分析为阿拉伯语 al-（定冠词）+ qaṣr（宫殿、城堡）；西班牙语原形为 alcázar。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, alcazar is a whole-word borrowing; al- is not a productive English prefix here. Its plural is alcazars, and it has no common affix-derived family; historically, Arabic al- is the definite article and qaṣr means palace or castle, while the Spanish source form is alcázar.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: castle 强调城堡建筑及防御功能；fortress 更突出军事防守；palace 强调王室或统治者的居所。alcazar 兼具宫殿与堡垒的特征，并带有明确的西班牙历史文化背景。

senses.pos: n. 名词（苏格兰地方用语）
senses.meaning_zh: 石头；石块
senses.meaning_en: A stone, in Scottish regional usage.
senses.english_definition: A clach is a stone, especially in Scottish regional speech or names.
senses.collocation_en: a large clach; a standing clach
senses.collocation_zh: 一块大石头；一块直立的石头
senses.sentence_en: The local guide called the standing stone a clach.

etymology_story.zh: Clach 借自苏格兰盖尔语 clach“石头”，与爱尔兰语 cloch 及更早的盖尔语形式有关。它保留了原来的具体含义，也常见于苏格兰地名。
etymology_story.en: Clach is borrowed from Scottish Gaelic clach, meaning stone, and is related to Irish cloch and earlier Gaelic forms. It retains its literal meaning and also occurs in Scottish place names.

morphology_enriched.zh: 在英语中，clach 是不可再分析的借词，没有常用的英语派生词族。盖尔语复数 clachan 可分析为 clach + -an，但这是源语言的屈折变化；英语中表示“小村落”的 clachan 应作为相关借词单独学习，不能简单解释为英语中 clach 的规则复数。
morphology_enriched.en: In English, clach is an unanalyzed loanword with no common English derivational family. The Gaelic plural clachan can be analyzed as clach + -an, but this is source-language inflection. English clachan, meaning a small village, should be learned as a related borrowing rather than treated simply as a regular English plural of clach.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: stone 是最接近的通用词；rock 可指岩石材料或较大的天然石块；boulder 特指大块岩石。Clach 的区别主要在于苏格兰地域和盖尔语文化色彩，而非固定的大小差异。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Stone is the closest general equivalent; rock can refer to the material or a substantial natural mass; boulder specifically denotes a large rock. Clach is distinguished chiefly by its Scottish regional and Gaelic associations, rather than by a fixed size.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 想象苏格兰高地的一块立石：clach 就是当地的“石头”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a standing stone in the Scottish Highlands: clach is the local word for stone.

usage_note: 排印、校对用语；日常编辑通常说 delete；本课教动词，不考同形的删除符号名词义。
sentence: The proofreader asked the printer to dele the repeated word.

senses.pos: v. 动词（校对、排印术语）
senses.meaning_zh: 删去；删除排印文字
senses.meaning_en: To delete text, especially in proofreading or printing.
senses.english_definition: When you dele a word or passage, you mark it for deletion or remove it from the text.
senses.collocation_en: dele a word; dele a line
senses.collocation_zh: 删去一个词；删去一行文字
senses.sentence_en: The proofreader asked the compositor to dele the repeated word.
senses.sentence_zh: 校对员要求排字工删去那个重复的词。

senses.meaning_zh: 删除符号；删字符
senses.meaning_en: A proofreading mark indicating that something should be deleted.
senses.english_definition: A dele is a proofreading mark that tells someone to remove a letter, word, or passage.
senses.collocation_en: a dele mark; insert a dele
senses.collocation_zh: 删除符号；加上一个删除符号
senses.sentence_en: She put a dele in the margin beside the duplicated sentence.
senses.sentence_zh: 她在重复句子旁的页边空白处加了一个删除符号。

etymology_story.zh: Dele 来自拉丁语 dēlēre“擦去、毁去”的单数命令式 dēlē，原意相当于“删掉！”。英语把这个指令用于校对和排印，并进一步用它命名表示删除的校对符号。
etymology_story.en: Dele comes from dēlē, the singular imperative of Latin dēlēre, meaning to erase or destroy: literally, delete! English adopted the instruction in proofreading and printing and also used it as the name of a deletion mark.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语将 dele 视为不可再分析的借词，既可作动词，也可作名词。动词形式为 deles、deled、deleing，名词复数为 deles；delete、deletion、deletable 与其同源或属于相关词族，但不是把现代英语后缀直接加到 dele 上所得。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats dele as an unanalyzed loanword used as both a verb and a noun. Its verb forms are deles, deled, and deleing, and its noun plural is deles. Delete, deletion, and deletable belong to the related etymological family, but are not formed simply by adding modern English suffixes to dele.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: delete 是最通用的“删除”，适用于文字和数字内容；strike out 强调用划线表示删去；excise 强调从较大文本中切除某一部分。Dele 具有传统校对和排印的专业色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Delete is the general term for removing text or digital content; strike out emphasizes marking text with a line; excise emphasizes cutting a section from a larger text. Dele belongs particularly to traditional proofreading and printing.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 dele 记作校对员写下的拉丁语指令“删掉！”：既可指删除动作，也可指删除符号。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember dele as a proofreader's Latin command, delete!: it names both the action and the mark.

morphology.text: 整词作为独立词素记忆。派生词：penn-（penna 的词干，羽毛）+ -aceous（具有……性质的）→ pennaceous（正羽状的）。

etymology.text: 直接借自拉丁语 penna，意思就是“羽毛”。记住展开成片的羽毛形状，就能联想到正羽。

usage_note: 鸟类学术语，指具有明确羽轴和羽片的正羽；通常小写。复数 pennae，不能把它当作 Pennsylvania 的缩写。

senses.meaning_zh: 【鸟类学】正羽：具有羽轴和成形羽片、构成鸟体外部羽衣的羽毛
senses.meaning_en: A contour feather with a central shaft and a developed vane.
senses.english_definition: A penna is a feather with a central shaft and a developed vane that forms part of a bird's outer plumage.

etymology_story.zh: 直接借自拉丁语 penna，意为“羽毛；翅膀”。英语鸟类学将其意义收窄，用来指具有成形羽片的正羽，与绒羽相区别。[词源与释义依据](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/penna)
etymology_story.en: Borrowed directly from Latin penna, meaning 'feather' or 'wing'. In English ornithology, its meaning narrowed to a contour feather, distinguished from a down feather. [Etymology and definition source](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/penna)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为完整借词处理，不拆成普通英语词根和词缀；复数为 pennae。相关拉丁词干为 penn-：penn- + -aceous → pennaceous（正羽型的；具有紧密羽片的）；相关同源词包括 pennate（羽状的）、pennation（羽状排列）和 penniform（羽毛状的），并非都由现代英语 penna 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Treat penna as a whole borrowed word rather than a combination of ordinary English morphemes; its plural is pennae. The related Latin stem penn- appears in penn- + -aceous → pennaceous, describing a feather with a coherent vane; related formations include pennate ('feather-shaped'), pennation ('a featherlike arrangement'), and penniform ('resembling a feather'), rather than all being direct modern derivatives of penna.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: contour feather（正羽）是最接近的对应表达；feather（羽毛）范围更广，也包括绒羽；quill 常指大而硬的羽毛或其羽管，侧重点不同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Contour feather is the closest equivalent; feather is broader and includes down feathers; quill often emphasizes a large, stiff feather or its hollow shaft.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 penn- 与“羽毛”相连：penna 是一根羽毛，pennaceous 强调羽片紧密成形。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect penn- with 'feather': penna names the feather, while pennaceous highlights its coherent vane.

etymology.text: 这是现代英语把 aluminum、nickel 和 cobalt 三个元素名称缩合而成的材料名。读名字就能想起铝、镍、钴。

usage_note: 材料名，通常作不可数名词，也可放在 magnet 前修饰材料；拼写一般小写。

etymology_story.zh: 名称由 aluminium 或 aluminum（铝）、nickel（镍）和 cobalt（钴）的开头片段拼合而成。它以三种标志性合金元素命名，但这种材料实际上以铁为基础。[构词与释义依据](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/alnico)
etymology_story.en: The name combines the opening fragments of aluminium or aluminum, nickel, and cobalt. These identify characteristic alloying elements, although the material itself is iron-based. [Formation and definition source](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/alnico)

morphology_enriched.zh: al(uminium/aluminum) + ni(ckel) + co(balt) → alnico，是片段拼合词，也与元素符号 Al、Ni、Co 对应。没有常用的词缀派生形式；常见复合表达有 alnico magnet（铝镍钴磁体）、cast alnico（铸造铝镍钴合金）和 sintered alnico（烧结铝镍钴合金）；alnico magnet 中的 alnico 是名词作定语。
morphology_enriched.en: al(uminium/aluminum) + ni(ckel) + co(balt) → alnico, a blend whose components also match the chemical symbols Al, Ni, and Co. There are no established common affixal derivatives; compounds include alnico magnet, cast alnico, and sintered alnico. In alnico magnet, alnico functions as an attributive noun.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: alnico alloy（铝镍钴合金）是明确的同义表达；permanent-magnet alloy（永磁合金）是涵盖其他材料的上位概念；magnetic alloy（磁性合金）范围更广，不保证具有永磁性能。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Alnico alloy is an explicit equivalent; permanent-magnet alloy is a broader category containing other materials; magnetic alloy is broader still and does not necessarily imply permanent-magnet properties.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Al + Ni + Co → alnico：名字记住铝、镍、钴，材料记住铁基永磁合金。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Al + Ni + Co spells alnico: remember the three named elements within an iron-based permanent-magnet alloy.

senses.meaning_zh: 【苏格兰及英格兰北部方言】庇护；避风处；栖身处
senses.meaning_en: Shelter, protection, or a sheltered place in Scottish and northern English usage.
senses.english_definition: A bield is a place where a person or animal can shelter from bad weather or danger.
senses.collocation_zh: 寻求庇护；舒适的栖身处
senses.sentence_en: The sheep found a bield behind the stone wall.
senses.sentence_zh: 羊群在石墙后找到了一处避风的地方。

senses.meaning_zh: 【苏格兰及英格兰北部方言】庇护；遮蔽；躲避风雨
senses.meaning_en: To shelter or protect someone or something, or to take shelter.
senses.english_definition: If something bields you, it shelters you; if you bield somewhere, you take shelter there.
senses.collocation_en: bield the sheep; bield behind a wall
senses.collocation_zh: 为羊群提供庇护；躲在墙后避风雨
senses.sentence_en: The high wall bielded the sheep from the bitter wind.
senses.sentence_zh: 高墙为羊群挡住了刺骨的寒风。

senses.meaning_zh: 【罕见苏格兰用法】有遮蔽的；避风而舒适的
senses.meaning_en: Sheltered and cosy, in rare Scots usage.
senses.english_definition: A place that is bield is sheltered from the weather and feels comfortable.
senses.collocation_en: a bield corner; a bield spot
senses.collocation_zh: 避风的角落；有遮蔽的地方
senses.sentence_en: They chose a bield corner of the garden for their seat.
senses.sentence_zh: 他们选择在花园里一个避风的角落安放座椅。

etymology_story.zh: 名词经中古英语及早期苏格兰语形式追溯至古英语 bieldo、byldo，原意为“勇气；胆量”，与 bold 同源。意义逐渐扩展为“保护”和“提供保护的地方”。[词源依据](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/bield)
etymology_story.en: The noun descends through Middle English and early Scots forms from Old English bieldo or byldo, meaning 'boldness' and related to bold. Its meaning extended to protection and then to a place providing protection. [Etymology source](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/bield)

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代形式以 bield 为整体词基；动词变化为 bields、bielded、bielding。方言派生包括 bield + -y → bieldy（有遮蔽的）及 bield + -less → bieldless（无处庇护的）；bielded 也可表示“受到庇护的”，bielding 可表示“提供庇护的”；变体拼写包括 beild。上述搭配属地域性表达，没有通用英语高频搭配；少见形容词用法有时也被解释为名词定语用法或分词简化形式。[词形与用法依据](https://www.dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/bield)
morphology_enriched.en: Use bield as the whole modern base; its verb forms are bields, bielded, and bielding. Dialect formations include bield + -y → bieldy ('sheltered') and bield + -less → bieldless ('without shelter'); bielded can mean 'sheltered', and bielding can mean 'sheltering'. Beild is a spelling variant. The combinations above are regional rather than high-frequency general English; the rare adjective is sometimes analysed as an attributive noun or a shortened participial form. [Forms and usage source](https://www.dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/bield)

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: shelter（庇护；遮蔽处）最通用，也可作动词；refuge（避难处）更强调摆脱危险；haven（安全而安宁的地方）更突出安全感。bield 带有鲜明的地域色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Shelter is the general equivalent and also functions as a verb; refuge emphasizes escape from danger; haven suggests safety and peace. Bield carries a distinctly regional character.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 沿历史意义串联：勇气带来保护，保护形成避风处。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Follow the historical chain: boldness provides protection, and protection provides shelter.

pronunciation.note: 按 Collins 的字母读法转写；P、D、Q 依次读出。

forms: 副词缩写不变形；大小写变体 pdq、PDQ；带点写法 P.D.Q.。
family: pretty damn quick 是展开形式，不是另一个时态。

morphology.text: p(retty) + d(amn) + q(uick) → PDQ（赶快；马上），取三个词的首字母，不把它硬拆成词根。

etymology.text: 来自英语口语 pretty damn quick 的首字母缩写，十九世纪已有使用。可把三个字母想成一声急促的催办。

usage_note: 非正式俚语缩写，常写 PDQ，也有 pdq 和 P.D.Q.。逐个读字母；不适合正式公函。原短语含 damn，语气较随便。
